After overcoming the Death Tower, Conrad and his allies must once again face the Morphs, the alien race that threatens all civilizations. Moreover, his friend Ian got abducted and to get answers Conrad has to find him… Are the Morphs behind this disappearance? But why? You will have to find out…
Unveil a nefarious plot and save the solar system!

games.title: Flashback 2: Collector's Edition
games.description:
The Collector’s Edition releases on Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X and PlayStation 5, will include:

- Limited Edition
- The original Flashback video game in digital version
- An 8-inch (20cm) figurine of Conrad
- 3 lithographs
- A unique badge
- 2 stickers sheets

games.title: Flashback 2: Limited Edition
games.description:
The Limited Edition of Flashback 2 includes
- The game
- An exclusive Steelbook
- The digital soundtrack

games.title: Flashback: 25th Anniversary - Collector's Edition
games.description:
To celebrate the 25th anniversary of the Super Nintendo version of game, Microïds is releasing a Collector's Edition (in Europe and Australia), which includes the game in physical edition, a retro cartridge style metal case, an exclusive numbered metal card, a 24-page retro-style instruction booklet, the digital soundtrack (remastered version). Pre-orders are now open!

In the Nintendo Switch version of Flashback, players will be able to choose between the original 1993 gaming experience and Modern mode, which contains:

games.title: Flashout III
games.description: Flashout is back! Where high speed meets high stakes. Where unforgiving combat, loud electronic music and addictive boosts of adrenaline mix up to separate winners from losers. Where gravitation is nothing more than an empty word. Take part in an exciting, head-to-head fight to the finish!

games.title: Flaskoman
games.description: Flaskoman is a puzzle platformer in a steampunk laboratory. Use mysterious liquids to activate lab mechanism and your abilities.

games.title: Flat Heroes
games.description: Flat Heroes is a minimalist super intense local multiplayer game with special care put into the game-feel and polishing of every detail in a trendy graphic experience. The game includes multiple cooperative and competitive modes for 1-4 players and features squares!

games.title: Flat Kingdom: Paper's Cut Edition
games.description: The Flat Kingdom is a beautiful and peaceful 2D land, but now it’s threatened by an evil thief and becoming 3D! The only who can stop the chaos is Flat, a little hero able to change into a circle, triangle or square in order to solve puzzles, overcome obstacles and defeat giant bosses!

games.title: Flatland Vol.1
games.description: Flatland - Vol. 1 is a fast-paced hardcore platformer featuring hand-crafted levels and Lightning-fast respawns. Help Square survive his journey to the depths of Flatland, a minimalist neon-style 2D world. Run, jump, die, learn, repeat.

games.title: Flatland Vol.2
games.description:
Flatland Vol.2 is a fast-paced hardcore platformer featuring hand-crafted levels and Lightning-fast respawns. Help Square in crossing the most dangerous part of Flatland: the flooded wells.

Run, jump, die, learn, repeat.

games.title: Flatland: Prologue
games.category: Platform, Puzzle, Strategy, Adventure, Indie, Arcade

games.title: FlatOut 4: Total Insanity
games.description: FlatOut 4: Total Insanity is a return to the franchise's adrenaline-pumping arcade destruction roots. Featuring an exciting blend of white-knuckle speed and wild out-of-control racing tracks, FlatOut 4 promises an intense death-defying demolition derby game featuring muscle cars, race cars, trucks and even a rocket boosted ice cream van!

games.title: Flatout Pixel Racing
games.description: Go flatout! No brakes needed! A retro arcade top down racing game in a pixel art style.

games.title: Flewfies Adventure
games.description: Join Flewfie and friends on an epic side scrolling adventure! Zap, beam and fly your way through 5 unique worlds and save your friends along the way!

games.title: Flight Attendant Simulator: Onboard Tasks
games.description: Welcome Aboard! Fasten Your Seatbelt—It’s Going to Be a Thrilling Ride!

games.title: Flight of Light
games.description: Rhythm-racing - Fly through fantastical worlds, or race your friends in time to the music!

games.title: Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business
games.description: Lead the Skies and Build Your Aviation Empire!

games.title: Flightpath: Adventures in Venaris
games.description:
Blast through a story-driven shoot’em up where your choices drastically alter the experience!

With multiple paths, unique content for each pilot you choose, specific tasks to complete, procedurally generated levels and unpredictable enemy attack patterns across 10 stages.

games.title: Fling to the Finish
games.category: Platform, Racing, Sport, Adventure, Indie, Arcade
games.description: Fling to the Finish is a cooperative racing game where teammates are tethered together by a stretchy elastic rope. Get up close and personal with your partner as you share a controller to maneuver two characters bouncing, rolling, and flinging their way to the finish line!

games.title: Flinthook
games.description: Flinthook is a fast action-platformer with “roguelike” elements. Become space’s greatest pirate with your hookshot, pistol and slowmo powers!

games.title: Flip It
games.description: Wrong side

games.title: Flipbomb
games.description: Flipbomb is a fast paced one-button game where you press any button and activate a flipper. But there's a twist, instead of a ball, you are hitting bombs! Quite handy, in fact, because there's a rain of debris coming down your way, and you have to clear it.

games.title: Flippin Kaktus
games.description: Flippin Kaktus is a brutal action-driven vendetta featuring a spiky hero with the thorny past and rage-outbreaks combat style. When the vicious “Calaveras” drug cartel raids his home, he breaks bad in a hardcore journey to save his foster family. Reveal the dark side of the wacky 80s punk and flip the switch to obliterate anyone in his path!

games.title: Flipping Death
games.description: Possess the living, aid the dead and flip between the worlds of Flipping Death - a puzzling adventure platformer where you find yourself filling in for Death. Maybe your new powers will help you solve the mystery of your own demise?

games.title: Flippy Jump
games.description: You close the door of your refrigerator and an interesting life begins inside. Fruits and vegetables try to escape from this big white cage. Break everything around you and smash through shelves to find a way out. The more precise the timing of the jump, the more powerful the impact. That's exactly what you need to succeed! Try to get out all the fruits and vegetables out of the fridge. Carrot, cucumber, sausage, and even a spoon for some reason.

games.title: Flipy
games.description: Flipy is chilling game with Christmas atmosphere. Your goal is to stack as many blocks on top of each other as you can to achieve the highest possible score. Good Luck!

games.title: Floaty Rescue
games.description: Tap, drag, and draw the perfect path. Floaty Rescue is a clean, line-drawing arcade game where you pilot a small rescue boat, collect coins, and scoop survivors before they drift away.

games.title: Flock
games.description: Flock is a multiplayer co-op game about the joy of flight and collecting adorable flying creatures with your friends. Soar through beautiful landscapes, seeking out rare and elusive creatures to add to your flock.

games.title: Flockers
games.description:
For over twenty years sheep have been an integral part of the worms’ fearsome arsenal. Held for years within the evil thrall of their diabolical masters the sheep are finally making a dash for freedom! Escaping the tyrannical worms, the flock must dodge its way past all manner of lethal machinery and traps as the sheep negotiate their path through the confinement of the Worms’ weapons factory out into the testing grounds and ever onwards towards pastures green.

Flockers is a modern day take on the classic A to B puzzle genre with a generous helping of sinister foreboding and dark humour for good measure. Levels have been designed to challenge the player’s skill and strategic planning as they attempt to guide their flock past heinous traps, sadistic devices and diabolical puzzles; rewarding those that can save the most sheep while still allowing progression for anyone who falls foul of the factory’s deadly machinery.

games.title: Flooded
games.category: Real Time Strategy (RTS), Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Indie
games.description: Flooded is a reversed city-builder, in which you need to optimize your production on an island that shrinks over time. Gather enough resources to flee to safety, while the surrounding world is getting flooded.

games.title: Floor 9
games.description: In Floor 9, you find yourself trapped in a mysterious hotel known as "Hotel Liminal." To escape, you must identify anomalies on each floor. These anomalies can be anywhere - on the ground, in paintings, or even right in front of your eyes. You must check every corner carefully, as one mistake will send you back to the beginning, to Floor 9. The game offers you a unique blend of eerie atmosphere, puzzle-solving, and survival, all wrapped up in a psychologically thrilling experience.

games.title: Floor Kids
games.description: Floor Kids is a new breakdance battle game featuring unique freestyle gameplay, rhythm challenges, and multiplayer sessions. Discover stylized hand-drawn graphics by award-winning animator JonJon set to an original soundtrack by world-renowned scratch DJ/producer Kid Koala. Innovative controls allow you the freedom to play the way you like with a dynamic scoring system that rewards your moves based on musicality, originality, and style. Build up your crew of bboys and bgirls, unlocking new characters and locations as you cross the city, busting hundreds of different moves and countless combinations on your journey from the corner to the club. Bring Your Skills. Build Your Crew. Find Your Style.

games.title: Floral Flowlove
games.description: On that day, I saw an angel.

games.title: flOw
games.description:
flOw is a game about piloting an aquatic organism through a surreal biosphere where players consume other organisms, evolve, and dive into the abyss. With an embedded design of DDA (dynamic difficulty adjustment), players with differing skill levels can intuitively customize their game experience and enjoy the game at their own pace.

You can play as one of 5 creatures, each in a unique environment. Lose yourself in the crisp “deep blue” in full HD at 1080p and 5.1 Surround Sound. Use the SIXAXIS motion sensors on the DUALSHOCK wireless controllers for an organic experience that will allow you to glide, flit, and flOw through the universe.

games.title: Flower
games.description:
ESCAPE TO A DREAMLIKE WORLD

From the studio behind the genre-bending titles Journey and flOw comes Flower, a unique gaming experience that lets you soar through a dreamlike world of luscious fields and rolling hills. Control the wind to carry a stream of flower petals around each landscape and watch as it comes to life.

Every level has its own unique aims and little mysteries – but you don’t have to worry about them if you don’t feel like it. Flower is about doing what you want, when you want. Freedom is everything.

games.title: Flower Shop: Summer In Fairbrook
games.description:
The Flower Shop is a dating and farming simulation game.

Steve's life has just taken a downward turn. His grades from his first semester in college are dismal, his relationship with his girlfriend is rocky at best, and now his dad is shipping him off to some farm for the summer so that he can "build character."

What's a poor, lazy, college kid to do?

Take control of Steve as he spends a summer in Fairbook, working on the farm, making new friends, and maintaining old relationships.

games.title: Flower Shop: Winter In Fairbrook
games.description:
The Flower Shop: Winter In Fairbrook is a dating and farming simulation game and takes place after the first Flower Shop game, Summer In Fairbrook.

Play as Natalie this time, and meet some of the characters of the first game like Clara, Susana, Steve, Trent, Jacob plus a "new entry": Ryan, who runs the general store of the town.

games.title: Flowers Are Dead
games.description: Flowers Are Dead is a first person story-based game. Play as Evelyn. Face your tribulations. Delve deep into your mind, trace down the one that got away and live through your memories.

games.title: Flowers by Powgi
games.description: This unique anagram puzzle is a bunch of fun! Plant letters on the petals to grow words through the middle of the flower!

games.title: Flowers: Les Quatre Saisons
games.description: A collection of four Flowers games in one package.

games.title: Fluffy Cubed
games.description:
Fluffy Cubed is a minimalist puzzle game where the mechanics are inspired by the famous Sokoban genre, of Japanese origin.

In this game, you play a kitten in the shape of a cube that must move the boxes to their places. But is not that simple, you'll need to analyze well your movements to make sure that the boxes will no get trapped.

The interface is simple, cute and you don't have to worry getting only one way to solve them, because there is many ways to complete the levels.

games.title: Fluffy Milo
games.description: Help Milo put the milk in the bowls.

games.title: Flupp the Fish
games.description: Play the three Adventures of Flupp, a tiny fish!

games.title: Fluster Cluck
games.description: Use explosives, rockets, turrets and mines to get your friends' UFOs out of the sky. Drag them to the Chikkinizer and ignore their whining. Shout jibes at the flying chikkins in a loud voice, since they can't mute the FLUSTER CLUCK MASTER! Earn bigger guns, faster ships, crazy hats! Free your friends and put them in the Chikkinizer. They will be instantly chikkinized with a MegaField, and laugh all the way up the ladder!

games.title: Flutter Bombs
games.description: Experience nature’s wrath in this top down twin stick shooter. Command up to 10 different wingsets each with a unique bombing tactic. Unleash fury with powerful weapon upgrades. Defend your grove with Flutter Bombs!

games.title: Fluxteria
games.description:
Welcome to Fluxteria, non-stop arcade-space-shooting action in full 3D. 
Four modes of play: Story Mode, Survival Mode, Timed-Attack Mode and Obstacle Race Mode.

games.title: Fly Corp
games.description: Develop your own transport network in various countries and cities: open new routes, buy new planes and upgrade them, increase capacity of the airports!

games.title: Fly Fly
games.description: Fly Fly is an endless game where players take flight as an eagle, collecting feathers while navigating through randomly generated hoops at varying distances.

games.title: Fly for Fly
games.description: In Fly for Fly, you control a cheeky little fly that turns a peaceful classroom into total chaos. Your only goal is to make every student lose their patience and survive long enough to see it happen.

games.title: Fly Light
games.description: Fly Light is a game in which you need to turn on lamps located on 4 different sides, thereby attracting midges to you. Thus, you need to lure as many midges as possible to the exploding area. But you need to be careful, because if you attract a midge too close to you, it can sit on the lamp, thereby partially blocking the glow range of the lamp, which will mean that you will not be able to attract a new midge so easily. You will lose when the midges stick to one of the lamps so that it can no longer shine. You get points for the number of midges destroyed using explosions.

games.title: Fly Punch Boom!
games.description: It's everything you've seen in your favorite anime fights: fly fast and smash your friends in the face until their expressions go all wonky; make them shoot off into collapsing buildings, krakens, killer cotton candy, or in space. Ram skyscrapers, whales and asteroids into your enemy, then fly towards them before they wake up and unleash over-the-top super moves. It's all about the joy of punching.

games.title: Fly the Plane
games.description: Fly now! Live an incredible flight experience to worlds full of light and color. Explore different scenarios in search of your rewards. Can you find them all?

games.title: Flying Bunny
games.description: Gravity-bound shooting runner!

games.title: Flying Soldiers
games.description: Get ready to command an odd squad of fun birds and devise a plan to bring them safe and sound to the end of the battlefield. An outlandish puzzle game that will challenge your mind to make these greenhorn recruits into brave soldiers.

games.title: Flying Sushi
games.description: Flying Sushi is a fast-paced, side-scrolling arcade game where you control a sentient piece of sushi as it soars through the air. Navigate through endless obstacles while collecting bonuses and power-ups to rack up the highest score possible. How far can you go in this quirky and fun adventure?

games.title: Flynn & Freckles
games.description:
Flynn, a young pirate, decides to begin a perilous quest in search for the most valuable of treasures: Captain Freckles’ sword. But, to his surprise, the sword is possessed by the old captain’s spirit. Now they’ll both have to face the dangers of the island and the curse that rests upon the treasure.

Flynn & Freckles is a third-person view, single player game with a great amount of exploration and combat. As Flynn we’ll need to deal with a series of platforms, puzzles and fight against loads of enemies.

F&F gives us the opportunity to enjoy, once again, a 3D platformer game, old school 90’s style, with a renewed artistic and technical approach, and all of it revolved around a fantastic pirate setting.

games.title: Flynn: Son of Crimson
games.description: Traverse a beautifully hand crafted world and unearth the mysteries of a dark past in this fast paced 2D action platformer with metroidvania elements.

games.title: Flywrench
games.description: Flywrench is a frenetic action game from the makers of Nidhogg about piloting an aerobatic ship through the depths of space.

games.title: Foam Frenzy
games.description: Charge forward, take aim, and pop every target with soft foam darts. Foam Frenzy is a fast, first-person arcade runner where rubbery foes flood the lane and your toy blaster keeps them bouncing. Snap to weak points, chain knockbacks, and clear waves before they crowd you.

games.title: Foamstars
games.description:
A 4v4 online party shooter from Square Enix that has you battling to foam as much of the city as you can while avoiding your opponents traps and weapons.

Use foam to build terrain, creating slippery surfaces to surf around the arena at high speed, help defend from enemy attacks, or create vantage points to take out opponents.

And most importantly, to foam up the opposition!

games.title: Foamstars: Season 1
games.description:
Season One: Starry Pop
The first Season runs between Tuesday February 6, 2024, and Friday March 8, 2024. During that time, you’ll be able to take part in seasonal events where you’ll compete for rankings and enjoy different game modes!

games.title: Fobia: St. Dinfna Hotel
games.description: Fobia: St. Dinfna Hotel is a first-person psychological horror indie game focused on environment exploration, survival and puzzles solving, developed by the Brazilian studio Pulsatrix Studios.

games.title: Focus on You
games.description: The love at first sight, came like a sunny summer day. Meet YUA and make your own sparkling moments.

games.title: Folk Hero
games.description: Folk Hero is an action-slasher with rogue-lite elements set in the world of Slavic fantasy. Explore the ever-changing island, find treasures, combine weapons and artifacts to defeat mythical enemies. Challenge your skills! One life, one attempt.

games.title: Folly Of The Wizards
games.description: Folly Of The Wizards is a comedic 2D roguelike action game that puts you in the shoes of a clumsy wizard apprentice. Join a wacky wizard cult and use unique spells to defeat enemies, explore procedurally generated dungeons, and save the world from chaos.

games.title: Food Boy
games.description: Food Boy is a wholesome pizza delivery arcade game that everyone can play! Ride your bike through different streets, try to keep balance, and avoid obstacles to make more deliveries and get the highest scores.

games.title: Food Truck Kingdom
games.description: Are you ready to cook your way through time and prove your culinary mastery?

games.title: Food Truck Simulator
games.description: Renovate, equip and restore the shine of the food truck that belonged to your father. Create recipes, cook the food and serve customers across an entire city. Customize and upgrade your food truck to reach more customers and expand your menu.

games.title: Food Truck Tycoon
games.description: Test your skills and talent as owner of a busy food truck!

games.title: Fool's Pub
games.category: Simulator, Strategy, Indie, Card & Board Game
games.description:
Welcome to Fool’s Pub - The Online Multiplayer Card Game.

This isn’t just a card game – it’s an online multiplayer battle where up to four players compete in a high-stakes game of skill, luck, and survival. Outplay your friends or strangers from around the world and prove you’ve got what it takes to be the last one standing.

- First-Person Fun: Experience the game through the eyes of your character, bringing you closer to the action with every draw, bluff, and shot fired.
- Play Your Way: Jump online to challenge others or enjoy offline mode with clever AI opponents when you’re flying solo.
- Cute and Dangerous: Meet adorable characters packing serious heat – their charm hides a fierce determination to win at any cost.
- Rough Rules, Wild Rounds: With Russian roulette-style mechanics, every turn could spell glory or disaster. Will you take the risk or play it safe?
- Only One Wins: In this pub, there’s no second place. Outwit, outplay, and outlast everyone else to claim the ultimate victory.

Get ready for the perfect mix of strategy, adrenaline, and chaos.
Fool’s Pub is calling – are you brave enough to answer?

games.title: Foot Clinic
games.description:
Step into the shoes of a doctor and podiatrist as you indulge in the foot clinic experience. Scrub, scrape, pluck, and pull all kinds of feet.

Perform foot treatments for conditions like calluses, corns and ingrown toenails. Each patient presents a new problem, so you'll never get bored of your work!

games.title: Foot Step
games.description: Foot Step is a game in which you need to control a little man and dodge kicks. When it comes into contact with cells, the foot will destroy them underneath it, but if the foot collides with a round object, the foot will not be able to break through it and will stop on this line, turning the round object into a regular cell. The goal of the game is to advance gradually without getting kicked or falling onto the spikes below.

games.title: Football 2024 Journey
games.description: Tile matching game

games.title: Football 26 League Superstar
games.description:
Football 26 League Superstar invites you into the heart of modern football — where ambition, strategy, and skill decide who becomes a legend.
Start your journey as a hungry newcomer with a modest squad and limited resources. Every match is a step forward, every decision matters. Train harder, think smarter, and climb from local victories to the grandest stage of world football. Your ultimate dream? Lifting the World Cup and proving you belong among the elite.

games.title: Football 2: Breakthrough Gaming Arcade
games.description: A game in the "Breakthrough Gaming Arcade" series! This game's release is part of Breakthrough Gaming's "Bible Video Game Sundays"!

games.title: Football Cup 2022
games.description: Live and breathe the beautiful game recreated with unparalleled realism of futbol! Choose one of the favorites such as Argentina, Spain or Brazil, or help one of the outsiders achieve the first place. Train, develop yourself, come to the field, and be a soccer star! Once you try to play these soccer games 2022and you won’t stop, it’s all because of the real football game feeling. You will find not only classic soccer game but also many other futbol modes.

games.title: Football Game
games.description: You are Tommy. A local high school footballing hero, the town of East Bend is your playground. It's game night for the Purchase County Turbines and your sweetheart is waiting in the bleachers. Join Tommy for a night that you won't forget...

games.title: Football Heroes League
games.description: Football Heroes League is a high-octane multiplayer soccer game where superhuman abilities meet precise controls.

games.title: Football Story
games.description: Football Story is a multiplayer football game that pits full teams of players against one another. Each player controls their own character, instead of a full team. In Football Story, you step into the cleats of a player in a small neighborhood club.

games.title: Football Striker 2025
games.description:
From the creative minds behind Jumping Food Games comes the sequel to the most exciting soccer puzzle game of the year: Football Striker 2025!
Dive into the world of soccer with this sequel and experience 20 new football-related levels that will challenge your gray matter.

Over 20 tricky levels are waiting for you!

Get Football Striker 2025 now and become a legend on the virtual pitch!

games.title: Football, Tactics & Glory
games.description:
Football, Tactics & Glory is a football management game for strategy lovers.

Football, Tactics & Glory reinvents the basics of the football management genre, making it appealing to everyone, not just the most hardcore football management aficionados. The game skips the boring parts of football management games – all those endless tables, numbers, routine and micromanagement. But it is deep enough to keep players engrossed for hundreds of hours.

If you enjoy turn-based gameplay, strategy or tycoon games, you will love Football, Tactics & Glory.

games.title: Football: Breakthrough Gaming Arcade
games.description: You're the player and the manager of your moves on the field! It's a frenzy out there! Dash at sonic speed to the end zone and score as many touchdowns as possible!

games.title: For a Few Minutes
games.description: For a Few Minutes is an emotional visual novel that explores love, grief, and the fragile hope of moving forward.

games.title: For Honor
games.description: Enter the chaos of war as a bold Knight, a brutal Viking, or a deadly Samurai. Play the thrilling story campaign or fight in brutal PvP modes, all on new dedicated servers. Enjoy an evolved experience with 18 Heroes, 18 maps, new PvP and ranked modes, thousands of gear items, and more.

games.title: For Honor: Afeera Hero
games.description: Embody the Afeera, tactical geniuses of the battlefield. They can deftly dispatch an enemy with their mace and shield.

games.title: For Honor: Arakure - Hero
games.description:
The Arakure Hero offer includes:

- 1 New Hero: Arakure
- 1 Ornament
- 1 Elite Outfit
- 7-Day Champion Status (extra XP, extra loot, and more)
- 3 Scavenger Crates with random gear

Live by your own rules and rely on your instincts. Take on multiple opponents and fight dirty to steal another victory. Wielding tonfas, Arakure packs a punch. Her brazen personality brings a unique perspective to the Samurai faction and with weapons never seen before, she is not afraid to do what it takes to win a fight. Explosive, scrappy, Arakure will hit you where it hurts.

games.title: For Honor: Assassin's Creed Shadows Hero Skin Bundle
games.description:
Become Naoe the Swift and Yasuke the Brave from Assassin's Creed Shadows in this Hero Skin Bundle for Shinobi and Shugoki.
The Assassin's Creed Shadows Hero Skin Bundle offer includes:
1 Shinobi Hero Skin
1 Shugoki Hero Skin
14-Day Champion Status
6 Scavenger Crates
For all Heroes owned: Assassin's Creed Iga’s Furriest Illustrious Outfit

games.title: For Honor: Assassin's Creed Ultimate Hero Skin Bundle
games.description:
The Assassin's Creed Ultimate Hero Skin Bundle offer includes:
1 Peacekeeper Hero Skin
1 Shinobi Hero Skin
1 Shugoki Hero Skin
1 Berserker Hero Skin
28-Day Champion Status
12 Scavenger Crates
1 Execution for Peacekeeper
1 Execution for Shinobi
1 Execution for Shugoki
1 Execution for Berserker
For all Heroes owned: Assassin's Creed Iga's Furriest Illustrious Outfit

This Assassin's Creed Ultimate Hero Skin Bundle unlocks a Shinobi and Shugoki Hero Skin of Naoe the Swift and Yasuke the Brave from Assassin's Creed Shadows; a Berserker Hero Skin of Eivor Wolf-Kissed from Assassin’s Creed Valhalla; and a Peacekeeper Hero Skin of Ezio Auditore. The bundle also grants Iga’s Furriest, an Assassin's Creed Illustrious Outfit, to all Heroes owned.

games.title: For Honor: Black Prior Hero Skin
games.description:
Commander Ravier has been sent to Arabia to retrieve the sultana’s most guarded treasure. Steal the secrets of the Celestial Sphere and become the master of fate with the Commander Ravier Black Prior Hero Skin, a full body customization that transforms you into Heathmoor’s most merciless Black Prior.

The Commander Ravier Black Prior Hero Skin offer includes:

One Black Prior Hero Skin
Seven-Day Champion Status
Three Scavenger Crates

games.title: For Honor: Complete Edition
games.description:
This compilation of the For Honor games contains:

- For Honor
- For Honor: Marching Fire Expansion
- For Honor: Year 1 - Heroes Bundle
- For Honor: Year 3 Pass

games.title: For Honor: Deluxe Edition
games.category: Strategy, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description:
This version contains:

- For Honor
- Digital Deluxe Bundle

games.title: For Honor: Eivor Wolf-Kissed – Berserker Hero Skin
games.description:
Unleash your fury with Eivor Wolf-Kissed, the Assassin from the Raven Clan Vikings in the world of For Honor. The Berserker Hero Skin is completely tailored from the ground up with authentic sound design.
The Eivor Wolf-Kissed Hero Skin offer includes:
1 Berserker Hero Skin
7-Day Champion Status
3 Scavenger Crates

games.title: For Honor: Ezio Auditore – Peacekeeper Hero Skin
games.description: Embody Ezio Auditore, the iconic Assassin from Renaissance Italy, in the world of For Honor.

games.title: For Honor: General Zhi - Zhanhu Hero Skin
games.description:
With the new Zhanhu Hero Skin, embody the Wu Lin's most tactical and treacherous sword arm. General Zhi is the wielder of the Starfall Sword, a ceremonial blade said to be forged from a comet and gifted to enemies as a token of peace. Zhi now gifts it to Astrea to forge an alliance. But few can say whether he offers his sword in peace or in blood. Scheming and deadly, General Zhi is always ten steps ahead in a game his enemies do not even know they're playing.

The Hero Skin of General Zhi offer includes:
1 Zhanhu Hero Skin
7-Day Champion Status
3 Scavenger Crates

games.title: For Honor: Gold Edition
games.description:
This version contains:

- For Honor
- Digital Deluxe Bundle
- Season Pass

games.title: For Honor: Gold Heroes Pack
games.description: Unlock additional heroes with the Gold Heroes Pack! This pack includes six additional heroes with unique playstyles.

games.title: For Honor: Gryphon Hero
games.description: A well-known veteran has returned! Wield the mighty Bardiche as Gryphon, a new playable hero.

games.title: For Honor: Gudmundr the Great - Warlord Hero Skin
games.description:
Unleash the indomitable shield of Svengård and the legendary sword of Gudmundr the Great with the brand-new Hero Skin for the Warlord. Gudmundr the Great is the esteemed Viking Jarl who valiantly defended Svengård during the fierce assault by the Blackstone Legion. Revered as a legend among his people, Gudmundr the Great has led his warriors to countless victories through his unmatched skill and strategic genius. His fierce passion for battle is equaled only by his unwavering dedication and loyalty to his Viking brothers and sisters. Embrace the strength and spirit of Gudmundr the Great and lead your warriors to triumph.

The Hero Skin of Gudmundr the Great offer includes:
1 Warlord Hero Skin
7-Day Champion Status
3 Scavenger Crates

games.title: For Honor: Highlander Hero Skin - Oathbreaker Maddox
games.description: Become a treacherous survivor with the Oathbreaker Maddox Hero Skin, a full body customization of the Highlander.

games.title: For Honor: Juren - Hero
games.description:
Embody the chaotic nature of our new Wu Lin hero, Juren. Victory comes at any cost – betrayal is always an option. Relentless in the storm of war, Juren will pursue his own goals above all else. Wielding a Fang Tian Hua Ji halberd, Juren's arsenal of attacks is overwhelming and unpredictable.
Includes:
1 New Hero: Juren
1 Ornament
1 Elite Outfit
7-Day Champion Status (extra XP, extra loot, and more)
3 Scavenger Crates with random gear

games.title: For Honor: Khatun - Hero
games.description:
Enact bloody wrath with your Turco-Mongol sabers and instill fear in your enemies.

The Khatun Hero offer includes:
1 New Hero: Khatun
1 Ornament
1 Elite Outfit
7-Day Champion Status (Extra XP, Extra Loot, and More)
3 Scavenger Crates with Random Gear

games.title: For Honor: Kyoshin Hero
games.description: Become a Kyoshin, a mystical Samurai whose elegance and prowess will leave everyone in awe on the battlefield.

games.title: For Honor: Lady Saori – Nobushi Hero Skin
games.description:
When the lord of Castle Chiyo is away, his enemies strike in the dead of night. The protection of the people then falls to his wife, Lady Saori, who takes up arms to defend the castle. Outnumbered and desperate, she faces unimaginable loss, the death of her people, and the destruction of her family home – her legacy. Broken, furious, and ridden with guilt, the weight of her failure takes hold of her, a darkness emerging from the inside. She loses herself. And she will become something more. Something terrifying.

Unlock the Lady Saori skin now and fight with the fury of a lone guardian.

The Hero Skin of Lady Saori offer includes:

1 Nobushi Hero Skin
7-Day Champion Status
3 Scavenger Crates

games.title: For Honor: Liana the Pale
games.description: Join the cursed Dragomir family and become Liana the Pale to inspire bloodcurdling nightmares on the battlefield.

games.title: For Honor: Marching Fire Edition
games.category: Fighting, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description: This compilation of the For Honor games contains the base game For Honor as well as the For Honor: Marching Fire Expansion.

games.title: For Honor: Marching Fire Expansion Pack
games.description: The Wu Lin Faction is coming! Expand your world with 4 new Heroes instantly- the Tiandi, the Shaolin, the Jiang Jun and the Nuxia. Also get Day 1 access to the new Acade Mode, an endless PVE experience playable solo or co-op with a friend.

games.title: For Honor: Master Katashi - Orochi Hero Skin
games.description: Be Master Katashi and protect the Seion Bridge with a legendary katana fabled to contain the strength of an entire army.

games.title: For Honor: Medjay Hero
games.description: Free Heathmoor from the curse unleashed by Bolthorn with the help of the first Egyptian hero in For Honor, the Medjay.

games.title: For Honor: Monkey King Hero
games.description: Become a warrior of legend with the Hero Skin of Monkey King Wukong, a full body customization of the Shaolin.

games.title: For Honor: Naoe the Swift – Shinobi Hero Skin
games.description:
Become Naoe the Swift, the iconic Assassin from Iga Province, in the world of For Honor. This Shinobi Hero Skin is completely tailored from the ground up, with the original Japanese voice actor and authentic sound design.
The Naoe the Swift Hero Skin offer includes:
1 Shinobi Hero Skin
7-Day Champion Status
3 Scavenger Crates

games.title: For Honor: Ocelotl Hero
games.description:
Stalk opponents, and when the time is right, strike them with overwhelming ferocity.

The Ocelotl Hero offer includes:

One New Hero: Ocelotl
One Ornament
One Elite Outfit
Seven-Day Champion Status (Extra XP, Extra Loot, and More)
Three Scavenger Crates with Random Gear

games.title: For Honor: Pirate Hero
games.description: Bold, passionate, and the captain, the Pirate hero is coming to Heathmoor this season seeking lost treasures and relics.

games.title: For Honor: Prince Yi – Tiandi Hero Skin
games.description: Prince Yi, a philosopher-warrior, follows a righteous path and defends the Wu Lin legacy against Zhi's twisted peace.

games.title: For Honor: Queen Kalliopi Gladiator Hero Skin
games.description:
Kalliopi’s past remains shrouded in mystery. What is known is that her tribe fell to the relentless conquest of Guljin, leaving her a prisoner of the Khatun. But Kalliopi’s story didn’t end in chains—it began anew. Faced with impossible odds, Kalliopi rose to the challenge. Her unmatched skill, unyielding determination, and magnetic presence have made her the star of Guljin’s bloody spectacles. To Kalliopi, the arena is no longer a cage; it is her kingdom. She has embraced her role fully, wielding her growing fame as both armor and purpose in a life reshaped by the Khatun’s victory.

The Hero Skin of Queen Kalliopi offer includes:

1 Gladiator Hero Skin

7-Day Champion Status

3 Scavenger Crates

games.title: For Honor: Season 10 - Sakura
games.description: A series of chilling incidents has plagued the Myre, and many believe they all began with Sakura, an infamous Hitokiri. Years ago, the Samurai executioner was taskedto sentence a peasant fisherman who had committed an odious crime. As Sakura rose her axe to deliver justice, she fell into a trance and slaughtered every living soul in the village. Many years have passed, and yet Kaidan is still rumored to be haunted by Sakura's victims. Some unfortunate warriors recently fought in the abandoned village, but only a few lived to tell the tale. They have seen things most people would not believe…

games.title: For Honor: Season 11 - Hulda
games.description: The darkest cults always creep back to the surface in times of despair and self-doubt. As the Knights marched on Valkenheim and conquered most of the North, the Vikings began to lose hope and turned to the Jormungandr for help. The Viking sectarians began to spread their ominous beliefs and crushed the weak in the name of their god, the Great Serpent. The legendary Hulda rose as a new leader among the Northerners and fought the bloodiest battles in Viking history to reclaim Valkenheim.

games.title: For Honor: Season 12 - Sun Da
games.description: After a massive sandstorm wrecked most of the Wu Lin territories, many fled west and sought refuge in Heathmoor, while others stayed behind with the Emperor to rebuild an army. Among them, Sun Da, leader of the Zhanhu, found new ways to use fire in his laboratory at Qiang Pass. As he tried to increase the Wu Lin arsenal, an unexpected enemy got wind of his discoveries and attacked the fortress...

games.title: For Honor: Season 13 - Hope
games.description: After so many signs, all believed the end of times was nigh. Yet the earth quietened down without warning, the skies cleared and a new dawn came. At long last, warriors felt hope and remembered those who once fought for peace. For the first time in history, the leaders of all factions gathered and agreed to cease their quarrel for a brief moment. They signed what was called the Truce of Wyverndale.

games.title: For Honor: Season 14 - Tyranny
games.description:
A genuine feeling of hope grew in everyone’s heart as the Truce of Wyverndale convinced more and more people across Heathmoor. Yet a sinister threat was also brewing. As the celebrations of the Honor Games continued with a reenactment of past battles against Apollyon and the Blackstones, a group of mysterious warriors geared up and gathered secret allies from all factions. Peace would soon become a distant dream...

In one of For Honor's most ambitious season's ever, Tyranny brings much anticipated updates from the community with fight updates, events, new customization, a new battle pass and a new Hero that will reveal themself amidst the season.

games.title: For Honor: Season 15 - Resistance
games.description:
The Order of Horkos imposed a regime of terror and left many scars around the world. But in the most desperate times, a spark of rebellion is all they needed to bring back hope. As the warriors of Horkos seized several fortresses to conduct experiments with the Corruption, various groups of outcasts and mercenaries from all factions took up arms to reclaim their homes. Unexpected alliances were formed, and new Draconite weaponry was invented to fight the enemy back.

Play your part for the resistance and get access to new armor, weapons, events, battle pass and more!

games.title: For Honor: Season 16 - Mayhem
games.description:
With the help of Ilma, a legendary Blacksmith, many warriors across Heathmoor were able to regain fortresses and discover some of the Draconite's true powers. Yet all these rebellions needed someone to unite them in this pivotal moment. Someone who knew the enemy better than anyone else, because he was once part of them. Someone who had learned from his past mistakes and was now ready to make things right.

After a failed attempt at bringing peace in Heathmoor, the one who was once called Holden Cross was now simply known as 'Gryphon'. He had forgone his former name and faction years ago. He became a mercenary to fight for those who could not bear the toll of war anymore, no matter which faction they belonged to. Under his guidance, rebels from all factions formed the Chimera Alliance, a full-blown army with the means to defy the Order of Horkos and stop their Corruption.

games.title: For Honor: Season 17 - Asunder
games.description:
After the Battle of the Eclipse, the Chimera Alliance and Order of Horkos fought relentlessly for years. As Heathmoor's population declined, people everywhere began to make 'Covenants', secret pacts to share intel and resources, with either Horkos or Chimera warriors. Covenants could be used to gain allies outside their faction, while rooting out the evil among their own. Sealing a Covenant was also a symbolic way to make a statement about the future. Would someone embrace the warmongering views of the Horkos, following strict codes and rituals to keep the strongest in their rightful place? Or would they rather fight for Chimera's ideals of solidarity and peace?

Experience how Heathmoor is now torn asunder between the Order of Horkos and the Chimera Alliance. Get access to new armor variations, weapons, events, battle pass and more!

games.title: For Honor: Season 18 - Mirage
games.description:
Warriors everywhere sealed new alliances through the Covenants, but another great enemy was about to challenge their renewed vigor. This new threat was not just another clan or army trying to reap more territories. After centuries of being spoiled and exhausted by humanity's thirst for power, Mother Nature herself was about to show the true extent of her burning wrath. An intense drought befell Heathmoor, endangering crops and fortifications everywhere. While the Horkos saw the calamity as another opportunity to prove their might, the Chimera struggled to maintain solidarity among their ranks, with less resources to share between themselves.

A new battle for water began. Warriors kept fighting, but also struggled to survive the scorching heat. As some battled in a secluded temple, strange visions followed their every step...

games.title: For Honor: Season 19 - Tempest
games.description: Year of the Covenants: Season 3, named "Tempest," is the nineteenth season of the ongoing Faction War. Warriors prayed for an answer for their parched throats during the drought... and it was answered. But, the answer these warriors received from their gods was much more than simple rain, but a roaring storm, ready to wipe all who remained unprepared.

games.title: For Honor: Season 2 - Shadow and Might
games.description: Shadow and Might has been unleashed! The Faction War is heating up with two new Heroes, two new free Maps, more Territories, New Gear and more new content!

games.title: For Honor: Season 20 - Frozen Shores
games.description:
The rise of the waters during the Tempest and the subsequent winter allowed seafaring pirates passage to the frozen shores of Heathmoor. These pirates had no allegiance to any faction – they only cared about treasure. In their pursuit of wealth, they began trading with the people, offering warriors access to new weapons from across the sea.

Take your character through a journey of 100 Tiers of rewards for all heroes! Available during For Honor: Frozen Shores only.

games.title: For Honor: Season 21 - Golden Age
games.description:
New visitors from far away have unveiled the lost reliquary of Wyverndale. Now, treasures long forgotten have been made available to warriors once more. From the ancient past of Heathmoor comes old weapons that once again glisten in the light of day. Arm yourself with the blades of Heathmoor’s original warriors, and fight like the forebears of old.

Take your character on a quest back to the Golden Age with 100 Tiers of rewards for all heroes! Available during For Honor: Golden Age only.

games.title: For Honor: Season 22 - Curse of the Scarab
games.description: Includes Testing Grounds, Justice of Pharaohs (Seasonal Event), Bolthorn's Curse Raider Skin, New Seasonal Customization and a new Battle Pass.

games.title: For Honor: Season 23 - The Demon Dagger
games.description: Includes Testing Grounds TU2, Web of the Jorogumo (Halloween Event), Kensei Hero Skin, the Yokai Nightmare (Seasonal Event), Cross play phase 2, New Seasonal Customization and a new Battle Pass.

games.title: For Honor: Season 3 - Grudge & Glory
games.description: Grudge & Glory has been unleashed! The Faction War has been updated, two new Heroes and two new free Maps have been added along with more Territories, New Gear, more new content and a new duel tournament competitive feature around the corner.

games.title: For Honor: Season 4 - Order & Havoc
games.description: This season, get ready for two new Heroes, two new free Maps, new gear and a brand new game mode just around the corner!

games.title: For Honor: Season 5 - Age of Wolves
games.description: Age of Wolves celebrates the one year anniversary since the launch of For Honor. This season will focus on gameplay and stability with major hero updates, global fight changes, new training features and the long awaited arrival of dedicated servers.

games.title: For Honor: Season 6 - Hero's March
games.description: As heroes of every faction march on the battlefield, they celebrate the myths and legends that shaped their history. Remembering heroes from the past, they honor the present and prepare to face the future.

games.title: For Honor: Season 7 - Storm and Fury
games.description: Dark clouds gather – volcanoes rumble. The Gods have stirred. Now the factions look to each other for blame. It’s a clash of passions and rage as each faction turns on each other trying to lay blame and make sense of the changes.

games.title: For Honor: Season 8 - Marching Fire
games.description: For Honor’s biggest and most ambitious update ever is coming October 16, 2018. With a new faction, 4 new heroes, a new 4x4 mode, significant visual enhancements and unlimited single player and 2-person co-op PVE mode yet to be revealed, Marching Fire expands the world of For Honor like never before.

games.title: For Honor: Season 9 - Vortiger
games.description: Mt. Ignis’ eruption sent shockwaves through the lands. From out of this chaos rises a dark sect long forgotten. The Black Priors were once dark warriors of Apollyon and the Blackstone Legion. After the collapse of the Blackstone, the Black Priors disappeared. Some say they were wiped out, others say they fled the lands. But now, as new chaos shakes the lands, the Black Priors re-emerge. Led by their grim leader, Vortiger, these warriors, unbound by chivalry, promise victory to the Knights...by any means necessary.

games.title: For Honor: Sohei - Hero
games.description:
Sohei are warrior monks who wield seven weapons. Under the tutelage of Oniwaka and Master Katashi, Sohei attain spiritual and martial mastery deep in a Myre monastery. To earn the name Sohei, they must train with a single weapon for years before being allowed to move on to the next.

Often arrogant, the Sohei deeply respect the rare worthy opponent. To have your weapon chosen by a Sohei is the highest honor, for they believe the blade contains the soul of the Samurai. Warriors’ souls thus live on in battle. These collections make the Sohei, quite literally, armies of one.

The Sohei Hero offer includes:
One New Hero: Sohei

One Ornament

One Elite Outfit

Seven-Day Champion Status (Extra XP, Extra Loot, and More)

Three Scavenger Crates with Random Gear

games.title: For Honor: The Crucible Lord – Centurion Hero Skin
games.description:
The Crucible Lord is a Hero Skin for the Centurion, inspired by Destiny 2. The skin features gear provided by a machine entity known as Ghost. The Centurion is depicted as a Guardian selected to combat the threat of Dark Ether and the undead Scorn it creates.

The design incorporates elements associated with the Light, framing the Crucible Lord as a combatant in an ongoing conflict involving interdimensional forces.

This Hero Skin offer includes:
1 Centurion Hero Skin
7-Day Champion Status
3 Scavenger Crates

games.title: For Honor: The Nightstalker
games.description: Satiate your thirst for blood by incarnating the cursed Lord Dragomir the Nightstalker, and use his monstrous features.

games.title: For Honor: The Oni's Hunt Deluxe - Hero Skin Bundle
games.description:
The Oni's Hunt Deluxe Hero Skin Bundle offer includes:

1 Sohei Hero
1 Sohei Hero Skin
1 Emote inspired by Dead by Daylight for all heroes
1 Execution inspired by Dead by Daylight for all heroes
1 Mythic Outfit inspired by Dead by Daylight for all heroes
14-Day Champion Status
6 Scavenger Crates

Unlock the Sohei Hero and turn into The Oni's Wrath, the full‑body Hero Skin of a monstrous executioner. Dominate with the emote, execution, and Mythic Outfit inspired by Dead by Daylight: special time-limited content from Survivors of the Fog, now for all your heroes!

Inspired by Dead by Daylight.

games.title: For Honor: The Oni's Wrath – Sohei Hero Skin
games.description:
Wear the fearsome Oni Mask and transform your Sohei into The Oni's Wrath, a full‑body Hero Skin that turns your warrior into a relentless, monstrous executioner. Dominate the battlefield with terrifying style and let your enemies witness true fury.
The Oni's Wrath Hero Skin offer includes:
1 Sohei Hero Skin
7-Day Champion Status
3 Scavenger Crates

games.title: For Honor: The Scorching Herald – Gryphon Legendary Hero Skin
games.description:
Get the Gryphon Hero and the Scorching Herald Hero Skin in the Tales of Gryphon Bundle. Guljin and her Khatuns have imposed a stifling peace on Heathmoor, yet Gryphon remains defiant. Taking on the mantle of the Scorching Herald, clad in fiery griffin-shaped armor, he roams the land. To whoever will listen he shares high tales of legendary warriors, appearing as myths in the Arena of Echoes. As glory spreads, so does unrest, and the cycle of war stirs once more.
The Tales of Gryphon offer includes:
1 Gryphon Hero
1 Gryphon Legendary Hero Skin

games.title: For Honor: The Unsung Knight - Warden Hero Skin
games.description:
The Unsung Knight’s identity is a mystery. When she was a child, a noble Knight took her on as a squire. He trained her to become a Warden, a paragon of hope and strength, entrusting her with Valor’s Edge, an ancient sword dating back to the days long before the Cataclysm. With the sword in her grasp, The Unsung Knight now travels the wastelands, helping those in need. Dedicated to the protection of the weak, she will not hesitate to fight any and all invaders who would take valuable resources from her people.

The Unsung Knight Warden Hero Skin offer includes:
- One Warden Hero Skin
- Seven-Day Champion Status
- Three Scavenger Crates

games.title: For Honor: The Violet King - Lawbringer Hero Skin
games.description:
The Violet King is a Hero Skin for the Lawbringer, inspired by Destiny 2. The design features spiked armor associated with a machine entity referred to as Ghost. The character is equipped to confront the effects of Dark Ether and the undead Scorn forces it influences.

The Violet King is positioned as a figure aligned with the power of Light, resisting external threats originating beyond Heathmoor.

This Hero Skin offer includes:

1 Lawbringer Hero Skin
7-Day Champion Status
3 Scavenger Crates

games.title: For Honor: The Warrior Prince - Aramusha Hero Skin
games.description:
Wind back time and embrace your destiny as The Warrior Prince, a new hero skin for the Aramusha, inspired by Prince of Persia: Warrior Within. The legendary Sands of Time reshape Heathmoor as the wandering Prince returns, armed with deadly blades and an unyielding will. Carve your legend before time runs out!

Step into battle with the fierce elegance of a warrior forged by the trials of time. With steel in hand and destiny in his grasp, he carves his own legend, defying the chains of fate. Will you embrace the path of the tormented Prince, or be lost to the flow of time?

The Warrior Prince Aramusha Hero Skin offer includes:
1 Aramusha Hero Skin
7-Day Champion Status
3 Scavenger Crates with random gear

games.title: For Honor: Ultimate Bloodcurse Bundle
games.description: Unlock two legendary Hero Skins, included with Executions, Mythic Outfits, and more, for all your heroes!

games.title: For Honor: Ultimate Edition
games.description:
Choose the Ultimate Edition which includes 12 additional heroes with unique playstyles to get the best experience in For Honor!

The Ultimate Edition includes 12 additional heroes with unique playstyles:
- Centurion – a Knight fighting with his gladius.
- Gladiator – a Knight fighting with his trident and buckler.
- Highlander – a Viking fighting with his claymore.
- Shaman – a Viking fighting with her hatchet and dagger.
- Shinobi – a Samurai fighting with his kusarigama.
- Aramusha – a Samurai fighting with his dual katana.
- Jiang Jun – a Wu Lin fighting with his guandao.
- Shaolin – a Wu Lin fighting with his staff.
- Zhanhu – a Wu Lin fighting with his changdao.
- Black Prior – a Knight fighting with his arming sword and kite shield.
- Jormungandr – a Viking fighting with his war hammer.
- Hitokiri – a Samurai fighting with his masakari axe.

games.title: For Honor: Ultimate Heroes Pack
games.description: Unlock additional heroes with the Ultimate Heroes Pack! This pack includes six additional heroes with unique playstyles.

games.title: For Honor: Violet King & Crucible Lord - Hero Skin Bundle
games.description:
Give your homeworld its best chance of survival as The Crucible Lord and The Violet King, new Hero Skins for the Centurion and Lawbringer inspired by Destiny 2. These two heroes have been chosen by a mysterious machine known as Ghost, which has clad them in otherwordly gear.

Fighting side by side, these two Guardians of Heathmoor wield their new gifts to take on the monstrous Scorn – and the dread Scorn Baron that brings the minions back from the dead. Transmat into battle and strike back against Dark Ether.

The For Honor x Destiny 2 Hero Skin Bundle includes:
1 Centurion Hero Skin
1 Lawbringer Hero Skin
14-Day Champion Status
6 Scavenger Crates

games.title: For Honor: Virtuosa - Hero
games.description:
Pursue perfection with our new Outlander hero, Virtuosa, and master the art of the blade. Outsmart foes with flawless fencing technique and evade attacks with a smile!

The Virtuosa Hero offer includes:
1 New Hero: Virtuosa
1 Ornament
1 Elite Outfit
7-Day Champion Status (extra XP, extra loot, and more)
3 Scavenger Crates with random gear

games.title: For Honor: Warmonger Hero
games.description: Prey on the weak as a Warmonger, new playable Hero. Strike and impale with the Flamberge, a legendary two-handed sword!

games.title: For Honor: Yasuke the Brave – Shugoki Hero Skin
games.description: Strike your foes with the strength of the powerful samurai, Yasuke the Brave, in the world of For Honor.

games.title: For Honor: Yokai Banishers - Hero Skin Bundle
games.description:
Unlock two Hero Skins bound by fate across the centuries, facing the same mortal dilemma and demonic peril.

The Yokai Banishers Hero Skin Bundle offer includes:
1 Orochi Hero Skin
1 Kensei Hero Skin
14-Day Champion Status
6 Scavenger Crates

games.title: For Honor: Yoshiro the Damned - Orochi Hero Skin
games.description:
Embody Yoshiro the Damned, who had to turn himself into a disfigured monster to save his village from an evil spirit.

The Hero Skin of Yoshiro the Damned offer includes:
1 Orochi Hero Skin
7-Day Champion Status
3 Scavenger Crates

games.title: For Luna the Bell Tolls
games.description: A chime heard once in five years. A past that never left.

games.title: For the King
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Adventure, Indie, Card & Board Game
games.description: For The King is a turn based roguelike, RPG that can be played solo or cooperatively online and features strategic adventuring, turn based combat, and persistent choices. Players must survive cunning enemies and creatures, wicked weather and brutal traps in their quest to solve the mysterious death of the king and bring order to the land.

games.title: For the King II
games.description: Battle against Fahrul's tyrannical Queen alone or as a party of 4 players in the sequel to For The King, the massively popular turn-based roguelike tabletop RPG. Level up and explore as you unravel the once beloved Queen's terrible secret.

games.title: For the Warp
games.category: Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Adventure, Indie, Card & Board Game
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilding game in space! Explore randomly generated systems, enemies and strange encounters. Build your deck, survive and reach For The Warp gate!

games.title: Forager
games.category: Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Adventure, Indie
games.description:
Forager is the popular crafting, exploration and base building game that can best be defined as “the idle game that you want to actively keep playing”.

A quirky mix between old school 2D Zelda experiences and modern Minecraft or Terraria-like crafting games that places players into a small piece of land with just a pickaxe and a desire for expansion and exploration.

Players can buy procedurally generated lands to uncover secrets, solve puzzles, find dungeons, treasure and forgotten relics and to expand their sprawling bases. Nearly impossible to put down, there is always something to manage or work towards!

games.title: Forbidden Forgiveness
games.description:
"Forbidden Forgiveness is a First Person Psychological Horror game that aims to play with your mind. 
 
the story depends on multiple dimensions where you’ll be able to travel between them at anytime and what you’ll do in these dimensions will effect the story and the gameplay, the game is heavily depends on multiple Endings. 
 
You’ll need to know who’s good and who’s bad not just because they’re doing things you don’t like, it means they’re Bad. 
 
And you’re not defenseless you can defend yourself from the Unknown but sometimes you can’t, so you’ll have to run, the game contains a unique puzzles with a new way to solve and they are not easy nor impossible but expect some challenge, there are Boss Fights but they are not just having more guns, ammo and health packs to kill them, you’ll need to solve a puzzle or do something to be able to damage\kill them."

games.title: Forced
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure, Indie
games.description: Players are cast as slaves in a fantasy gladiator arena, condemned to fight as gladiators to win their freedom. With the help of Balfus, a Spirit Mentor, they are able to fight their way through the challenges and Guardians at the end of each area and gain freedom for them and their kin.

games.title: Foreclosed
games.description: Foreclosed is a Cyberpunk action-shooter set in a comic book world. Follow the events of Evan Kapnos in this original comic book styled game and discover how losing your identity is all too possible.

games.title: Foregone
games.description: Foregone is a fast and fluid 2D action-platformer packed with legendary loot and stunning pixel art. Collect an arsenal of powerful weapons and unravel a compelling story of regret and conspiracy as you slice your way through hordes of enemies to save Calagan. Available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, XboxOne and PC.

games.title: Forest Cafe
games.description: It's time to take care of cute animals and build a cozy cafe for them in a forest clearing. Get everything ready for the reception. Add various tasty dishes and drinks to the menu.

games.title: Forest Camp Story
games.description: The great outdoors are calling! Create and run your own campground in this business management sim. Get a lay of the land and find the best places to camp. Before you know it, customers will be setting up tents and taking pictures, making memories that will last a lifetime. But it's not all about peace and solitude. With activities like bird watching, fly fishing, and horse riding, there's no shortage of ways to show your campers a good time! No camping experience? No problem! Set up guided tours to show new campers the ropes, and they'll soon be coming back for more. If you play your cards right, you might get visits from rabbits, squirrels, and other cute critters too! Don't be afraid to branch out and grow your business. Set up a camping goods store in nearby towns to earn extra cash and attract new customers. Get more people interested in your wares, and you might just spark a nationwide camping craze... Answer the call of the wild and start creating the camp of your dreams!

games.title: Forest Golf Planner
games.description: Create and customize your own golf course in this charming management sim.

games.title: Forest Grove
games.description: A teenage heiress has gone missing. Foul play is suspected. Uncover a cast of characters, collect evidence, and find the truth in this futuristic detective game!

games.title: Forest of Deceit
games.description: Forest of Deceit is a 4-8 player social deduction game where you use your phones to play!

games.title: Forest Of Terenu
games.description:
Enter the Forest of Terenu, a mysterious, otherworldly realm steeped in sorrow, memory, and the remnants of lost souls. In this gripping visual novel, you become Ellis, a 17-year-old girl searching for her missing brother, guided only by a flickering flame and the distant echoes of the past.

After falling asleep one night and awakening in a dreamlike yet menacing forest, Ellis finds herself trapped in a realm where light has faded and grief has taken root. The only constant is a strange glowing orb—her only source of light, and perhaps, her only ally.

As Ellis ventures deeper into the shadows of Terenu, she meets peculiar spirits and lost wanderers, each bearing pieces of a much larger puzzle: a tragedy buried in time and a curse that binds them all. Some want to help, others deceive. But all are haunted.
And Ellis is no exception.

Will you uncover the truth hidden beneath the trees—or be consumed by the darkness yourself?

games.title: Forestry 2017 - The Simulation
games.description: Forestry 2017 – This Simulation takes you to the forest! Take over the tasks of a professional woodcutter and enjoy working in the woods. Control huge machinery, fell the trees, arrange the timber and comb through your wood. Sell the wood, several products and earn money to expand your company.

games.title: Forests, Fields and Fortresses
games.description:
Forests, Fields and Fortresses - is a mix of a puzzle and a board game in which you have to build your kingdom.

In the Puzzle Mode, play handcrafted levels with a small number of pieces of territory. Your goal is to place them in such a way as to earn the required amount of gold.

In the Adventure Mode, start the game with a random map and an endless supply of pieces of territory.

games.title: Forgive Me Father
games.description: A dark retro horror FPS set in a comic book style world inspired by the novels of H.P. Lovecraft. As the only one with full senses, you begin a journey in search for answers and relief. How long can you last?

games.title: Forgiveness RPG: The First Chapter - Part One
Forgiveness RPG: The First Chapter - Part Three
Forgiveness RPG: The First Chapter - Part Two
Forgotten Fields
games.description: Forgotten Fields is a game about a struggling author who travels back to his childhood home one last time before it's sold off. Visit old friends, relive memories and experience bursts of inspiration in this nostalgic game about the passage of time.

games.title: Forgotten Hill Disillusion
games.description: Welcome to Forgotten Hill Museum, a place where the past, the present, nature, art and the unknown are exhibited!

games.title: Forgotton Anne
games.description:
Forgotton Anne is a 2d cinematic adventure game combining puzzle platforming with adventure game elements. You play as Anne, the enforcer keeping order in the Forgotton Realm, as she sets out to squash a rebellion that might prevent her master, Bonku, and herself from returning to the human world.

The World of Forgotton Anne: Imagine a place where everything that is lost and forgotten goes; old toys, letters, single socks. The Forgotten Realm is a magical world inhabited by Forgotlings, creatures composed of mislaid objects longing to be remembered again.

games.title: Forklift 2024: The Simulation
games.description: Get ready to take on the ultimate forklift simulation experience with Forklift 2024 - The Simulation! Operate your very own forklift and complete randomly generated orders to earn money and expand your warehouse. With a variety of goods to handle and increasing complexity as you progress, this game will keep you on your toes!

games.title: Forklift 2025 Simulator
games.description: Step into the driver’s seat of a powerful forklift and experience the true-to-life challenges of cargo handling. From carefully lifting pallets to stacking heavy loads at different heights, this simulator will test your precision, patience, and skill. Each mission brings new obstacles, requiring focus, balance, and accuracy to succeed.

games.title: Forklift Extreme: Deluxe Edition
games.description: An exceptional physical experience with unique visuals and super smooth, yet demanding gameplay

games.title: Forklift Simulator 2023
games.description: Start your job in this realistic forklift simulator. Experience realistic controls, intricate maneuvering, and precise cargo handling. Complete missions, master different forklift models, and prove your skills in this immersive simulation game.

games.title: Form
games.description: Enter a surreal adventure where puzzles are built from dreams and memories. Solve the mystery behind an ancient artifact. Advance through a world that transforms around you. Transcend this existence.

games.title: Forma.8
games.description:
Explore, fight and solve puzzles. Uncover the secrets of a mysterious alien planet in this open world metroidvania adventure, where nothing is what it seems…

Accidentally stranded during a crucial mission, the forma.8 probe will need to survive and accomplish the unthinkable. What really happened on this planet? Who, or what lived here? And when? What’s the secret behind its history? These are only but a handful of the questions in need of answers. Or else…everything will be lost.

The peculiar visual style, coupled with a deep lore and classic action-adventure mechanics makes forma.8 a unique experience, worth savoring and enjoy to the fullest.

games.title: Formula
games.description: FORMULA is a game in which you need to fly a ball and collect elements of the formula. After each collection, the shape of the curve of the field changes, along which you can move. Points are awarded after selecting each element of the formula. The game ends when the ball touches the walls of the narrowing field.

games.title: Formula Bit Racing DX
games.description: Formula Bit Racing DX is a fun arcade racing game, where each curve and lap recreate classic gameplay and offers you unbound speed limits of fun. Full throttle and enjoy!

games.title: Formula Legends
games.description: From the golden age to the modern era, race through time in Formula Legends. Master reimagined circuits, command legendary cars, and chase glory across decades of motorsport history. A love letter to Formula racing, where speed, skill, and strategy define the champion.

games.title: Formula Racing GP: Apex Overtaking
games.description: You don’t chase victory — you overtake it.

games.title: Formula Retro Racing
games.description: Formula Retro Racing is a retro style arcade racing game that’s influenced classic arcade racing games of the early 90’s.

games.title: Formula Retro Racing: World Tour
games.description: A retro racer updated for the modern age, rediscover nostalgic racing as you drive through iconic locations in Formula Retro Racing: World Tour. Fusing 90s-style arcade racing with realistic physics, split-screen multiplayer, and 60fps performance. With new tracks and car types!

games.title: Formula Retro Racing: World Tour - Special Edition
games.description:
Formula Retro Racing: World Tour - Special Edition includes:
- Base Game
- 2 Free Stickers
- 6 New Unique Tracks
- Reversed Track Variants
- Bonus Gameplay & UI Features

games.title: Formula Uno Racing
games.description: Race across a global lineup of high-speed circuits that evolve with the time of day. Tackle sharp turns under the morning sun, chase victory through glowing dusk, and dominate the track beneath dazzling night lights.

games.title: ForRace GT2D
games.description: Experience a realistic race that you have not experienced in 2D. In Forrace, you can race with hundreds of cars on dozens of tracks. You can earn money and trade cars.

games.title: Forrader Hero
games.description: Forrader Hero – turn-based roguelike dungeon crawler where heroes can’t step back and must fight through the end to save their soul in ‘Forgotten Proto.World’ fighting hordes of monsters, undead creatures, and their overlords.

games.title: Fort Boyard
games.description: Ever wanted to experience the Fort Boyard adventure with your friends? You will soon be able to make that dream a reality: set off on the journey together, from the comfort of your couch, in just a few weeks’ time! In single or multiplayer mode (up to 4 players), solve Sir Fouras’ tricky riddles, follow Passe-Partout through the mazes of the fort and take up the challenges to get the keys that will allow you to enter the treasure room.

games.title: Fort Boyard 2022
games.description: Cross the threshold of Fort Boyard and complete the challenges! Take up the challenge with more than 10 activities that combine Action and Party Games! Endurance, dexterity, and perseverance will be your best assets for collecting boyard coins.

games.title: Fort Boyard: Nouvelle Edition - Toujours Plus Fort
Fort Defense
games.description: All hands on deck! Pirate armada dead ahead! Take part in an uncompromising struggle repelling freebooters' assaults. Watch out, the enemy may catch the tide for ruining your fortress. Build towers, collect crystals, upgrade spells and believe in your victory!

games.title: Fort Defense: North Menace
games.description: Fort Defense is back with refined gameplay and more levels.

games.title: Fort Triumph
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Tactical, Indie
games.description: Fort Triumph is a tactical RPG emphasizing the use of Environmental Interactions to create rich, challenging and rewarding tactical gameplay. In the game, you command a party of chosen heroes who set out to change the world, one quest at a time. On your path you will explore the world, discover ancient secrets, and face down any enemy who stand in your path to glory through turn based tactical combat.

games.title: Fortnite
games.description: Fortnite is a free-to-play online game where you and your friends can create, play and battle. Be the last player standing in Battle Royale and Zero Build, experience a concert or live event, or discover over a million creator-made games, including racing, parkour, zombie survival and more.

games.title: Fortnite Ballistic
games.description:
FORTNITE BALLISTIC is a first-person, 5v5 tactical FPS. Prove your talents, precision and teamwork to overcome your opponents.

Each round, use your skills and gadgets to Attack and Defend your side. Avoid elimination and outplay your opponents to secure victory for your team.

TACTICAL CHOICES MATTER.
Choose your gadget and lock in! Fortnite Ballistic provides unique, Flex gadgets that can alter the outcome of a round. Once you’ve locked in your gadget, add it to your arsenal during the Buy phase of each round and go ballistic.

FIRST PERSON, FULL IMPACT
Fortnite Ballistic is the first Fortnite mode built using the First Person Camera Mode Device in UEFN. Experience Fortnite in an all new way, challenging your skills and testing your tactics.

Getting this experience is not necessary to access this content. When you launch Fortnite using this through your Library, the experience will be pre-selected for your convenience.

games.title: Fortnite Festival
games.description: Play in a band with friends or perform solo on stage with hit music by your favorite artists in Fortnite Festival! On the Main Stage, play a featured rotation of Jam Tracks. Compete against friends for the best performance or team up to climb the leaderboards. The festival is just beginning with more Jam Tracks, Music Icons, concerts, and stages coming soon. Take your stage in Fortnite Festival!

games.title: Fortnite Festival: Season 1
games.description: It’s “opening night” for Fortnite Festival, and what better way to celebrate the launch weekend than with… The Weeknd! The award-winning artist is the featured Icon of Fortnite Festival Season 1: Opening Night. Season 1 runs from now until February 22, 2024, at 12 AM ET. During this time, keep the beat going in the Opening Night Festival Pass to unlock new Instruments, Jam Tracks, and more! The Opening Night Festival Pass has a free reward track and a Premium Reward Track upgrade. With the Premium Reward Track, you’ll unlock an extra layer of rewards as you progress, including The Weeknd Outfit!

games.title: Fortnite Festival: Season 10
games.description:
Gorillaz — the biggest virtual band in the world — has crossed over and crash-landed into a whole new universe! With their colorful backstory and ground-breaking musical ways, they’re ready to put on a show.

Band members Noodle, 2D, Russel Hobbs, and Murdoc Niccals are the Icons of Fortnite Festival Season 10. Watch out for this dream line-up making their Festival debut on August 26!

games.title: Fortnite Festival: Season 11
games.description:
Special Season of Fortnite Festival, the first to not include a real-life artist as a headliner.

Adds the biggest, most varied collection of Jam Tracks so far. Perform your best show yet on the Main Stage, make new mixes on the Jam Stage and in Battle Royale, and choose your background music when you get a Victory Royale or drop out of the Battle Bus.

games.title: Fortnite Festival: Season 12
games.description: Singer, actress, global star, and now Festival Season 12 Icon, LISA comes to Fortnite with her music and Outfits! Use the mic to sing absolute bangers. The Music Pass includes Jam Tracks like LISA’s “FUTW (Vixi Solo Version)” and kinetic tracks from other artists.

games.title: Fortnite Festival: Season 13
games.description:
The Festival continues with Season 13, now starring Chappell Roan!

Chappell adds “Pink Pony Club” to Fortnite through the Heartcore Music Pass, which you can purchase to access the pink Chappell Roan Outfit with an unlockable red version. Both versions are recreations of her fan-favorite Pink Pony fits on tour. The Pass also includes new accessories like the Midwest Princess Keytar.

games.title: Fortnite Festival: Season 14
games.description: Two-time GRAMMY-winning artist Laufey is Fortnite’s latest Icon. She’s bringing her mesmerizing blend of classical, jazz, and pop to the Fortnite Festival stage along with brand new Mic Vocal and Pro Drum charts!

games.title: Fortnite Festival: Season 15
games.description:
He got his start rapping with friends while playing Fortnite, and now you and your friends can band up or go solo with his 4 new Jam Tracks "Ransom," "Dark Thoughts," “Love Me” and "500lbs".

The Neon Dreams Music Pass unlocks new Festival gear, like the music-reactive Tour Ready Lil Tecca Outfit, the Mic Mace Pickaxe, Tecca’s World Back Bling, and the Dopamine Tour-inspired Guitar.

games.title: Fortnite Festival: Season 2
games.description: Get ready to go gaga as the legendary superstar, Lady Gaga, becomes the Icon for Fortnite Festival Season 2: Unlock Your Talent!

games.title: Fortnite Festival: Season 3
games.description: You’ve seen her in a crown, now see her in Fortnite. Award-winning artist Billie Eilish is the Icon of Fortnite Festival Season 3!

games.title: Fortnite Festival: Season 4
games.description: There’s a storm raging over Fortnite Festival! James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich, Kirk Hammett, and Robert Trujillo from Metallica are the Icons of Season 4.

games.title: Fortnite Festival: Season 5
games.description: Put your hands together for the next Festival Icon! Fresh off her historic stadium world tour, award winner and pop culture powerhouse Karol G brings her Latin sounds to the world of Fortnite in Festival Season 5.

games.title: Fortnite Festival: Season 6
games.description: It’s the Snoop D-O-Double G! With more than 35 million album sales worldwide, Snoop Dogg is one of the biggest rap and hip-hop icons in the world, and now he’s the Icon for Fortnite Festival Season 6.

games.title: Fortnite Festival: Season 8
games.description: The 8th season of Fortnite Festival, featuring modern pop icon Sabrina Carpenter

games.title: Fortnite Festival: Season 9
games.description: Sabrina’s leaving the door open for the next Fortnite Festival Icon… Bruno Mars! This GRAMMY-winning megastar is expanding his record-breaking world tour with a stop in Fortnite.

games.title: Fortnite OG
games.description:
FORTNITE OG is BACK and here to stay. Drop into Chapter 1 and explore the OG map, collect OG loot, and relive OG gameplay.

THE OG OG RETURNS Solos or Squads, drop into battle with Fortnite OG: Chapter 1. Build your way to pure victory in Battle Royale or dominate the Island in a new way with Zero Build. Each Fortnite OG season runs approximately two months, bringing back the legendary loot and features from back in the day.

CLASSIC COOL IN THE OG PASS The Fortnite OG Pass features 45 tiers of retro rewards with a modern twist on items and Outfits. A new OG Pass will be available every OG season for 950 V-Bucks or in Fortnite Crew including the OG Pass, new Battle Royale, Music and LEGO Passes in Fortnite Crew for 1,400 V-Bucks.
