Feel like a renaissance engineer, build your own solutions to light puzzles, feel your brain grow and all of that within the beautiful and mysterious world of LIT.

games.title: Lithium: Inmate 39
games.description: Lithium Inmate 39 is a platform and 3D puzzle game for horror genre. It tells the story of a psychiatric patient who must find the way back to his origins, discovering his past and getting explanations to understanding what is going on in his mind.

games.title: Lithium: Inmate 39 - Relapsed Edition
games.description: A survival horror game where you solve many puzzles, lure enemies into deadly and bloody traps and try to escape running away from twisted monsters chasing you in the dark.

games.title: Little Adventure on the Prairie
games.description: A short and fun platforming adventure game.

games.title: Little Big Adventure: Twinsen's Quest
games.description:
Step into Twinsun's fantastical world in this action-adventure remake! Little Big Adventure - Twinsen's Quest brings brand new visuals, new music by the original composer, and smoother gameplay to the iconic classic released back in 1994.

Embark on a Timeless Adventure, Reimagined

Twinsen is back in this remake featuring a new stylish makeover and modernized gameplay. Faithful to the original game, Little Big Adventure – Twinsen’s Quest takes you on an epic journey on a small planet harboring both magic and technology.

games.title: Little Big Workshop
games.description: Imagine a magical factory, appearing right in your living room. A carefully planned masterpiece, where diligent workers throw together anything customers want. Rubber ducks and dressers, drones and electric guitars, scooters and other wonderful goods can be created from many different materials and sold for hard cash – cash you invest right back into your factory to get more machines, more workers and grow your business. In Little Big Workshop you become a factory tycoon!

games.title: Little Devil Inside
games.description: Little Devil Inside is a truly engaging 3D action adventure RPG game where you are thrown into a surreal but somewhat familiar setting with men, creatures and monsters to interact with, learn and hunt – survive and discover the world that exists beyond.

games.title: Little Disaster
games.description: This cute little disaster is bursting with big fun and challenge

games.title: Little Dragons Café
games.description:
Little Dragons Café opens with a twin brother and sister learning to cook and manage a small café with their mother. All was routine until one morning when the twins discover that their mother won’t wake up. Suddenly, a strange old man appears and tells them that they must raise a dragon to save her. Working with three quirky café employees, the twins must wrangle a dragon and run the family business while finding a way to save their mother.

In Little Dragons Café, players can choose to play as either sibling Ren or Rin. The story-driven gameplay features a balance of three elements:

Manage your café - Run your own café by preparing tasty dishes, serving your customers, and managing a colorful cast of eccentric staff and visitors.

Explore the world - Discover an entirely new world filled with wildlife, secrets, and dangers while collecting ingredients and recipes to enhance your café menu.

Raise a Dragon - Care for and train your very own dragon as he grows from baby to adult. Explore, hunt, and uncover new areas with your faithful companion.

games.title: Little Droid
games.description: Little Droid is a metroidvania-style adventure that takes you to a world of mysteries, tough enemies, and hidden dangers. The journey is packed with challenges, requiring careful battery management to keep the droid energized at crucial moments. Explore a richly detailed environment, collect weapons to overcome various obstacles, and uncover secrets as you pursue the source of a mysterious signal.

games.title: Little Helper Cafe
games.description: A hedgehog, sugar, and lots of logic on the table!

games.title: Little Keepers
games.description: What are friends for if not to defend each other from mutant plants that want to hurt you? Build your enemies, destroy your defenses and restore chaos in the garden! ... Wait, it was the other way around.

games.title: Little Kitty, Big City
games.description: You're a curious little kitty with a big personality, on an adventure to find your way back home. Explore the city, make new friends, wear delightful hats, and leave more than a little chaos in your wake. After all, isn't that what cats do best?

games.title: Little Kitty, Big City: Picture Purrfect
Little League World Series Baseball 2022
games.description: Little League World Series Baseball 2022 captures the fun and fundamentals of Little League in a new unique way: pick your team, power-up your stats, and knock it out of the park to become a Little League All-Star.

games.title: Little Legend
games.description: Little Legend is a 2D side-scrolling Adventure Game taking place in a dreamlike Open World. Craft your own Magic abilities and and follow the heartwarming story of Pimpim.

games.title: Little Legs
games.description: Discover the wonderful world of cute insects!

games.title: Little Misfortune
games.category: Point-and-click, Platform, Puzzle, Adventure, Indie, Arcade
games.description: Little Misfortune is an interactive story, focused on exploration and characters, both sweet and dark, where your choices have consequences.

games.title: Little Mouse's Encyclopedia
games.description: An interactive encyclopedia for kids and their parents.

games.title: Little Nightmares
games.description: Little Nightmares is a puzzle-platform horror adventure game developed by Tarsier Studios and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. Set in a mysterious world, Little Nightmares follows the journey of Six, a hungry little girl who must escape the Maw, an iron vessel inhabited by monstrous, twisted beings.

games.title: Little Nightmares I & II
games.description: This collection of two Little Nightmares games will introduce you to a lovely, frightening and iconic puzzle-platformer series, starting with the original from 2017.

games.title: Little Nightmares II
games.description: Little Nightmares II is a puzzle-platformer and survival horror game in which players control Mono, a young boy navigating a nightmarish world warped by the transmission of a distant Signal Tower. Gameplay combines environmental puzzle-solving with stealth and light combat, as Mono and his AI companion Six work together to evade grotesque enemies and traverse dangerous environments. The game is a prequel to the original Little Nightmares and features collectible items that unlock additional story content.

games.title: Little Nightmares II: The Nome's Attic
games.description: Follow the Nomes to find this special in-game puzzle and unlock the Nomes' hat as a reward upon completion.

games.title: Little Nightmares II: TV Edition
games.description:
Little Nightmares II is a suspense-adventure game in which you play as Mono, a young boy trapped in a world that has been distorted by the humming transmission of a distant tower. With Six, the girl in a yellow raincoat, as his guide, Mono sets out to discover the dark secrets of The Signal Tower and save Six from her terrible fate; but their journey will not be straightforward as Mono and Six will face a gallery of new threats from the terrible residents of this world.

Will you dare to face this collection of new, little nightmares?

games.title: Little Nightmares III
games.description:
Embark on a new adventure in the unique world of Little Nightmares.

In Little Nightmares III, you follow the journey of Low & Alone, as they search for a path that could lead them out of the Nowhere.

Trapped within the Spiral, a cluster of disturbing places, the two friends will have to work together to survive in a dangerous world full of delusions and escape the grasp of an even greater threat lurking in the shadows.

For the first time in the franchise, face your childhood fears together with a friend using online co-op, or solo with an AI companion.

games.title: Little Nightmares III: Dark Six Costumes Set
games.description:
Get the Dark Six Costumes Set suited for both characters Low and Alone - a twisted reflection of the girl who escaped The Maw.

Many questions remain about the identity of Dark Six. Is she an alternate reflection of Six, a haunted, corrupted reflection? Is she the same person, but darker, shaped by her fears and the horrors she’s witnessed? Or is she something completely different?

Her silhouette remains unchanged, but something is different… The yellow is gone.

What’s left is a cold echo - quiet, watching, waiting.

Wearing this costume is more than a disguise.

It’s a question: What happens when you stop running… and become what you feared?

games.title: Little Nightmares III: Deluxe Edition
games.description:
The Deluxe Edition Includes:

Little Nightmares III - Base Game
Preorder Bonus: Dark Six Outfit Set
Secrets of the Spiral Expansion Pack + Ferryman Costumes Set
Resident Costumes Set (4 Total Costumes)

games.title: Little Nightmares III: Ferryman Costumes Set
games.description: Get the Ferryman Costumes Set, exclusive to the Expansion Pass and suited for both characters Low and Alone - a mysterious figure familiar to all children in The Nowhere…

games.title: Little Nightmares III: Klonoa Costumes Set
games.description: Bring nostalgia and darkness together with these costumes. A tribute to the beloved classic, reimagined with a creepy twist for your journey through the Spiral.

games.title: Little Nightmares III: Nomes Costumes Set
games.description: Transform your character with this eerie yet endearing look inspired by the mysterious Nomes of the Little Nightmares universe.

games.title: Little Nightmares III: Residents Costumes Pack
games.description:
Prepare to enter a world where fear wears many faces.

Conceal your identity in The Nowhere and embrace your dark side by wearing the costumes of some of The Residents of the two previous games: The Janitor, The Twin-Chefs, The Lady, The Hunter. Each costume goes in a set of two, suited for both characters Low and Alone.

The Janitor Costume: Step into the shadows - perfect for those who prefer lurking in the quiet corners, ready to sweep away any trace of their presence.

The Twin Chefs Costume: Double the terror, double the chaos - the Twin Chefs costume brings a twisted culinary duo that’s as unsettling as it is unforgettable.

The Lady Costume: Elegance with a dark twist, the Lady costume channels a haunting grace, blending beauty and dread in a way only the truly unsettling can.

The Hunter Costume: Embrace the hunt - fierce, relentless, and ever-watchful, a true predator lurking in the dark.

games.title: Little Nightmares III: Secrets of The Spiral - Expansion Pass
games.description:
Includes:
Little Nightmares III: Ferryman Costumes Set
Little Nightmares III: The Backstage
Little Nightmares III: The Shores

Delve deeper into the eerie lands of The Spiral.

games.title: Little Nightmares III: The Backstage
games.description: Low and Alone are torn apart. To find his friend, Low ventures into The Backstage. There lies The Puppeteer hunting the living canvas for her next masterpiece. With her Torch Hat, Dime is the only one who can guide Low through these depths.

games.title: Little Nightmares III: The Shores
games.description: Low and Alone, reunited, traveled through the mirror. Without Dime, it's once again just the two of them. The filthy stones, the fishy smell, the damp wind, there is no doubt they have reached The Shores. The overwhelming fog is regularly pierced by the lighthouse beacon. From up there, they will find their way. Low’s map says so. It must be true.

games.title: Little Nightmares: Complete Edition
games.description:
Little Nightmares is a puzzle-platform horror adventure game developed by Tarsier Studios and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. Set in a mysterious world, Little Nightmares follows the journey of Six, a hungry little girl who must escape the Maw, an iron vessel inhabited by monstrous, twisted beings.

The Complete Edition includes the base game and the Secrets of the Maw DLC, consisting of three chapters: The Depths, The Hideaway, and The Residence.

games.title: Little Nightmares: Deluxe Edition
games.description:
Little Nightmares is a puzzle-platform horror adventure game developed by Tarsier Studios and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. Set in a mysterious world, Little Nightmares follows the journey of Six, a hungry little girl who must escape the Maw, an iron vessel inhabited by monstrous, twisted beings.

The Deluxe Edition includes the base game and the Secrets of the Maw DLC, consisting of three chapters: The Depths, The Hideaway, and The Residence.

games.title: Little Nightmares: Fox Mask
games.description: An add-on introducing the Fox Mask to the base game.

games.title: Little Nightmares: Secrets of the Maw - Expansion Pass
games.description:
Little Nightmares is a puzzle-platform horror adventure game developed by Tarsier Studios and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. Set in a mysterious world, Little Nightmares follows the journey of Six, a hungry little girl who must escape the Maw, an iron vessel inhabited by monstrous, twisted beings.

The Secrets of the Maw DLC introduces three new chapters: The Depths, The Hideaway, and The Residence.

games.title: Little Nightmares: Six Edition
games.description:
Little Nightmares is a puzzle-platform horror adventure game developed by Tarsier Studios and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. Set in a mysterious world, Little Nightmares follows the journey of Six, a hungry little girl who must escape the Maw, an iron vessel inhabited by monstrous, twisted beings.

The Six Edition includes:
• Game disc
• 10cm figure of Six
• Themed Cage Box
• Exclusive A3 poster
• Sticker board
• Original Soundtrack CD (composed by Tobias Lilja)

games.title: Little Nightmares: Tengu Mask
games.description: An add-on introducing the Tengu Mask to the base game.

games.title: Little Nightmares: The Depths
games.description: The Depths is the first area the Runaway Kid passes through in Little Nightmares's DLC, Secrets of the Maw. It is located at the very bottom of the Maw and is also where the Granny is encountered.

games.title: Little Nightmares: The Hideaway
games.description: The Hideaway is the second area the Runaway Kid passes through in Little Nightmares's DLC, Secrets of the Maw. The Janitor appears to be the main antagonist in this area.

games.title: Little Nightmares: The Residence
games.description: The Residence is the fifth area Six passes through and the third area the Runaway Kid passes through in Little Nightmares and its DLC. It is where the Lady resides and is the last chapter of the main game and DLC.

games.title: Little Noah: Scion of Paradise
games.description: Join the genius alchemist Noah and her cat companion Zipper as they explore ancient ruins to uncover the secrets hidden within! Create unique teams and combos from 40+ recruitable allies in this casual but compelling game!

games.title: Little Orpheus
games.description:
An impossible adventure awaits in Little Orpheus, the brand-new adventure from award-winning studio The Chinese Room, a Sumo Digital Studio, available from today exclusively on Apple Arcade.

From the BAFTA-winning team behind Everybody’s Gone to the Rapture and Dear Esther, Little Orpheus is a side-scrolling adventure game about one comrade’s journey to the centre of the Earth.

The year is 1962. NASA are trying to put a man on the moon but in a remote corner of Siberia, a Soviet cosmonaut is heading in the other direction. Ivan Ivanovich is dropped into an extinct volcano in his exploration capsule, Little Orpheus, to explore the centre of the earth.

Ivan vanishes, emerging three years later claiming to have saved the world. In a top-secret bunker, he is debriefed by the fearsome General Yurkovoi. Little Orpheus casts players as Ivan as he recounts an adventure beyond belief: a tale of lost civilizations, undersea kingdoms, and prehistoric jungles deep below the Earth’s crust.

Brought to you in glorious technicolour with visuals inspired by a bygone era of adventure, Little Orpheus is a serialised adventure inspired by classic movies like Flash Gordon, Sinbad and The Land That Time Forgot.

games.title: Little Red Lie
games.description: A contemporary adventure game about debt, family, and the truth about honesty.

games.title: Little Strays
games.description: In the shadows of abandoned warehouses, tiny kittens await a feline hero to rescue them and scavenge for food.

games.title: Little Town Hero
games.description:
Unlike most RPGs, there is no need to fight weak monsters repeatedly to level grind in "Little Town Hero".

Instead, you will need to have a good strategy to fight each boss monster one on one.

...Will the protagonist live the adventure he craves and escape the humdrum village life?

- A challenging battle system which relies heavily on coming up with new Ideas and strategies.

- Compact story progression designed with the busy gamer in mind.

- Soundtrack by Toby Fox, composer of the background music for UNDERTALE.

games.title: Little Town Hero: Big Idea Edition
games.description:
Izzit? Dazzit!: use your ideas to outwit and defend against enemies, then strike back with strong attacks.
charming LOCALS: befriend townspeople to gain their support, as well as unlock more ideas to use in battle.
there's no place like home: enjoy life in this little town with a whimsical soundtrack by Toby Fox (under tale) and cozy art style by game Freak

games.title: Little Triangle
games.description: The game targets to be one of the best hardcore platformers ever. If you are worried that a good hardcore game will take you too long to finish, you can try the "casual" mode in Little Triangle where you have some additional lives. With the same level design as the hardcore mode, you will still find the fun in the challenges with much less pressure. If you only love highly challenging hardcore platformers but cannot find new ones, please check the "hardcore" mode of Little Triangle and the difficult level is just right for you.

games.title: Little War Online
games.description: Little War Online is an upcoming crossplatform 2D MMORPG. It will be available on Android, iOS, PC, OSX, Linux & Browsers first. It is also planned to hit PlayStation 4 and Xbox One at a latter date.

games.title: Little Witch Academia: Chamber of Time
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description:
Little Witch Academia: Chamber of Time is a heart-pounding 3D action RPG beat ‘em up featuring an original storyline carved from the popular anime series by Studio Trigger.

Little Witch Academia: Chamber of Time features main characters from the anime and original storylines for players to explore as they make their way through Luna Nova Magical Academy.

games.title: Little Witch Nobeta
games.description: Control the lovely little witch Nobeta, explore the unknown mysterious castle, and gradually discover the truth!

games.title: Little Witch Nobeta: Day One Edition
games.description:
The Day One Edition of Little Witch Nobeta includes:
- The game
- A reversible cover sleeve
- 6 Postcards
- A Sticker Sheet
- An A2 Double-sided Poster
- Collector's Box

games.title: Little Witch Nobeta: Limited Edition
games.description:
The Limited Edition of Little Witch Nobeta includes the following:
- Game: Little Witch Nobeta
- Special Illustrated Box
- Script with Autograph (A4, 48 pages)
- B2 Tapestry
- Art book (B5, 32 pages)
- Soundtrack CD

games.title: LittleBigPlanet 3
games.description: In LittleBigPlanet 3, explore a world filled with creativity as you explore all corners of the Imagisphere, meet the inhabitants of the mysterious planet Bunkum and face the nefarious Newton. Discover endless surprises that the LittleBigPlanet Community have created and shared for you to enjoy, with new levels and games to play every day. Then if you're feeling inspired, flex your creative muscles with the powerful and intuitive customization tools, to bring your own imagination to life in LittleBigPlanet 3.

games.title: LittleBigPlanet 3: Bigfoot Costume
games.description:
Follow the monster-sized footprints.
Campers beware, deep in the forest lurks a very big hairy beast indeed − luckily it’s really Toggle dressed up as Bigfoot, as the cheeky scamp.

games.title: LittleBigPlanet 3: Dead Space - Isaac Clarke Costume
LittleBigPlanet 3: Fix Me Hook Hat T-shirt
LittleBigPlanet 3: Mass Effect - Andromeda Costume Pack
games.description:
DISCOVER A NEW GALAXY
Star charts at the ready, Sack Gang.

Create your own wild missions through the far reaches of the galaxy by dressing up your LBP pals as characters from the thrilling RPG adventure, Mass Effect Andromeda.

This pack features costumes of:
• N7 Armor: Sackboy charges into battle in the iconic Pathfinder threads.
• Drack: Enemies freeze in fear at the sight of Big Toggle dressed as the Krogan warrior.
• Initiative Armor: Only the bravest recruits are chosen for daring missions - including Little Toggle.
• Wraith: A fierce creature faithful to the mysterious Kett alien race. OddSock needs to perfect his growling.
• Poc: Swoop can spy on your enemies from above dressed as a covert drone.

games.title: LittleBigPlanet 3: Santa Hat And Beard Costume
LittleBigPlanet 3: The Journey Home
games.description:
Bunkum is safe! To celebrate this marvelous feat, the grateful curators of the Imagisphere are throwing a huge party back on Craftworld… and everyone’s invited.

But silly bowler hat-wearing inventor Newton has transported the gang to the wrong side of the planet, and they now face a race against time to join in their own celebrations.

games.title: Live A Live
games.description:
Previously unreleased outside of Japan, the RPG game Live a Live is releasing on the Nintendo Switch system in the HD-2D style!

Seven different stories featuring different protagonists, time periods, and gameplay styles await. In The Wild West, a wanderer with a bounty on his head fights for his life. In the Twilight of Edo Japan, a shinobi undertakes a secret mission. Experience these tales in any order you choose—the adventure is yours to control. What other stories will you uncover on the horizon...?

games.title: Live or Die
games.description:
Live or Die is the new free online multiplayer Battle Royale in which you can face other players in action-packed matches in which in addition to the other players you will find a wide cast of hostile, bloodthirsty and unfriendly creatures. Live or Die lets you choose up to seven different characters and customize them to your liking.

You will be able to travel to three worlds with totally different themes such as the Prehistoric World, the Fantastic World or the Strange World and you will be able to play in three game modes, each more exciting: Hunting Mode, which you can play alone or in cooperative mode with your friends, Battle Royale Mode, in which you can show who is the best and Survival Mode, where the rules of the game are totally different from the other two modes.

games.title: Livelock
games.description: Livelock is a cooperative top-down shooter where you and up to two others must work together to break the cycle of infinite war between machines. As one of "The Few" remaining Capital Intellects, you will need quick reactions and decision-making to overcome the chaos.

games.title: Lizard Lady vs. the Cats: Platinum Edition
Lizards Must Die 2
games.description: Lizards Must Die 2 is a cooperative slasher action game, a high–quality continuation of the SENSATIONAL first part. Insidious lizards attacked the lands of the Rus again. HYPERBOREA is on fire and only the GLORIOUS HEROES can lick the invaders from their homeland.

games.title: Llamasoft: The Jeff Minter Story
games.description: 42 of the weirdest, trippiest, sheepiest games ever created. Enter the mind of Jeff Minter, the legendary creator of Attack of the Mutant Camels, Gridrunner, and Tempest 2000, in this interactive documentary from Digital Eclipse.

games.title: Loaders, Inc.
games.description: Box by Box, Build Your Business

games.title: Loadout
games.description:
Loadout is an outrageous new multi-player shooter that’s all about the guns, baby! Build a massive variety of absolutely insane weaponry - billions of combinations - totally customized, totally unique, and totally deadly.

Our robust and modular Weaponcrafting system allows players to make their own weapons from a wide variety of weapon parts, and then modify their entire arsenal to suit their play style. There are no defined classes in Loadout. You define your own class through the weapons you create.

Loadout is also loaded with over-the-top comedic violence, stylish character models, and crazy player animations. We aim to add a fresh, new look to the shooter experience that gives players a full-adrenaline rush that is totally different from the vast array of modern combat titles. From our hilariously gory damage system, to our wacky character customizations, Loadout will appeal to the lunatic in us all. But don’t let the demented humor fool you. At its core, Loadout is a fast-paced shooter that’s easy to learn, but hard to master.

games.title: Local News with Cliff Rockslide
games.description: Welcome to Local News, it's the small-town-celebrity Cliff Rockslide (seven subscribers, ahem) with his trustworthy cameraperson, YOU!

games.title: Lock's Quest
games.description:
The 2019 Remaster of "Lock's Quest"
Build Defenses and Battle against the Clockwork horde in this 2D Action RPG / Tower Defense hybrid.

games.title: Loco Parentis
games.description: Co-op horror game, where you have to help a little girl find her mother and figure out what is really happening in your house and who your neighbors really are.

games.title: LocoRoco 2 Remastered
games.description: Armed with a deadly song that withers all living things, the evil Moja army has returned – and only you can help the LocoRoco save the world in this classic puzzle platformer, remastered in HD for PlayStation 4.

games.title: LocoRoco Midnight Carnival
games.description:
Roll, jump, bounce and ‘boing’ your way through a mysterious moonlit fairground built by the mischievous BuiBui. Just watch out for the fiendish traps and devious hazards they’ve left behind!

16 classic LocoRoco levels in this playful platformer originally released on the PSP, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.title: LocoRoco Remastered
games.description: The peaceful world of the LocoRoco is under attack by the not-so-nice Moja Corps! These evil outer space creatures have come to take the LocoRoco from their land of blowing flowers, lively creatures and pastel scenery. You must move the LocoRoco through more than 40 levels of slippery slopes, teetering platforms, and maze-like passages. The LocoRoco have the uncanny ability to fluidly morph to their landscape, so all you need is to tilt, roll, and bounce the happy blob-like creatures to safety.

games.title: Lode Runner Legacy
games.description: Lode Runner Legacy is the latest edition in the popular Lode Runner series. Players control “Runner” to recover stolen gold while avoiding enemies and minefields. Enjoy the ingenious balance of puzzle and action gameplay, an updated Voxel visual style and powerful game editors.

games.title: Lofi Mahjong
games.category: Puzzle, Strategy, Indie, Card & Board Game
games.description: Dive into a calm, cozy world with Lofi Mahjong. Enjoy classic Mahjong Solitaire enhanced by a lofi soundscape for maximum focus and minimum stress.

games.title: Log Jammers
games.description: Find some flannel and pack your adrenaline for this action-packed, horror sports tragedy. The stakes are high, and the multi-species cheerleaders are jumping higher.

games.title: Logiart Grimoire
games.description:
Logiart is a "Picture Logic Puzzle" that uses vertical and horizontal numbers as hints to complete illustrations.
It has simple and easy-to-understand rules, making it accessible for anyone to play.
Various assist functions are also included, allowing for a smooth gameplay experience.
You can also choose to turn off the assist functions if desired.

games.title: Logiart Grimoire: Emil's Magic Training, Part 1
games.description:
Emil has begun training to create Logiart puzzles, just in case!
Feel free to try out the records of his hard work.
It seems he still needs more training, but maybe he’s already managed to create a perfect puzzle now and then...?

games.title: LogiKing
games.description: LogiKing is a game where you utilize the effects of 10 cards numbered 0 to 9 and deduce your opponent's hidden cards.

games.title: Lollipop Chainsaw RePop
games.description: Lollipop Chainsaw RePop is a remaster of the original. RePOP is a definitive version of the game which leaves the story unchanged, with the focus on quality of life improvements and additional gameplay content.

games.title: Lone Survivor: The Director's Cut
games.description: In this original and adult psychological survival horror, the masked protagonist must escape from a city ravaged by disease, by any means necessary.

games.title: Lone Wolf
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure, Indie
games.description:
Lone Wolf: A Post Apocalyptic Beat-Em Up Role Playing Game. This action/adventure game lets a player use martial arts skills, weapons, and turn into a werewolf to fight their way through a world set in the aftermath of post nuclear devastation.

This game was made with the love of the beat-em up arcade machines and console games of the 1980's and 1990's, taking some of the mechanics of these games mixed with some more modern gameplay.

games.title: Lonely Guardian
games.description: Lonely Guardian is a relaxing and accessible 2D platformer where you play as a Foo Dog, a mythical creature from East Asian culture. Your sacred mission is simple: collect the Mystic Pearl, rescue a lost pup, and reach the temple gate in each level.

games.title: Lonely Mountains: Downhill
games.description: Just you and your bike - take it on a thrilling ride down an unspoiled mountain landscape. Make your way through thick forests, narrow trails and wild rivers. Race, jump, slide and try not to crash - all the way from the peak to the valley!

games.title: Lonely Mountains: Downhill - Eldfjall Island
games.description: Pack your raincoat and bring your beloved bike to the volcanic island of Eldfjall - the largest Lonely Mountain yet.

games.title: Lonely Mountains: Downhill - Misty Peak
games.description: Ride above the clouds on the lost trail of Graterhorn in this free DLC. Master the new challenges to ride in style in the air elemental customization set. Misty Peak - New adventures await you on the Lonely Mountains.

games.title: Lonely Mountains: Downhill - Redmoor Falls
games.description: Gear up for a trip around the lost trail of Redmoor Peaks in this free DLC. Take a chance on the new challenges to win the water elemental customization set.

games.title: Lonely Mountains: Downhill - Riley's Return
games.description: Ride into uncharted territory and discover the lost trail of Mount Riley in this free DLC. Prove your skills in new challenges to unlock the brand-new earth elemental customization set Riley’s Return brings you a fresh adventure to the Lonely Mountains.

games.title: Lonely Mountains: Downhill - Rivera's Revenge
games.description: Turn on your bike light to explore the secret cave of Sierra Rivera's lost trail in this free DLC. Collect the fire elemental customization set by playing through the brand-new challenges. Saddle up and face Rivera's Revenge in the Lonely Mountains.

games.title: Long Gone Days
games.description: A modern-day JRPG that imagines a world of war. Overcome language barriers, forge unlikely friendships, and find hope amidst conflict.

games.title: Long Live the Queen
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Adventure, Indie, Visual Novel
games.description: Rule the world or die trying! Being a Princess is not an easy job. Being a Queen is even harder. Especially when you're only fourteen years old, and the reason you've inherited the throne is that your royal mother has just met an untimely end. Now power is up for grabs.

games.title: Look Outside
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Adventure, Indie
games.description:
Explore the warped interior of the apartment building you are stuck in. Fight hideous monsters that were once your neighbors. Manage weapons and ammo. Play video games. Craft bombs from household supplies. Cook. Answer the door. DONT let them in. Keep yourself alive and sane as the world just outside your window stops making sense.

Just whatever you do...
DONT LOOK OUTSIDE

A survival horror RPG by Francis Coulombe, with music by Eric Shumaker, made in one month for the Hawktober game jam.

games.title: Looking for Aliens
games.description: Aliens are among us! Can you find traces of them on Earth, the moon, and the edges of the galaxy? Find all the clues to prove the existence of alien civilizations and discover how making fried eggs can end up in a monster attack!

games.title: Looking for Aliens: Collector's Edition
games.description:
Aliens are among us! Can you find traces of them on Earth, the moon, and the edges of the galaxy? Find all the clues to prove the existence of alien civilizations and discover how making fried eggs can end up in a monster attack!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:
• Blast-off with five exciting bonus levels!
• Explore the galaxy with a downloadable soundtrack and wallpapers!
• Tons of hidden cards to collect!

games.title: Looney Test
games.description: Looney Test is the ultimate quiz for anyone who’s ever wondered, “Am I a little weird… or completely off the rails?” Dive into 12 ridiculous multiple-choice questions that will test your silliness, challenge your inner clown, and reveal just how delightfully looney you truly are. Play solo for a personal dose of absurdity or take turns with friends to see who’s the biggest goofball in the group!

games.title: Looney Tunes Galactic Sports
games.description: Bugs Bunny & Co. go to Mars to compete in the zany Galactic Sports event.

games.title: Looney Tunes: Wacky World of Sports
games.description:
Compete against friends and family with the Looney Tunes squad in basketball, soccer, golf and tennis.

Play your way solo or in four-player local co-op and choose the characters that best suit your play style.

Avoid wacky obstacles and gain power-ups to incite chaos as you control your favorite Looney Tunes all-stars!

games.title: Loop
games.description: Put your puzzle-solving skills to the test with Loop, the addictively fun game. Move stones around a grid system to their correct positions and challenge yourself with exciting gameplay!

games.title: Loop8: Celestial Edition
games.description:
‘Celestial’ Limited Edition includes:
- The game in a custom box
- 5.25”x7.25” softcover artbook with over 50 pages
- A musical selections CD
- 7” x 10.5” mini wall scroll
- Authentic 4” x 3.15” Japanese wooden ema

games.title: Loop8: Summer of Gods
games.description:
In this original coming-of-age RPG, step into the life of Nini, a newly earthbound teen who arrives in the quaint Japanese town of Ashihara in August 1983. Explore the town, befriend its people, and face off against the Kegai in turn-based battles where the outcomes depend on the relationships you’ve built and the decisions you’ve made. Use Nini’s special connection to the gods to reset the world, with each loop allowing Nini and his allies to relive the 8th month over and over until they get it right…or the Kegai overcome them entirely.
With one month until the world ends, how will you spend each day?

games.title: Loopers
games.description: Loopers is a kinetic novel made by Ryukishi07 in collaboration with the visual novel studio Key.

games.title: Loopindex
games.description: It's time to explore the virtual land of Loopindex! Its vast, uncharted lands are full of puzzles to solve! Play alone, or team up with a robo-friend, and use logic and timing to clear each area. The difficulty will test your ingenuity as you explore the unique “loop mechanic” at the core of the gameplay loop. You’ll take on levels full of traps and discovery, befriend virtual creatures, and even battle against cool bosses.

games.title: Loopy Ball
games.description: Fun little game where you must avoid the spikes to live longer.

games.title: Loot Hero DX
games.description:
A legendary Dragon is haunting the lands. Towns are set ablaze, and its magic power resurrects the evil creatures of the world. A hero is needed to travel to the corners of
the lands and slay the beast to restore peace.

RPG grind-fest! Run, Battle ever harder enemies, Collect XP and Loot, Buy better equipment, Level Up, Do it all over again.

games.title: Loot Rascals
games.description: Only you can rescue Big Barry - your huge robot head pal - from a space theme park that’s been invaded by a tentacled pan-dimensional godbeast.

games.title: Loot River
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure, Indie
games.description: Set in a series of procedurally generated labyrinths, Loot River is a dungeon crawling action roguelike that combines tense, real-time combat and dark fantasy settings with spatial block-shifting.

games.title: Loot: Action-Packed Bundle
games.description: Get Loot Action-Packed Bundle, Action game for PS4 console from the official PlayStation website. Explore Loot Action-Packed Bundle game detail, demo, images, videos, reviews.

games.title: Loot: Games & Themes Ultimate Holiday Bundle
games.description: Get Loot Games & Themes Ultimate Holiday Bundle, Action game for PS4 console from the official PlayStation website. Explore Loot Games & Themes Ultimate Holiday Bundle game detail, demo, images, videos, reviews.

games.title: Loot: Strategy-Packed Bundle
games.description: Get Loot Strategy-Packed Bundle, Strategy game for PS4 console from the official PlayStation website. Explore Loot Strategy-Packed Bundle game detail, demo, images, videos, reviews.

games.title: Loot: Ultimate Games & Themes Bundle
games.description: Get Loot Ultimate Games & Themes Bundle, game for PS4 console from the official PlayStation website. Explore Loot Ultimate Games & Themes Bundle game detail, demo, images, videos, reviews.

games.title: Lootbox Lyfe+
games.description: Metroidvania movement gameplay with soul-selling lootbox-based customization

games.title: LootLite
games.description: LootLite is a roguelike-arcade in which you can embody different heroes to try to recover their stolen treasures, through a huge area full of secrets, hidden paths and all kinds of weapons that will make your playthrough easier.

games.title: Lord of Metal
games.description:
Lord of Metal is a single player story-driven management simulator game about organizing Rock music festivals bringing a dystopian world back to life. Gather your crew, book bands, sign sponsors, claim festival grounds and bring some Rock to the masses!

In Lord of Metal, you're a disciple of the almighty Metal God, tasked with reviving the world's passion for hard rock and metal. To achieve your goal, you need to host festivals going from small roadside gigs to mega events for thousands of fans.

Get ‘under the hood’ of heavy music industry: gather your crew, book bands, land sponsors, build & manage fests and make decisions that matter. Travel the vibrant world of the game and enjoy the stories and mechanics based on real music industry experience brought to you by pros.

games.title: Lord of the Click
games.description: Battle valour, courage and honour - if these words still mean something to you, you are welcome to play Lord Of The Click.

games.title: Lord of the Click 3
games.description: The Orcs are getting closer and very soon they will get so close that it will be impossible to get out of the elf kingdom. For the good of the people, the king himself is ready to stop the army of monsters. It will be difficult to determine how this battle will end if you don't help him!

games.title: Lord of the Click II
games.description: Yes! Oh my gosh! Hell yeah! This long-promised day has finally come with the release of the game that kills not only your time but your calories as well! The return of the legendary Lord of the Click has happened so suddenly and with a number «II» on the end.

games.title: Lord of the Click: Interstellar Wars
games.description: Let's do it once more, people! New chapter of the critically acclaimed Lord of the Click series is finally here. And it's tetralogy now meaning we're done with the trilogy thing and up for something bigger. Interstellar Wars take the neverending conflict to a whole new level — in space!

games.title: Lord of the Rings
games.description: An ambitious massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) set in J.R.R. Tolkien's Middle-earth, developed by Amazon Games in partnership with Embracer Group. The game was intended to offer a fresh twist on Tolkien's mythology rather than a standard recreation. The project was cancelled in 2024 as part of Amazon's strategic pivot away from first-party AAA MMO development.

games.title: Lord Winklebottom Investigates
games.description: Take on the role of Lord Winklebottom, detective giraffe, as he investigates the murder of his childhood friend, the axolotl Admiral Gilfrey, in this point and click murder mystery adventure game.

games.title: Lords of Exile
games.description: Lords of Exile is a 8-bit side-scrolling action platformer set in the far Lands of Exilia where a cursed knight makes his way to the revenge. A combination of classic retro mechanics and linear level design in 8-bit graphics!

games.title: Lords of Ravage
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Tactical, Indie, Visual Novel
games.description: Become the Final Boss! Play any way you want, combine followers from different factions, and win spectacular turn-based battles. Expand your Empire of Darkness and seek a powerful artifact that can change the fate of the world.

games.title: Lords of the Fallen
games.description:
Lords of the Fallen is a fantasy action role-playing game set in a world where humanity has overthrown its god. The story follows Harkyn, a convicted criminal chosen to confront the returning demonic forces known as the Rhogar and their leaders, the Lords.

The game focuses on melee combat, with weapons, armor, and character attributes affecting movement, defense, and attack style. Players explore interconnected areas, fight enemies and bosses, collect equipment, and use magic alongside physical attacks. It was developed by CI Games in collaboration with Deck13.

games.title: Lords of the Fallen: Ancient Labyrinth
games.description: Ancient Labyrinth is a DLC expansion to Lords of the Fallen. The DLC contains about 1 hour of gameplay (1 new boss and 1 new zone).

games.title: Lords of the Fallen: Collector's Edition
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description:
Lords of the Fallen is a fantasy action role-playing game set in a world where humanity has overthrown its god. The story follows Harkyn, a convicted criminal chosen to confront the returning demonic forces known as the Rhogar and their leaders, the Lords.

The game focuses on melee combat, with weapons, armor, and character attributes affecting movement, defense, and attack style. Players explore interconnected areas, fight enemies and bosses, collect equipment, and use magic alongside physical attacks. It was developed by CI Games in collaboration with Deck13.

The Collector’s Edition includes a handcrafted 8-inch polystone bust, a hardcover art book, an official soundtrack, a cloth map, and digital content — The Monk’s Decipher, Lionheart Pack, and Demonic Weapons Pack — all packaged in a collector’s box.

games.title: Lords of the Fallen: Complete Edition
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description:
Lords of the Fallen: Complete Edition is an edition of the 2014 fantasy action role-playing game. It includes the base game and the post-release downloadable content released for it, including Ancient Labyrinth, The Monk’s Decipher, the Demonic Weapons Pack, the Lionheart Pack, the Foundation Boost Pack, the Arcane Boost Pack and the Soulflayer Pack.

The game follows Harkyn, a convicted criminal sent to confront the Rhogar, a demonic force returning after humanity’s war against its god. Gameplay is centered on melee combat, equipment builds, magic, exploration, and boss encounters. The included DLC adds an area and a boss to Ancient Labyrinth, along with extra weapons, armor, spells, and resource packs.

games.title: Lords of the Fallen: Game of the Year Edition
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description:
Lords of the Fallen is a fantasy action role-playing game set in a world where humanity has overthrown its god. The story follows Harkyn, a convicted criminal chosen to confront the returning demonic forces known as the Rhogar and their leaders, the Lords.

The game focuses on melee combat, with weapons, armor, and character attributes affecting movement, defense, and attack style. Players explore interconnected areas, fight enemies and bosses, collect equipment, and use magic alongside physical attacks. It was developed by CI Games in collaboration with Deck13.

The Game of the Year Edition comes with all previously released DLCs bundled in, which include:

- The base game
- ‘Ancient Labyrinth’ DLC
- Demonic Weapons Pack
- Lionheart Pack
- ‘The Monk’s Decipher’ DLC

games.title: Lords of the Fallen: Limited Edition
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description:
Lords of the Fallen is a fantasy action role-playing game set in a world where humanity has overthrown its god. The story follows Harkyn, a convicted criminal chosen to confront the returning demonic forces known as the Rhogar and their leaders, the Lords.

The game focuses on melee combat, with weapons, armor, and character attributes affecting movement, defense, and attack style. Players explore interconnected areas, fight enemies and bosses, collect equipment, and use magic alongside physical attacks. It was developed by CI Games in collaboration with Deck13.

The Limited Edition includes the game's soundtrack, "The Monk's Decipher" DLC, and the "Demonic Weapons Pack," which includes Margyr (dagger), Thehk (hammer), and Ihir (sword).

games.title: Lorelei and the Laser Eyes
games.description:
A woman, summoned by an eccentric man to participate in a project in an old hotel somewhere in central Europe, becomes embroiled in a game of illusions, increasingly dangerous and surreal.

Now you are invited to fall into the same rabbit hole, in a non-linear mystery with an immense amount of handcrafted puzzles, constantly presenting you with new riddles to solve, each leading you closer to deciphering the enigma of Lorelei and the Laser Eyes.

games.title: Lorn's Lure
games.description: An android is led through a vast structure by a glitch in his visual system. Lorn's Lure is an atmospheric narrative first-person platformer with novel climbing mechanics and modernized retro 3D graphics.

games.title: Lornsword Winter Chronicle
games.description:
Lornsword Winter Chronicle is a story-driven action strategy game.
Be the general on the battlefield and take direct action to command your soldiers and set up your economy.
The Lorn Empire counts on you, keep your mind pure and your Lornsword sharp!

games.title: Lost Artifacts
games.description: Lost Artifacts — Restore the ancient city and defeat the dark priest!

games.title: Lost Artifacts: Frozen Queen
games.description: Lost Artifacts: Frozen Queen – an exciting strategy game about adventures and archaeological discoveries. Save the world from a global ice age!

games.title: Lost Artifacts: Golden Island
games.description: Lost Artifacts Golden Island is an exciting strategy game about the world of Atlantis. Restore Atlantis and defeat the villain!

games.title: Lost Artifacts: Mysterious Book
games.description:
The team of experienced treasure hunters rushes again to meet adventures!
During a regular inventory at the museum, archaeologist Claire comes across an unfamiliar book with a mysterious lock-puzzle adorned with precious stones.
After unsuccessful attempts to open the book, the girl, in anger, presses a strange mechanism, and all the stones from it fall out immediately!
The museum room quickly changes into a forest with giant trees - the book has taken Claire and the team to its world.
Will the brave treasure hunter be able to find the lost stones and return home?
Embark on a heroic mission with Claire - quench your thirst for adventure and help her find all the stones!
Convenient controls and clear training will help you easily get into the basics of the game.
Embark on an exciting journey through the world of the Enigmatic Book!

games.title: Lost Artifacts: Soulstone
games.description: Lost Artifacts: Soulstone is an exciting strategy game about a world of magic and myth.

games.title: Lost Artifacts: Time Machine
games.description: Lost Artifacts: Time Machine is an exciting strategy game about time traveling. Fix time paradoxes!

games.title: Lost Castle
games.description:
Lost Castle is a super cute, super hard action RPG with roguelike elements and randomized dungeons. Brimming with a host of hand drawn, humorous characters and environments that embrace retro action with modern twists.

Prologue
In its glory days, Castle Harwood was the heart of a happy land governed by wise and virtuous nobles. But those days are long gone now. Calamity has befallen these lands, and wicked magics corrupt the castle and all that surrounds it. Demons have claimed this rotten place for their domain and even the might of the empire is thwarted by their dark army... and slowly, the corruption is spreading. Castle Harwood is lost.

Yet at the heart of this nightmare, something bright glimmers and fills the hearts of the mighty with the courage needed to invade the castle. The Lost Castle is filled with the treasure of the defeated Earl and it is the promise of riches that calls you. And maybe you can do some good, too.

Key Features:
- Up to four players online and local!
- Four player Co-Op or PVP Mode
- Daily Challenges for you and your fellow Treasure Hunters!
- Randomly generated dungeons, items, enemies and bosses.
- Hardcore retro action inspired by classic beat ‘em ups.
- Gorgeous hand drawn characters and environments.
- 100+ items and 60+ potions with useful, dangerous or hilarious effects.
- 190+ weapons and more than 60+ sets of armor.
- Massive variety of skills and special attacks.
- Sacrifice dead heroes to gain new abilities.

games.title: Lost Chiko 2
games.description:
The 2nd game in the Lost Chiko series, this time with a different adventure, a different story and a different gameplay!
One day while we were sleeping under a tree, a bird comes and tells us that our mother has been kidnapped.

games.title: Lost Ember
games.description: Explore the remains of a fallen world from fascinating perspectives! Slip into the role of different animals to uncover the fate of an ancient world. Dive into deep waters, fly at lofty heights, dig underground as a mole or even climb steep cliffs with a mountain goat, there are lots of ways of getting around.

games.title: Lost Epic
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Indie
games.description: LOST EPIC is a 2D side-scrolling action RPG about a war between gods and humanity. The player becomes the deity-defying knight, God Slayer, and explores the world known as Sanctum to bring the Pantheon of Six to their knees.

games.title: Lost Grimoires 2: Shard of Mystery
games.description: Stop a terrible curse!

games.title: Lost Grimoires 3: The Forgotten Well
games.description: Save the kingdom from curse! Travel through 26 hand painted locations! Use alchemy to lead your investigation! Solve 26 minigames! Traverse the Kingdom on horseback and a raft! Learn the long hidden secret of people and elves!

games.title: Lost Grimoires Bundle
games.description:
Take a deep dive into the extraordinary world of Lost Grimoires in two engrossing adventures! Help the young alchemist to finish her training and uncover the truth about her parents, who vanished mysteriously amid political turmoil. Become the advisor of House Griff and embark on a dangerous mission to save Prince Fern, the young heir to the throne, from the clutches of dark magic.

This bundle includes:
Lost Grimoires: Stolen Kingdom
Lost Grimoires 2: Shard of Mystery

games.title: Lost Grimoires: Stolen Kingdom
games.description: Master alchemy to heal the kingdom!

games.title: Lost Hellden
games.description: Lost Hellden is a unique 3D hand-painted J-RPG from Artisan Studios, enhanced by dynamic lighting and weather effects. Follow Cyphel and his allies as a mature story unfolds. Customize your characters as you see fit and dive into a battle system that mixes action and strategy.

games.title: Lost In Fantaland
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Adventure, Indie, Card & Board Game
games.description: Lost In Fantaland is a retro pixel-style roguelite game that blends deck building and turn-based strategies on a checkerboard.

games.title: Lost in Play
games.description: Go on a feel-good adventure with a brother and sister as they explore dreamscapes and befriend magical creatures. Lost in their imagination, Toto and Gal must stick together and solve puzzles to journey back home. This whimsical puzzle adventure game will make you feel like you're playing a cartoon!

games.title: Lost in Random
games.description: Welcome to the world of Random, a dark kingdom where every citizen’s future is determined by the roll of a dice. Will you be defeated by your fate or embrace chaos and learn to make it work in your favor? Embark on a journey with Even and her sidekick Dicey to play the odds and break the curse of Random.

games.title: Lost Islands
games.description: In an era where warriors clashed face to face with cold steel, 100 outcasts converge on a cursed island in search of glory and gold. Only one will leave through violent close quarter combat with katanas, flintlocks, rapiers, and broadswords.

games.title: Lost Judgment
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description:
Lost Judgment is an action-adventure game that blends detective work, narrative-driven exploration, and dynamic combat. Players take on the role of a private detective investigating cases across urban environments, gathering evidence, tailing suspects, and uncovering hidden connections while engaging in fast-paced fighting encounters.

The game expands on its predecessor with new investigative mechanics, varied side activities, and multiple combat styles that emphasize fluid movement and adaptability. Its structure combines story-focused progression with open-ended exploration, offering a mix of mystery-solving and action.

games.title: Lost Judgment: Detective Essentials Pack
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description:
A DLC pack containing items to enhance the story and side content in the game.

The Detective Essentials Pack contains:

The following additional girlfriends:
•Tsukino Satome, a familiar graphic designer
•Minato Todo, the girl inside the mascot
•Kyoko Hakase, the school nurse

A set of the following six extract recipes and a sample of each extract for single use:
•Extract Recipe: Lightning Blade
•Extract Recipe: Telekinesis
•Extract Recipe: Insta-Flux
•Extra Recipe: Unyielding Wave
•Extract Recipe: Guardian Spirit
•Extract Recipe: Temporal Zen

The following three distinct types of fur varieties for the detective dog:
•White
•Black
•Rust

The following four additional Sega Master System titles
•Fantasy Zone II: The Tears of Opa-Opa
•Global Defense
•SAGAIA / Darius II
•Alien Syndrome

Additional skateboarding pursuits, including:
•Skateboard "Hover Drive"
•Skateboard park "Open Air"

An additional skin for the drone racing minigame:
•Drone frame "Sky Spider"

A challenging super boss for the Gauntlet
•Super Shin Amon

games.title: Lost Judgment: Digital Deluxe Edition
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description:
Lost Judgment is an action-adventure video game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. A sequel to the 2018 game Judgment (a spin-off of the Like a Dragon series), the game focuses on private detective Takayuki Yagami as he investigates a criminal accused of both sexual harassment and murder

Joined by his partner, ex-yakuza Masaharu Kaito, the crime-fighting duo is called on to investigate a seemingly perfect crime whose lead suspect has an airtight alibi. What starts as a tale of revenge reveals a tangled web of conspiracy involving several unlikely factions taking advantage of a broken law system. But as victims pile up and Yagami unravels the truth, he must choose between defending the law or exacting justice.

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes the following in-game content:

-Lost Judgment base game
-Detective Essentials Pack
-School Stories Expansion Pack

games.title: Lost Judgment: Digital Ultimate Edition
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description:
Lost Judgment is an action-adventure video game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. A sequel to the 2018 game Judgment (a spin-off of the Like a Dragon series), the game focuses on private detective Takayuki Yagami as he investigates a criminal accused of both sexual harassment and murder

Joined by his partner, ex-yakuza Masaharu Kaito, the crime-fighting duo is called on to investigate a seemingly perfect crime whose lead suspect has an airtight alibi. What starts as a tale of revenge reveals a tangled web of conspiracy involving several unlikely factions taking advantage of a broken law system. But as victims pile up and Yagami unravels the truth, he must choose between defending the law or exacting justice.

The Digital Ultimate Edition includes the following in-game content:

-Lost Judgment base game
-Detective Essentials Pack
-School Stories Expansion Pack
-Character Story Expansion

games.title: Lost Judgment: School Stories Expansion Pack
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description:
This pack includes activities to deepen the interactions with the school’s clubs.

Additionally, Yagami takes boxing from the ring to the streets as a new fighting style that joins his default martial arts styles.

The School Stories Expansion Pack contains:

Dance Club additions:
•Additional Special Moves
•New Outfit

An additional robot for the robot war minigame:
•Additional Robot: [MB5000/SUPREMACY]

The following items expand the game of School Stories "Bikers":
•The body of the motorcycle [MAXINATOR]
•Additional Course [Urban]

Adds the following sparring partners to the Boxing Gym:
•Sugiura
•Higashi
•Kaito

A new fighting style for Yagami:
•Boxing Battle Style

games.title: Lost Judgment: The Kaito Files
games.description:
Play as the muscle of the Yagami Detective Agency, Masaharu Kaito, and take on a new case that ties up loose ends of his past in The Kaito Files. Kaito brings his own Primal Focus detective techniques and two beastly fighting styles to challenge new foes and crack the case with a distinct Kaito swagger.

Following the events of Lost Judgment, Kaito starts a lucrative case while Yagami is out of town that unexpectedly has him searching for his old flame, Mikiko. Along the way, Kaito encounters a teenager claiming to be their son and team up to uncover the truth behind Mikiko's disappearance.

Now Kaito stands at the crossroads of past and present while up against a syndicate tied to Kamurocho’s criminal underbelly. But why did Kaito and Mikiko split up, and what does this dark fraternity have to do with her?

games.title: Lost Orbit
games.description:
Stranded after his ship is destroyed in deep space, Harrison, a lowly maintenance worker and our hero, must struggle to find his way home...

LOST ORBIT centers around the exploration of space. Players take control of a lone astronaut (Harrison) who sets off on a dangerous journey to rejoin his civilization, armed with only an improvised set of equipment and a relentless spirit. Without the help of his ship, Harrison will need to use the gravitational forces of planets to navigate and propel himself through space.

Set in a world rich with comedy and tragedy, LOST ORBIT is a game filled with risk, loneliness, wonder, and death.

games.title: Lost Orbit: Terminal Velocity
games.description:
Prepare to once again embark on a perilous journey filled with deadly asteroids, orbital boosts and the emptiness of space, but this time escape space pirates and more in Lost Orbit: Terminal Velocity, the definitive version of the fast-paced, dodge ‘em up game from PixelNAUTS Games.

Lost Orbit centers around the exploration of space. Players take control of a lone astronaut who sets off on a dangerous journey to rejoin his civilization, armed with only an improvised set of equipment and a relentless spirit. Without the help of his ship, Harrison will need to use the gravitational forces of planets to navigate and propel himself through space.

Set in a world rich with comedy and tragedy, Lost Orbit is a game filled with risk, loneliness, wonder, and death.

games.title: Lost Region
games.category: Shooter, Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Adventure, Indie
games.description:
Lost Region is a third person survival action game. Game is developing for the XBox One, PS 4 and Windows platforms.
Alpha version of the game will be shown on February 20th 2017.

Key Game Features:
– Large world to explore. You will be able to explore every building and visit any corner of the world with area over 64 sq/km, to loot supplies and
the necessary tools to survive.
– Ability to create clans together with your friend or to join to already existing. Bandit groups, research teams and mercenaries are trying to survive in new cruel world.
– Wide specter of buildings – from little house to huge base with other players and NPCs. Capture, protect, create, destroy. You cannot survive in this world being homeless.
– Choose your path: Bandit, Mechanic, Soldier or just an adventurer. Only you choose your destiny. Do all the best to survive in this world.

games.title: Lost Ruins
games.category: Platform, Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Adventure, Indie
games.description: Lost Ruins is a 2D side-scrolling survival action game, where you play as a young girl that has awoken in a strange and foreign place without her memories. With the aid of weapons, spells and tonics, and the guidance of the magical and mysterious Beatrice, you will explore a dark and dangerous world, battle hideous monsters, and topple incredible bosses.

games.title: Lost Sea
games.description: Lost Sea is an explorative action-adventure game set inside the perilous environment of the Bermuda Triangle. Select your hero and recruit a ragtag crew of survivors who can help you navigate the hazardous island chain. Scour each island for the mysterious tablets you need to navigate the waters of the Lost Sea and venture closer to the mysterious portal, that you hope, will transport you home.

games.title: Lost Sphear
games.description: "The next evolution in this new golden age of JRPG’s arrives with LOST SPHEAR, bringing a fresh take on classic RPG gameplay! A young man, who suffered a phenomenon that he had never seen, faces an ominous power that threatens the fabric of reality. Awaken the power of Memory to restore what was lost! Muster different Memory and craft the world around you in a journey to save the world."

games.title: Lost Twins 2
games.description: A cute puzzle-platformer with a unique mechanic of moving the world itself to create new paths. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op mode to help Ben & Abi navigate this mysterious world. Engage in clever puzzles & overcome obstacles to help them re-unite & find their way back home

games.title: Lost Viking: Kingdom of Women
games.description: While traveling to the East the Vikings fall into a trap. Ragnald is saved by the accompanying wolf and must find his loved ones. The Viking and his companion are forced not only to survive, but properly manage time, space and energy to achieve the goal.

games.title: Lost Wing
games.description: Lost Wing is all about speed, guns, and points. Storm your way through brutally-challenging environments and destroy the mega bosses for a chance to top the leaderboards! Featuring a deep electronic soundtrack and stunning neon sci-fi visuals.

games.title: Lost Words: Beyond the Page
games.description: Lost Words is a 2D narrative adventure game where players move words to solve puzzles. The game features a story written by Rhianna Pratchett and ties the narrative into the gameplay in an unusual way, by having the player running on and interacting with words to solve puzzles.

games.title: Lotus Reverie: First Nexus
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Tactical, Adventure, Indie, Visual Novel
games.description: A visual novel about the end of the world with a focus on time management. Experience battles in original parallel turn-based strategy minigames or classic novel mode. Half of the survivors are not human, and only one pair will survive.

games.title: Loud on Planet X
games.description: Defend your stage with music in this new indie rhythm game featuring Tegan and Sara, CHVRCHES, Lights, Metric, METZ, F*cked Up, HEALTH, Purity Ring, Little Dragon, Austra, Shad, Cadence Weapon, July Talk, Monomyth and more!

games.title: Loud: My Road to Fame
games.description: Get ready to rock & roll with Astrid in a heartwarming music arcade rhythm game.

games.title: Love Chemistry: Sibella's Formula
games.description:
A SFW release of "Lustful Chemistry" for consoles.

Take the role of an unhinged lady chemist in raucous side-scrolling platformer Love Chemistry - Sibella’s Formula! Shoot syringes of your special mind-control formula at weird enemies, from robots and carnivorous plants to roving bookworms, and make your way through tricky corridors in old-school pixel art style!

games.title: Love Clear
games.description: One day Itsuki chased a cat to a water courtyard at the school which is seldom visited by the students. He noticed a girl by the waterside; it was his childhood friend and kouhai Himari. When he called out to her, that was when his colourless days turned vibrant.

games.title: Love Clear: Limited Edition
games.description:
This edition includes the following:

- Love Clear
- B2 Tapestry
- Special Illustration card
- Original Soundtrack
- Acrylic key holder

games.title: Love Eternal
games.description: Wander a castle built of bitter memories in Love Eternal, a psychological horror platformer with devious trials and an unsettling, experimental narrative. Find a way out - or live in Shelter forevermore.

games.title: Love Is All Around
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Indie, Visual Novel
games.description: The player becomes Gu Yi, uses the first-person perspective to immerse himself in meeting six beauties, and embarks on a joyful and sweet love journey with them. Six girls that are charming, innocent, intelligent, wild, sexy, glamorous, who will go to the end with you is up to you to decide.

games.title: Love Is All Around 2
games.description: Intiny proudly presents the official sequel to the Love is All Around series—making a spectacular return! This time, we invite you to step into the treacherous yet enchanting world of ancient martial arts and imperial courts, experiencing an unprecedented, immersive romantic adventure.

games.title: Love Island
games.description: Tired of the hustle and bustle? Take a tour to Love Island! Play this match-three game with RPG elements to seduce all those charming anime girls!

games.title: Love Kuesuto
games.description: Take on the role of an old man whose life is flashing before his eyes. As you awaken, the goddess Aphrodite guides you through four game boards full of romantic trauma and relationship dilemmas.

games.title: Love Live! School Idol Festival: After School Activity - Wai-Wai! Home Meeting!!
games.description: Enjoy live performances from μ's, Aqours, and Saint Snow on a "big screen" with the PlayStation 4's beautiful 3D graphics!

games.title: Love Too Easily
games.description: A sweet kiss memory of last night. Lost cell phone. Three suspects. Become the main character's helper, choose, collect hints and clear the mini-games. A full-scale mystery rom-com interactive movie.

games.title: Love: Fall in Death
games.description:
Love: Fall in Death is an FMV (full-motion video) interactive film game developed by SNR Interactive in Istanbul.
The story follows Kutay, whose personality and fate are shaped by the player’s branching choices as he meets Ayşil in a lively Istanbul bar.
Depending on the choices, the narrative shifts between romantic comedy, drama, supernatural encounters, and light horror.

The game features live-action performances, multiple endings, Quick-Time Events, and a dice-based chance mechanic that affects key decisions.
Originally filmed in Turkish, the game is fully dubbed in twelve languages for its global release.

games.title: LoveChoice
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Adventure, Indie, Visual Novel
games.description: Do you know what love is? This game is trying to give our answer. This game encourages people to have a sensitive and gentle heart. Enjoy!

games.title: Lovecraft's Untold Stories
games.category: Shooter, Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Adventure, Indie, Arcade
games.description: Lovecraft’s Untold Stories is an action RPG with rogue-like elements. Explore, improve your skills and gear, and fight cultists and creatures from the Mythos to stop the Old Ones’ plans in randomly generated levels based on Lovecraft stories. Madness and death await you—but maybe you can delay the inevitable…

games.title: Lovely Crush
games.description: Explore little story about few beautiful catgirls. Here you can relax, forget about all your problems and enjoy with charming relaxing puzzle game.

games.title: Lovely Planet
games.description: With boots of speed on your feet, an infinite supply of bullets for your semi-automatic and the ability to jump over twice your own height, you're well equipped to go up against any enemy on your quest to reach Lovely Planet! Balance between jumping around dodging bullets and taking aim for a better shot at your enemies, don't waste time camping at cover spots and waiting for enemies to pop out - artfully evade the onslaught of bullets and defeat all baddies that stand in your way!

games.title: Lovepical-Poppy!
games.description:
LOVEPICAL-POPPY! is a sweet, comedic visual novel from the beloved Japanese brand SMEE. In this game, you'll find yourself surrounded by a charming cast of heroines, enjoying the delightful and hilarious moments of everyday life together.

This title features a talented team of SMEE's best, with a story penned by Yakamoto Uto, Minase Takumi, Nanao Yuhi, and Nakajima Taiga. Hanamaru’s fresh and vibrant art style brings the characters to life, while the adorable chibi art from Ameno Ame adds a touch of lighthearted humor. Under the direction of Yakamoto Uto and production coordination of Asami Akira, the game achieves a perfect balance of character development, narrative progression, and audiovisual experience, offering players a deeply immersive story.

Through a series of strange coincidences, Yaotome Tetsuya finds himself the new manager of an all-girls dormitory. He looks after the residents by cooking their meals and tending to their daily needs, all while working a part-time job at the dorm's attached crepe café. This charming café, located on the first floor to give the girls real-world experience, becomes a place where he shares the sweet and sour moments of work life alongside them in their cute uniforms.

His tireless efforts do not go unnoticed, and the heroines come to hold his kindness deep in their hearts. And when so many bright personalities live together under one roof, isn't it inevitable that a single spark will ignite a flame?

games.title: LoveR
games.description:
Romance... Record.
A new love is starting.
Summer in senior high school.
An encounter with 6 girls... and love happens.

games.title: LoveR Kiss
games.description: The “R” in LoveR stands for “Romance” and “Record.” Players will develop their love with six girl characters designed by Taro Mino and take pictures of their memories. In addition to the six charming girls, the chemistry teacher Himari Saiki has been added as a romantic interest. The theme of her route is "experiments in love".

games.title: Lovers in a Dangerous Spacetime
games.category: Shooter, Puzzle, Simulator, Adventure, Indie, Arcade
games.description: Lovers in a Dangerous Spacetime is a frantic 1- or 4-player couch co-op action space shooter set in a massive neon battleship. Only through teamwork can you triumph over the evil forces of Anti-Love, rescue kidnapped space-bunnies, and avoid a vacuumy demise. Deep space is a dangerous place, but you don’t have to face it alone!

games.title: Lovish
games.category: Platform, Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure, Indie, Arcade
games.description: Lovish is an outrageous 8-bit action-adventure game! Quest with Sir Solomon through a series of bite-sized rooms, as he attempts to free Princess Tsuna, the woman he loves, from the Devil Lord's clutches!

games.title: Low Story
games.description: Low gets thrown from the top floor of a building, and he falls into the dark world. After his fall, Low wants to return but he finds the door locked by Red One The World Keeper. Thus, Low starts looking for the key hoping revenge.

games.title: Lucha Align
games.description:
Get ready for the most exciting fight of your life in Lucha Align, the puzzle game where every piece is a luchador ready for action! Your mission is clear: fit the champions and completely fill the ring to claim victory in style.

With 40 levels full of action, each match brings new shapes, new challenges, and even more excitement. From the first training sessions to the ultimate battles, you’ll need strategy, quick thinking, and the spirit of a champion to master every grid and earn the special stars.

games.title: Lucid
games.description: Discover your own legend in Lucid. Platform through a crystalline world torn apart by calamity, absorb powerful abilities that expand movement and enhance combat against a diverse cast of enemies and bosses, all in gorgeous pixel art inspired by the golden age of 2D sidescrollers.

games.title: Lucid Cycle
games.description: Lucid Cycle offers a set of short but unique experiences.

games.title: Luck be a Landlord
games.category: Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Indie, Arcade, Card & Board Game
games.description: Luck be a Landlord is a roguelike deckbuilder about using a slot machine to earn rent money and defeat capitalism. This game does not contain any real-world currency gambling or microtransactions.

games.title: Luckslinger
games.description:
In Luckslinger, luck is measurable, collectable and usable whenever you please.

On one half it’s inspired by the unrealistically fast gunslingers, the dark gritty humor and the greed driven anti-heroes of the spaghetti western classics.

On the other half it’s inspired by vinyl digging, graffiti spraying, rhyming and the slow drums and jazzy samples of hip hop culture and sound.

games.title: Lucky Drop
games.description: Lucky Drop is a fun game of chance where you release balls and watch where they land. The path through obstacles is always different, and each launch brings excitement and the challenge to score as many points as possible. A perfect game to relax and test your luck – simple, fast, and addictive!

games.title: Lucky Slots
games.description: Lucky Slot is a single player quick-play game that is fun for all the family - keeping Vegas-style slots in a fun and safe way for all.

games.title: Lucy Dreaming
games.description: Lucy Dreaming is inspired and influenced by the classic 90s point & click adventure games, from its beautifully-realised pixel-art style to its irreverent, sarcastic humour. Delve into Lucy’s ever-expanding world as you explore a rich narrative, solve satisfying puzzles and discover hidden Easter eggs.

games.title: Ludo XXL
games.description: This classic game par excellence has brought young and old together for generations. The much-loved original, with its child-friendly rules and thrilling luck of the dice is now finally available for Nintendo Switch. It’s great fun for the whole family – full of both laughter and frustration!

games.title: Ludo XXL 2
games.description: Prepare to keep (or lose) your temper online!

games.title: Lulu's Temple
games.description: Lulu’s Temple is a mysterious retro dungeon crawler about an archeologist venturing deep inside a horrifying pyramid with only his torch and gun to protect him.

games.title: Lumberjack's Dynasty
games.description: In Lumberjack’s Dynasty you can build your own empire around the fascinating resource of wood. Forests full of trees are waiting to be cultivated, harvested and turned into different products to make your business grow.

games.title: Lumines Remastered
games.description: Lumines Remastered brings minimalism to the puzzle genre where the fusion of light and sound sets the stage for a two-color falling block experience playable on-the-go on Nintendo Switch or at home in 4K on PC and consoles. Groove to electronic jams while strategically dropping blocks before the BPM bar sweeps combos clean after each measure. It’s a stylish game perfect to play anywhere or at anytime."

games.title: Lumini
games.description: Lumini is a relaxing flow adventure game in which you take control over a swarm of innocent little creatures called lumini. After being gone for thousands of years, the balance on their home planet has shifted. With their return, the lumini find themselves in a hostile environment from which you need to keep them safe. On this journey you'll need to find out what happened in the past while trying to restore the balance on their planet. Using their special bond with the planet's energy, the lumini can replenish their swarm to replace their fallen comrades. Evolving their kind into an ever adapting and stronger species.

games.title: Lumo
games.description: Witness the rebirth of a genre in Lumo – a classic isometric adventure with a modern twist for gamers young and old alike!

games.title: Lumote: The Mastermote Chronicles
games.description: Meet Lumote, the squishiest bioluminescent creature, in this beautiful 3D puzzle platformer. Take control of the world’s inhabitants on a quest into the Great Depths to seize control from the Mastermote.
