games.description: "The SNK 40th ANNIVERSARY COLLECTION includes classic titles such as Alpha Mission, Athena, Crystalis, Ikari Warriors, Ikari Warriors II: Victory Road, Ikari Warriors III: The Rescue, Guerilla War, P.O.W., Prehistoric Isle, Psycho Soldier, Street Smart, TNK III, and Vanguard - with more titles to be announced! Get the complete experience by playing both the arcade and home console versions on many of these titles!"

games.title: SNK Heroines: Tag Team Frenzy
games.description: Play as iconic heroines from SNK’s history in a new, two-on-two tag-team fighting game. Players can activate a variety of Special Moves with the press of a button, and make use of special items to turn the tide of battle. One of the competitors will be Yuri Sakazaki from ACA NEOGEO Art of Fighting 2, which launches today in Nintendo eShop on Nintendo Switch. SNK HEROINES ~Tag Team Frenzy~ launches on Nintendo Switch this summer.

games.title: SNK Heroines: Tag Team Frenzy - Diamond Dream Edition
games.description:
Diamond Dream Edition Includes:

- SNK HEROINES Tag Team Frenzy for Nintendo Switch or PlayStation 4
- Deluxe Hardcover Artbook
- 2-Disc OST
- Lapel Pin Set
- Sleeveless shirt (Size L)
- Fatal Cutie Cap
- Workout Towel (12" x 42")
- Wrist Sweatband
- Deluxe Collector's Box

games.title: SNK Heroines: Tag Team Frenzy - Miss X
games.description: This content adds MissX from SNK Gals' Fighters. Download the v1.30 patch to unlock her as a playable character.

games.title: SNK vs. Capcom: SVC Chaos
games.description:
SNK and CAPCOM legends clash in this star-studded crossover fighting game!
The 2003 arcade hit SVC CHAOS is back and better than ever!

SVC CHAOS—a dream match of epic proportions! Worlds collide as 36 iconic characters across various series from SNK (mainly THE KING OF FIGHTERS) and CAPCOM (mainly STREET FIGHTER) do battle in a frantic fight to the finish! Brand-new rollback netcode and tournament modes allow for fun, fast-paced online matches—all while still retaining the classic visuals and controls of the original fan favorite. Also comes with a hitbox viewer and a gallery mode! Rise up and throw down with players all around the world in this new evolution of the SVC CHAOS legacy!

games.title: Snooker 19
games.description: This is the most authentic simulation of the sport ever created, with TV-style presentation and commentary, true-to-life physics and advanced artificial intelligence.

games.title: Snooker Blitz
games.description:
Play snooker friends for free in Snooker Blitz. The only online snooker game you ever need.

The world is ready for a truly unique snooker game! Challenge your friends, enter snooker tournaments, and go head to head against other players in real-time. Shoot snooker with ultra-realistic physics, breath-taking graphics, and have more fun than you’ve ever had in real life!

games.title: Snooker Nation Championship
games.description: Dream of playing in the World Snooker Championship? Indulge your snooker fix, and play along with the televised version of the sport with Snooker Nation Championship

games.title: Snoot Booper
games.description: Meet the Snoots behind the Snoot franchise. You can Boop the Snoot to get points.

games.title: Snoot Runner
games.description: Chase the burgers to unlock new friends. Experience the world of Puppolonia as a canine running through the capital city of Puppolonia collecting burgers. The player will collect letters to learn to spell various words related to canines. The player will jump and dodge obstacles in the course on the city streets while collecting power ups, letters, and burgers.

games.title: Snow Battle Princess Sayuki
games.description: Sayuki, a cute and powerful snow goddess is on a quest to save her beloved human boy, from the evil curse of the demon! An exciting, retro style, scrolling shooter. Go to the world of Japanese myth!

games.title: Snow Bros. Classic Collection
games.description:
It’s always more fun to throw a snowball than to be hit by one!

Toaplan‘s hit Snow Bros. is back! This arcade-style, fixed-screen platformer follows brothers Nick and Tom through epic levels in the Kingdom of Hottoda to save two trapped princesses, each possessing the magic of snow… and the only hope for the realm. As evil King Atchich seeks to take over the world, the snowmen we love must set out to storm the enemy’s fortress and rescue their princesses!

Shoot snow at your enemies, picking up items to enhance your fighting, from speed enhancements to shot powerups, becoming giant, and more. Each level features not only enemies but a boss fight, with unique characters to size up and snowball!

Whether you have loved them since the 90s or are just discovering the snowy goodness now, Snow Bros. will show you exactly why it’s such a timeless game.

Included Games:

Snow Bros.
Snow Bros.: Nick & Tom
Snow Bros. Jr.

games.title: Snow Bros. Wonderland
games.description: Boasting gorgeous 3D isometric graphics, Snow Bros. Wonderland has the brothers defending Snow Land from The Great King of Evil! Armed with an endless supply of ice pellets, gamers can turn monsters into snowballs which can be kicked to destroy a whole horde of enemies! Chain your attacks to defeat several bad guys at once and use your snowball skills to take down massive bosses.

games.title: Snow Madness
games.description:
This game provides an easy-to-play and fluent experience to player/players through both "Single-Player" and "Local 2-Player" mods.
In order to succeed in levels, you will need to get rid of unique enemies with your snowballs.
Snow Madness brings fun and competitiveness together and makes you experience an old-school atari game sensation.
Select the appropriate difficulty level and start to have fun!

games.title: Snow Moto Racing Freedom
games.description: Snow Moto Racing Freedom lets you take your rightful place on a high-speed snowmobile on Snocross tracks or through vast beautiful winter landscapes. Experience the thrill of racing so close to your opponents that you can feel the spray of the snow and hear the roar of their engines. Carve your own chosen path through exotic sceneries while stringing together extreme stunts high up in the air to gain that extra speed boost to fly past your opponents.

games.title: Snow Moto: Racing Adventure
games.description: Rev your snowmobile through crisp mountain air, conquering treacherous terrains with thrilling speed.

games.title: Snowboard Legends
games.description: Get ready for a thrilling snowboarding adventure! This game lets you ride through 12 exciting tracks filled with jumps, sharp turns, and breathtaking snowy landscapes. Race down steep slopes, carve through icy forests, and discover hidden shortcuts.

games.title: SnowRunner
games.description:
SnowRunner is an off-road driving simulation game that focuses on navigating challenging terrain using a variety of heavy vehicles. Players complete contracts and objectives across open environments, transporting cargo while overcoming mud, snow, rivers, and other natural obstacles.
The game emphasizes realistic physics, vehicle customization, and route planning, with progression tied to upgrading equipment and expanding a fleet suited for different conditions.

games.title: SnowRunner: 1-Year Anniversary Edition
games.description:
The 1-Year Anniversary Edition includes the base game SnowRunner and its Year 1 Pass.

Get ready for the next-generation off-road experience!

The game puts you in the driver’s seat of powerful vehicles as you conquer extreme open environments with the most advanced terrain simulation ever. Drive 40 vehicles from brands such as Ford, Chevrolet, and Freightliner as you leave your mark on an untamed open world.

Overcome mud, torrential waters, snow, and frozen lakes while taking on perilous contracts and missions. Expand and customize your fleet with many upgrades and accessories including an exhaust snorkel for heavy waters or chain tires to battle the snow.

Ride solo or with friends in 4-player co-operative multiplayer!

games.title: SnowRunner: 3-Year Anniversary Edition
games.description: Get ready for the ultimate off-road experience!Drive over 60 powerful vehicles and overcome extreme open environments.SnowRunner&rsquos 3-Year Anniversary Edition includes the base game as well as the Year 1, Year 2 and Year 3 Passes.

games.title: SnowRunner: 4-Year Anniversary Edition
games.description:
The ultimate off-road experience!

Drive over 70 powerful vehicles and overcome extreme open environments. SnowRunner's 4-Year Anniversary Edition includes the base game as well as the Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 and Year 4 Passes.

games.title: SnowRunner: 5-Year Anniversary Edition
games.description: SnowRunner's 5-Year Anniversary Edition includes the base game as well as the Year 1, Year 2, Year 3, Year 4 and Year 5 Passes.

games.title: SnowRunner: Clasico Pack
games.description:
Tear up the frontier with the Clasico Pack, granting you a new vehicle, the ferocious Chevrolet Apache 6x6, and its blazing blue alternate skin.

This classic six-wheeled pickup can conquer all kinds of dangerous terrain, excelling at deep mud and water thanks to its unique weight distribution and sizeable fuel tank.

games.title: SnowRunner: Dragon Wagons Dual Pack
games.description: The Dragon Wagons Dual Pack brings 2 new trucks to your garage: the Heavy-class Avenhorn A15 and the Heavy Duty-class Padera STD-4 - as well as unique add-ons!

games.title: SnowRunner: Freightliner & Western Star Dual Pack
games.description:
The Freightliner & Western Star Dual Pack brings two new trucks to your SnowRunner garage: the Heavy Duty-class Freightliner FLD 120 and Heavy-class Western Star 6900XD.

This DLC is not included in the Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 or Year 4 Passes.

games.title: SnowRunner: GMC Brigadier
games.description: Expand your SnowRunner garage further with the GMC Brigadier DLC, bringing you the brawny GMC Brigadier as well as an exclusive alternate skin. This gas-guzzling juggernaut, upgradable with all-wheel drive and differential lock, will provide extraordinary power and torque to your most daunting missions!

games.title: SnowRunner: Jeep Dual Pack
games.description: Expand your SnowRunner garage with the Jeep Dual Pack, bringing you two new iconic scouts from the legendary brand: The Wrangler-Rubicon and the CJ-7 “Renegade”. These light-weight, time-tested scouts from Jeep have earned their place in any endeavour to conquer the wilderness.

games.title: SnowRunner: Kenworth Dual Pack
games.description: The Kenworth Dual Pack brings two new Kenworth trucks to your SnowRunner garage - the Highway-class T880 and the Heavy Duty-class C500 - as well as one vinyl wrap for each.

games.title: SnowRunner: Land Rover Dual Pack
games.description: Upgrade your SnowRunner vehicle collection with the Land Rover Dual Pack, bringing two generations of the legendary Land Rover Defender, faithfully rebuilt for the first time in SnowRunner.

games.title: SnowRunner: Mack Dual Pack
games.description: The Mack Dual Pack brings two new trucks to your SnowRunner garage: the Highway-class Mack TerraPro and Heavy Duty-class Mack Pinnacle.

games.title: SnowRunner: Mercedes-Benz Trucks Dual Pack 1
games.description:
Mercedes-Benz makes its SnowRunner debut!
Expand your fleet of off-road heavy duty specialists with the Mercedes-Benz Trucks Dual Pack 1, granting you the Mercedez-Benz Actros 3332 and Mercedez-Benz Zetros.

games.title: SnowRunner: Navistar 5000-MV Tractor
games.description:
Expand your SnowRunner experience with the Navistar 5000-MV tractor!

This Heavy Equipment Transport Truck is a powerful hauler that was used to transport tanks and other military equipment across dangerous and uneven terrain.

games.title: SnowRunner: Pathfinders Vinyl Wrap Pack
games.description: Requires the base game SnowRunner to run. The Pathfinders Vinyl Wrap Pack adds four exclusive skins for the ANK MK38, KHAN Lo4F, Azov 64131 and KOLOB 74941 trucks. This Pack is included in the Year 5 Pass.

games.title: SnowRunner: Premium Edition
games.description: Get ready for the next-generation off-road experience! The Premium Edition includes the base game SnowRunner and its Season Pass.

games.title: SnowRunner: Rezvani Hercules
games.description: Expand your SnowRunner garage further with the Rezvani Hercules, a high-performance 6-wheel Scout truck with a fierce and unique modern look.

games.title: SnowRunner: Salt of the Earth Vinyl Wrap Pack
games.description: The Salt of the Earth Vinyl Wrap Pack adds four exclusive skins for the ANK MK38, International Paystar 5070, Caterpillar CT681 and Western Star 6900 TwinSteer trucks. This Pack is included in the Year 4 Pass and immediately available upon purchase.

games.title: SnowRunner: Scorched Vinyl Wrap
games.description:
Explore SnowRunner in style with the unique Scorched Vinyl Wrap for the Chevrolet CK 1500.

The Scorched Vinyl Wrap adds a fiery burst look to the Chevrolet CK 1500.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 1 - Search & Recover
games.description: Season 1 for SnowRunner that adds the region Kola Peninsula with two new winter maps, new vehicles and cosmetics.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 10 - Fix & Connect
games.description: Season 10 is included in the Year 3 Pass for SnowRunner. A storm has shaken western Canada, wreaking havoc all over and cutting off power. Reconnect British Columbia's grid and its crucial infrastructures with 2 new trucks across 2 new summer maps.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 11 - Lights & Cameras
games.description:
Season 11 is included in the Year 3 Pass for SnowRunner.

Action! Support the production of an exciting action movie deep in the valleys of Scandinavia and help a ski resort prepare for the next winter season with 2 new trucks across 2 new winter maps.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 12 - Public Energy
games.description: Season 12: Public Energy is included in the Year 3 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run. North Carolina's state government needs you to assist in the establishment of a nuclear power station and to help local farmers cultivate their crops.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 13 - Dig & Drill
games.description: Season 13: Dig & Drill is included in the Year 4 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.Authorities in Almaty need your help to kickstart a new mining venture! With 2 new vehicles, run surveys, deliver equipment and reopen a cargo airport.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 14 - Reap and Sow
games.description:
Season 14: Reap & Sow is included in the Year 4 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

Austrian officials need you to renovate their region's Renaissance castle and kickstart a new season of farming with 4 vehicles across two new 4km² maps.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 15 - Oil & Dirt
games.description:
Oil & Dirt is Season 15 of SnowRunner. Included in the Year 4 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

Québec is bursting with exciting projects, and they need you to construct an oil platform by delivering building materials and a massive anchor. Link roads together to form a new highway network, help organize a major fishing festival and more, with 2 new trucks across 2 brand new maps.

Season 15: Oil & Dirt includes:

• Two new 4km² maps set in Québec, Canada. Complete new missions across a new winter region traversed by tall mountains and frozen rivers.
• Two new vehicles: the Sleiter ST 816 “Elephant”, a 6-wheel Heavy Duty tractor able to pull even the heaviest loads, and the Mercer K520, an agile and versatile Off-road truck with exceptional capabilities in exploration and rescue scenarios.
• New activities: Help Québec companies with major infrastructure projects after the Canadian winter had them grind to halt, and celebrate the region’s angling industry by helping organize a major fishing festival.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 16 - High Voltage
games.description: Welcome to Washington! High Voltage tasks you with building a hydropower plant across 3 large maps with the help of 3 new trucks. Season 16 is SnowRunner’s fourth expansion and is included in the Year 4 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 17 - Repair & Rescue
games.description: Welcome to Zurdania! Breathe new life into the region by helping locals rehabilitate fields, renovate historical landmarks and boost tourism. Season 17: Repair & Rescue is included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 18 - Patch & Power
games.description: Patch & Power Season of Snowrunner. Included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 19 - Research & Restore
games.description: Research & Restore Season of Snowrunner. Included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 2 - Explore & Expand
games.description: Season 2 for SnowRunner that adds the Yukon region with two new maps, three vehicles and cosmetics.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 20
games.description: Season 20 of Snowrunner. Included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 3 - Locate & Deliver
games.description: Season 3 for SnowRunner that adds The Wisoncsin region with two new maps, thee vehicles, cosmetics as well as new truck addons and trailers for loading and carrying logs.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 4 - New Frontier
games.description:
Elevate your SnowRunner experience to new heights with the New Frontiers expansion, the game’s biggest and most ambitious addition, and the last installment of the Year 1 Pass.

Rebuild roads, fuel lines, and various buildings to bring an old soviet rocket launchpad back to life in Amur Oblast, a huge new winter region with four 4km² maps. Using powerful new vehicles, haul the massive rocket to the launch pad yourself.

The New Frontiers expansion is available as part of the Year 1 Pass, or as a standalone purchase.

New Frontiers includes:
· A new primary objective adding hours of gameplay through new missions to rebuild an old soviet rocket launchpad
· Four large maps in Amur Oblast, a new Russian winter region.
· Two new vehicles, including the ZiKZ 605-R, and the Khan 317 Sentinel scout vehicle.
· New addons
· New exclusive skins and cosmetics, including vehicle skins and stickers.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 5 - Build & Dispatch
games.description: Expand your SnowRunner experience with Season 5: Build & Dispatch. Restore an old Tatra factory in Rostov Oblast, Russia, with two new maps to explore alongside two new Tatra vehicles.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 6 - Haul & Hustle
games.description: Haul & Hustle is the sixth content expansion pack for SnowRunner.

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 7 - Compete & Conquer
games.description:
The Season 7: Compete & Conquer DLC is included in the Year 2 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

Race in exciting trials with Season 7: Compete & Conquer. This season introduces two brand new vehicles and a map set in Tennessee, USA, bringing a whole new playground packed with activities. Challenge your friends in intense racing challenges, or go alone in time-trial events!

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 8 - Grand Harvest
games.description:
Including 4 summer themed maps in a brand new region.

“Grand Harvest” is focused on farming, and to help you complete this task, 3 new vehicles will be at your disposal: the Kirovets K-700, a four wheel drive tractor with impressive power for its size; its modern version the K7M to help you plow all types of fields; and the Step 39331 ‘Pike’, a fine choice for all the transportation duties!

games.title: SnowRunner: Season 9 - Renew & Rebuild
games.description: This product is included in the Year 3 Pass for SnowRunner. Devastated by ravaging wildfires, Ontario counts on you in Season 9: Renew & Rebuild. Clear logs from fallen trees, secure the buildings and bring materials to renovate burnt infrastructures.

games.title: SnowRunner: Tatra Dual Pack
games.description: Expand and bring even more versatility to your SnowRunner fleet with the Tatra Dual Pack, giving you access to the iconic Tatra 813 and Tatra 805!

games.title: SnowRunner: The Atom
games.description: The SnowRunner garage expands once more with the Azov 67096-3N “Atom”! This Heavy-class truck features a modern engine, always-on differential lock and all-wheel drive capability. This DLC is not included in the Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 or Year 4 Pass.

games.title: SnowRunner: The Mastodon
games.description: Expand your vehicle collection with The Mastodon DLC to receive the ZikZ 612H "Mastodon", a super-large, super-heavy beast of a truck with 3 built-in trailer slots! The Mastodon DLC is not included in the Year 1, Year 2 or Year 3 Pass.

games.title: SnowRunner: Western Star 49X
games.description:
Tear up the dirt with The All New Western Star 49X, an additional vehicle for SnowRunner!

This modern heavy duty truck is a beast off the road and is no stranger to the mud. With its controllable extra axle, the 49X can navigate the worst road conditions while carrying all but the heaviest loads.

games.title: SnowRunner: Western Star Wolf Pack
games.description: This content requires the base game SnowRunner on Steam in order to play.Expand your SnowRunner garage with the Wolf Pack, a collection of Western Star&rsquos latest and most versatile trucks! Get the 57X, the 47X and a 47X variant, as well as exclusive cosmetics in a single DLC!Not included in the Year 1 Pass or Year 2 Pass.

games.title: SnowRunner: Year 1 Pass
games.description: Expand your SnowRunner experience with the Year 1 Pass, granting you access to the exclusive Sabertooth skin for the Heavy Duty Derry Longhorn 4520, as well as new vehicles, new skins, new missions, new maps to explore and more.

games.title: SnowRunner: Year 2 Pass
games.description: Expand your SnowRunner experience with the Year 2 Pass and gain access to four phases of new content released in the future, with new vehicles, new maps, add-ons and more!

games.title: SnowRunner: Year 3 Pass
games.description: Expand your SnowRunner experience with the Year 3 Pass! This gives you access to four phases of content, including new vehicles, new skins, new missions, new maps to explore and more!

games.title: SnowRunner: Year 4 Pass
games.description: The Year 4 Pass allows you to expand your SnowRunner experience by granting you access to four seasons of content, including new vehicles, new skins, new missions, new maps to explore and more.

games.title: SnowRunner: Year 5 Pass
games.description: The Year 5 Pass allows you to expand your SnowRunner experience by granting you access to four seasons of content, including new vehicles, new skins, new missions, new maps to explore and more.

games.title: Snowsquall Grip
games.description: Escape the snowy nightmare or be trapped forever — your call.

games.title: Snwbrd: Freestyle Snowboarding
games.description: Snwbrd - Is a Snowboard Game like AMPED and inspired by the AMPED Original Xbox Game, an action-packed, open-world snowboarding game that lets players experience the thrill and freedom of shredding the slopes.

games.title: So Many Me
games.description:
You play as an unassuming green blob named Filo, who has an incredible ability: to control his many, many clones -- referred to as the “ME”. These clones possess all sorts of fun abilities that can be used to solve puzzles throughout the game. As you progress further through Filo’s adventure, you will find a variety of new types of clones. Understanding and harnessing their unique powers are key to your success.

Filo’s myriad of adventures take him to a whimsical universe. It features a colorful art genre filled with adorable characters in their world’s mysterious environment.

games.title: Soccer Golf!
games.description: Kick a hole in one!

games.title: Soccer Kick-ups
games.description: Take on the challenge and become the king of kick-ups.

games.title: Soccer Kid Collection
games.description:
Recover the Stolen World Cup Trophy in this Stylish 16-Bit Action Game!

When an alien collector destroys the World Cup, it’s up to a boy and his soccer ball to save the day. Soccer Kid is a classic platformer that swaps traditional combat for ball skills. Dribble through diverse landscapes, use headers to reach high places, and kick the ball to knock down anyone in your way.

Experience a piece of gaming history with the QUByte Classics edition, featuring two versions of the same game with new features to help you master the most challenging levels!

games.title: Soccer Pinball
games.description: Have a soccer match with your friend or family member on the pinball field! You will try to score as many as possible within 3-minutes to see who is the best. You can see the top 4 high scores and beating them will get harder because after each round, there will be an additional ball in the field! Also your mini audience will always cheer for you.

games.title: Soccer Story
games.category: Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Sport, Adventure, Indie
games.description:
It's been a year since The Calamity tore apart the very foundations of soccer as we know it, and since then, Soccer Inc. has made dang well sure that not a soul has been allowed to even look at a soccer ball, let alone kick it.

Soccer may have been banned across the world... but now there is hope! A magical soccer ball has chosen you, our Savior of Soccer! Soccer Story is a physics-driven adventure RPG, where every problem can be solved with your trusty magic ball.

games.title: Soccer: Breakthrough Gaming Arcade - Challenge Mode Edition
Sociable Soccer 24
games.description: Sociable Soccer 24 is the exhilarating, cross-platform, arcade football franchise. Designed by Sensible Soccer creator Jon Hare, this former title on Apple Arcade has fast-paced, arcade-style intuitive gameplay, with multiplayer head-to-head matches and collectible player cards.

games.title: Sociable Soccer 25
games.description: Embrace the excitement of the world's favorite sport in Sociable Soccer 25. Created by legendary game designer Jon Hare, Sociable Soccer 25 features his signature fast-paced, arcade-style and intuitive gameplay, enriched with multiplayer head-to-head matches and collectible player cards.

games.title: Socketeer
games.description: SOCKETEER is a frantic randomly generated top-down shooter where you play as a small robot that cannot shoot. Instead, the main character must hack into any electronic device and utilize it to survive. Take control of defense robots and blast other enemies away, crack into security door control panels and slam them shut on unsuspecting guards, circumvent data consoles and download map information to help navigate to the exit.

games.title: Sofiya and the Ancient Clan
games.description: Sofiya and the Ancient Clan is a traditional side-scrolling action platformer presented in vibrant pixel art style with fluid animations. Run, jump and cast spells as you traverse hills and forests, caverns, castle walls, graveyards and more. Use your magic to trigger secret switches, make new platforms appear, incapacitate guards or take down vicious ogres, ghosts and a wide variety of other enemy types. Face off against monstrous bosses at the end of each region you clear, and victory will be rewarded with saucy unlockable images to fill your gallery!

games.title: Soft Body
games.description: "Soft Body is a meditative action game where you control two beautiful, gooey snakes at the same time. In the game, you paint the world with your body, and as you do so, the world changes around you and reveals new obstacles and challenges. Although the action is tense, the mood and aesthetic are contemplative and calm."

games.title: Softball: Breakthrough Gaming Arcade - 2 Player Cooperation Edition
games.description:
This game's release is part of Breakthrough Gaming's "Bible Video Game Sundays"!
Purchase and play our new Christian themed video games releasing every Sunday morning in the PlayStation Store today!

games.title: Softball: Breakthrough Gaming Arcade - 3 Player Cooperation Edition
games.description:
This game's release is part of Breakthrough Gaming's "Bible Video Game Sundays"!
Purchase and play our new Christian themed video games releasing every Sunday morning in the PlayStation Store today!

games.title: Softball: Breakthrough Gaming Arcade - 4 Player Cooperation Edition
Sokmeal Time
games.description: Sokmeal Time is a cozy sokoban game where you guide a hungry corgi through handcrafted puzzles. Move empty bowls into place, solve satisfying logic challenges, and watch kibble appear as your reward. With a relaxing flow, playful charm, this is a game that makes every solved puzzle feel like a warm treat.

games.title: Sokobalien
games.description: Do you have what it takes to build the biggest space farm in the galaxy? Help the alien reach this goal in this classic Sokoban puzzle style game! Push cows, sheep, pigs and chicken so that the correct UFO beams can abduct them. (Also, as a side-quest, collect all the hats you can!)

games.title: SokoBunny
games.description: SokoBunny is new fully 3d look at classic sokoban. Play alone or with your friend online, kick the cargo in the warehouse labyrinth.

games.title: Sokocat: Combo
games.description:
Sokocat – Combo, brings two games from the series, Sokocat Islands and Sokocat Dungeon, a puzzle game that requires the player to push stone blocks to the correct position to reach the end of the level.

Sokocat Islands brings a tropical themed adventure; solve minimalist puzzles while listening to the sea and a relaxing soundtrack. Sokocat Dungeon, in the other hand, brings a mysterious adventure, Kitten Jone (the cat) now has to find artifacts in the dungeons of a castle.

Enjoy the Islands, avoid the traps in the Dungeon and keep pushing the blocks to the right spot to succeed. Hope this cat has 9 lives.

games.title: Sokocrab
games.description: Step onto the sandy shores of SokoCrab, a captivating puzzle game where you guide a clever crab through 40 engaging levels. Your mission? Push barrels onto designated spots to clear the path to the next stage, all while navigating a vibrant beach-themed world.

games.title: SokoFrog
games.description: SokoFrog is a puzzle game about pushing boxes, help your frog friend get to the next level.

games.title: SokoLab
games.description: SokoLab is a Sokoban game where you play as a cute robot! Push blocks to the objective to reach the end of the level, new mechanics are introduced throughout the game adding layers of complexity to the puzzles! Can you reach the last level?

games.title: Sokolor
games.category: Puzzle, Strategy, Indie, Card & Board Game
games.description: Sokolor is a sokoban game with innovative mechanics. Push the colored cubes into their correct positions, but first you need to paint yourself the same color to be able to push them!

games.title: SokoMage
games.description: SokoMage is a new top-down puzzle that will push your brain to the limit. Slap rocks, avoid bushes, and hit the crystal to reach the end! Can you smash your way to the final level?

games.title: Sokomine
games.description: Grab your helmet and pickaxe, because Sokomine just got explosive! Every puzzle is a mix of brains and blasts. Push mining carts stuffed with dynamite straight into meteors, blow them to pieces, and collect the shiny crystals hiding inside

games.title: Sokomonster
games.description: Unleash chaos, strategize destruction, and conquer the city - monster style!

games.title: SokoPenguin
games.description: SokoPenguin is a Sokoban-style puzzle game, where you control a penguin who must push boxes to clear the path to its cozy igloo.

games.title: Sokorobot
games.description: In this puzzle game, a robot need to clear paths to unlock new levels!

games.title: SokoWinter
games.category: Platform, Puzzle, Strategy, Indie, Card & Board Game
games.description: Save the winter pushing the ice blocks in the water altars in this sokoban game.

games.title: Sol Cresta
games.description:
DOCK, SPLIT, and FORM UP!
Pilot three ships and free the solar system from the clutches of evil in this free-form shooting game!

PlatinumGames’ NEO-CLASSIC ARCADE series carries on the spirit and fun of classic gaming using modern technology, and the first project in this endeavor is Sol Cresta. Sol Cresta takes the docking and formation strategies of classic shooting games Moon Cresta and Terra Cresta and elevates them with the “free-form docking” system. The flagship Yamato, composed of the ships Amaterasu, Tsukuyomi, and Susano can utilize various attacks depending on how the three ships are aligned. Docking, splitting, and reforming the ships as needed is the key to defeating the invading armies of Mandler.

games.title: Sol Divide: Sword of Darkness
games.description: Vorg heard a rumour that the army of Satan was searching for treasures called Seirei stones, which led him to think that the time for revenge has come.

games.title: Sol Dorado Heist
games.description: Choose your path and solve the mystery of the Sol Dorado Heist!

games.title: Solar Ash
games.description: Journey through a surreal, vivid and highly stylized world filled with mystery, wild high-speed traversal, endearing characters, and massive enemy encounters. The Void beckons…

games.title: Solar Machina
games.description: Solar Machina is a vibrant 2D pixel art platformer where you control a robot on a colorful journey through tropical landscapes filled with traps and enemies. As you progress, your robotic suit evolves, granting new movement abilities that transform how you play. With smooth controls, distinct biomes, and a nostalgic chiptune soundtrack, Solar Machina offers a satisfying blend of challenge, rhythm, and exploration that keeps engagement from start to finish.

games.title: Solaroids
games.description:
Solaroids is a re-imagined version of the classic Asteroids as a single or local multiplayer shooter that retains the essential premise that inertia is the missing ingredient of many modern top down shooters.

Fly solo or with up to three of your friends against a seemingly insurmountable threat. Defend your solar system in a Campaign that progresses from tame introductory levels to epic high-octane space battles that will challenge even the most experienced pilots. As the campaign progresses and the threat continues to grow, so will the kinds of weapons at your disposal.

While each player competes for high scores individually, each must choose their own path; whether to be friend or foe, work together or individually, fight or flee. Each player can customize their ship colors and join or leave the game at any time. As participants come and go, the action never stops.

Solaroids: Prologue will continue to evolve with input continuously gathered from players in the community, as it makes its way to an official release as Solaroids!

games.title: Solaroids: Prologue
games.description:
Solaroids is a re-imagined version of the classic Asteroids as a single or local multiplayer shooter that retains the essential premise that inertia is the missing ingredient of many modern top down shooters.

Fly solo or with up to three of your friends against a seemingly insurmountable threat. Defend your solar system in a Campaign that progresses from tame introductory levels to epic high-octane space battles that will challenge even the most experienced pilots. As the campaign progresses and the threat continues to grow, so will the kinds of weapons at your disposal.

While each player competes for high scores individually, each must choose their own path; whether to be friend or foe, work together or individually, fight or flee. Each player can customize their ship colors and join or leave the game at any time. As participants come and go, the action never stops.

Solaroids: Prologue will continue to evolve with input continuously gathered from players in the community, as it makes its way to an official release as Solaroids!

games.title: Solbrain: Knight of Darkness
games.description:
The old gods have forgotten this land (Cannae). No one could save our people when darkness began to spread and collect the souls of men for his army.
Solbrain - Knight of Darkness is a 3D exploration game.

games.title: Soldam: Drop, Connect, Erase
games.description: Play one of the original tile-matching games from the 90’s. Dispatch Games brings back the Jaleco arcade classic with, Soldam: Drop, Connect, Erase. The game has been refreshed with updated graphics and gameplay, but retains its arcade charm with its catchy music and unique style that have been fan favorites for many years.

games.title: Solid Void Art Nonograms
games.description: A great collection of nonograms! Uncover art hidden within puzzles! Have fun and exercise your brain!

games.title: Solid Void: Nature Puzzles
games.description:
Challenge your mind and creativity!
Solve beautiful puzzles!
Experience a journey of logic and design!

games.title: Solid Void: Topsy Turvy World
games.description:
A Fresh Mix Of Classic Nonogram And Jigsaw Puzzles.
Flex your puzzle skills and master nonogram and jigsaw challenges!

games.title: Solitaire
games.description: The card game that everyone loves. Rediscover the classic card game, finally in a digital version that everyone can play! Arrange the cards from Ace to King in the 3 most popular game modes and spend an enjoyable moment indulging in your favourite pastime. A classic brain-teaser in which you will need all your concentration to earn as many points as possible. Only those making the fewest moves will have their names inscribed at the top of the international rankings.

games.title: Solitaire
games.description: Solitaire is a classic single-player card game based on the traditional Klondike rule set. The objective is to sort a standard 52-card deck into four foundation piles, one for each suit, arranged in ascending order from Ace to King.

games.title: Solitaire TriPeaks Flowers
games.description: In Solitaire TriPeaks Flowers you can play hundreds of levels filled with the most addictive version of solitaire there is! And you can do that along with your trusty cat companion that shall help you along the journey of filling your greenhouses with the most beautiful flowers of all colors! Playful and relaxed experience awaits!

games.title: Solo
games.description:
Solo is a puzzle exploration game in which a sailor is traveling through a vast archipelago, solving puzzles, wondering about love. A personal experience both for puzzle lovers and creative indie games aficionados.

Solo is a game about love.

About love as fuel, the force that drive us.

It is a universal feeling, but each of us experiences it in a different way. Individually, it holds different meanings depending on a variety of factors such as: culture, gender, sexuality or traumas. That's why Solo will explore this theme in an introspective way, to have the players identify and reflect on their own experiences.

games.title: SolSeraph
games.description:
Retro-inspired tower defense and action platformer SolSeraph reinvents the classics!

As the guardian of humanity, civilization is in your hands. Build your cities and set up defensive structures to protect them from the constant threat of monsters, then descend into their lairs with sword and spells to eliminate them for good. Explore floating islands, ancient caverns, and lost cities. The world is yours!

Brought to you by ACE Team, the creative minds behind Rock of Ages and Zeno Clash, SolSeraph combines action and strategy for a rich and unique gameplay experience reminiscent of the 16-bit era.

games.title: Solstice Chronicles: MIA
games.description: Battle for survival against waves of Martian mutants in this tactical twist on twin-stick shooters. Using the skills of your drone companion, make fight-or-flight decisions that drastically alter the threats you face. Will your choices lead you to freedom... or your doom?

games.title: Soma
games.description:
SOMA is a sci-fi horror game from Frictional Games, the creators of Amnesia: The Dark Descent. It is an unsettling story about identity, consciousness, and what it means to be human.

Enter the world of SOMA and face horrors buried deep beneath the ocean waves. Delve through locked terminals and secret documents to uncover the truth behind the chaos. Seek out the last remaining inhabitants and take part in the events that will ultimately shape the fate of the station. But be careful, danger lurks in every corner: corrupted humans, twisted creatures, insane robots, and even an inscrutable omnipresent A.I. You will need to figure out how to deal with each one of them. Just remember there’s no fighting back, either you outsmart your enemies or you get ready to run.

games.title: Someday You'll Return: Director's Cut
games.description: How far would you go if your daughter didn’t come home? Someday You’ll Return: Director’s Cut is a first-person psychological horror. This story-driven game offers enhanced features, an improved story, and additional content. Enter the woods if you dare and begin a search you’ll never forget.

games.title: Somerville
games.description: Somerville is a science fiction adventure game that follows a family separated in the aftermath of a large-scale catastrophe involving extraterrestrial forces. The story focuses on the personal impact of the invasion as the protagonist searches for a way to reunite with their loved ones. Players navigate a rural environment, solving environmental challenges and uncovering details about the events affecting Earth.

games.title: Sonar Beat
games.description:
In Sonar Beat, your most valuable ally is rhythm. Your super secret nuclear base is under attack and only the most intense musical defense can save it! Boost your senses and launch a counter attack to the music and save your base.

But don’t let your guard down: each new wave will be more intense than the last one, so hang in there as long as you can and keep fighting with your rhythm.

games.title: Song of Horror
games.description: Song of Horror is a psychological horror adventure. Face the manifestations of the Presence, an unpredictable, eldritch AI that reacts to your way of playing: you won't experience two exact gameplays. Death is permanent: you may die, but the horror continues.

games.title: Song of Horror: Deluxe Edition
games.description:
Song of Horror is a psychological horror adventure. Face the manifestations of the Presence, an unpredictable, eldritch AI that reacts to your way of playing: you won't experience two exact gameplays. Death is permanent: you may die, but the horror continues.

Deluxe Edition of Song Of Horror includes:

- Base Game
- Special Sleeve
- Maps Guide
- Characters Guide

games.title: Song of Memories
games.category: Music, Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Adventure, Visual Novel
games.description: Next-generation romance adventure game with the theme of "Ultimate selection and the story that the song plays". In addition to the huge scenario set in the school life, voice recording time of the luxury voice acting team is over 40 hours! In addition, this work contains more than 30 luxurious songs that appearing characters sing, coloring a sweet and painful story with a theme of songs.

games.title: Song of Nunu: A League of Legends Story
games.description:
In this single-player adventure, venture into the idyllic but treacherous world of the Freljord as Nunu, a young boy on a quest to find his lost mother. Unearth the secrets, myths, and legends buried deep in the frozen tundra alongside your best friend, a wise and playful yeti named Willump, and unfold an inspiring story one puzzle at a time.

Developed by Tequila Works, the studio behind RiME, Song of Nunu: A League of Legends StoryTM invites players old and new to experience the League of Legends universe from a fresh lens.

games.title: Song of the Deep
games.description: A metroidvania-style action-adventure game following a young girl’s quest into the unknown to find her missing father.

games.title: Songbird Symphony
games.description: "Songbird Symphony is a 2D musical adventure game depicting the tale of a young bird named Birb as he leaves the safety of his nest to confront the outside world and discover his true identity. Along the way, he encounters other feathery denizens and learns the language of the forest, ultimately unveiling his destiny."

games.title: Songbringer
games.description: Songbringer is a sci-fi, pixel, action-adventure game in which one journeys through procedurally-generated, Zelda-inspired worlds. Along the way one will uncover powerful artifacts and forge them anew. Those skilled with the nanosword will vanquish giants and save a planet from being overrun.

games.title: Sonho TrapStar
games.description: Sonho TrapStar is an action game set in São Paulo dominated by the infected of a new Covid pandemic and a fierce militia that imposes a curfew and has a license to kill anyone on the streets.

games.title: Sonic Colors: Ultimate
games.description: Join Sonic in the high-speed adventure of a lifetime across a colorful interstellar amusement park. Color the Universe in Sonic Colors: Ultimate!

games.title: Sonic Colors: Ultimate - 30th Anniversary Pack
games.description:
The Anniversary Pack contains:

- Base game
- Art book
- OST
- Sonic 30th Anniversary Collector’s Coin

games.title: Sonic Colors: Ultimate - Day One Edition
Sonic Colors: Ultimate - Digital Deluxe
games.description: Join Sonic in the high-speed adventure of a lifetime in Sonic Colors: Ultimate! Digital Deluxe includes the Ultimate Cosmetic Pack and the Ultimate Music Pack. Color the Universe!

games.title: Sonic Colors: Ultimate - Launch Edition
games.description: Join Sonic on an intergalactic journey, fully remastered for a new generation -- with a few new features, too! The launch edition comes with a baby Sonic keychain!

games.title: Sonic Forces
games.description: Fight through a world destroyed by Dr. Eggman and a powerful new villain in Sonic Forces, the new fast-paced action platformer from the team that brought you Sonic Colors and Sonic Generations. Sonic Forces lets you speed through rolling ruined landscapes as Modern Sonic, catapult past perilous platforms as Classic Sonic, and use powerful new gadgets as your own Custom Hero Character.

games.title: Sonic Forces: Bonus Edition
games.description:
Join an epic high-speed fight to save a world decimated by Dr. Eggman and a mysterious villain in the newest game from the team that made Sonic Colors and Sonic Generations. Experience fast-paced action as Modern Sonic, catapult past perilous platforms as Classic Sonic, and use powerful new gadgets as your very own Custom Hero Character.

The Sonic Forces Bonus Edition comes with an exclusive controller skin and awesome in-game costumes for your custom character. The controller skin design transports you into Sonic's universe, featuring Sonic and the mysterious new villain, Infinite. Plus, the costumes from games like Persona 5, Jet Set Radio, Super Monkey Ball, Nights, and will transform your custom character to match characters from these iconic SEGA games. Download the free Episode Shadow add-on when the game launches to fight with Shadow as a playable character!

games.title: Sonic Forces: Episode Shadow
games.description: Outside of the main story missions in Sonic Forces, Episode Shadow is additional story content that is a prequel to the main missions. The three stages are updated levels from the main game, but have been modified for when you play as Shadow the Hedgehog.

games.title: Sonic Forces: Sanic T-Shirt
games.description: Sometimes, you've gotta go fast. These exclusive "Sanic" T-shirts for your custom character features beautifully rendered art, and virtual threads organically grown on the snowing peaks of Mt. Fuji many years ago.

games.title: Sonic Forces: Super Sonic
games.description:
Speed through the levels faster than Sonic... as Super Sonic! Transform into Super Sonic across 20+ Modern and Classic Sonic stages. Collect the right amount of rings and Super Sonic will spring into action, giving you the ability to sprint across stages at break-neck speeds.

Please Note: You cannot participate in the rankings with Super Sonic.

games.title: Sonic Frontiers
games.description:
Worlds will collide in Sonic the Hedgehog’s newest adventure.

An experience like never before, accelerate to new heights and experience the thrill of high velocity open-zone freedom. Battle powerful enemies as you speed through the Starfall Islands - landscapes brimming with dense forests, overflowing waterfalls, sizzling deserts and more!

games.title: Sonic Frontiers x Monster Hunter Pack
games.description: Get some stylish in-game Monster Hunter equipment and play a fun mini-game!

games.title: Sonic Frontiers: Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description:
Worlds will collide in Sonic the Hedgehog’s newest adventure. An experience like never before, accelerate to new heights and experience the thrill of high velocity open-zone freedom. Battle powerful enemies as you speed through the Starfall Islands - landscapes brimming with dense forests, overflowing waterfalls, sizzling deserts and more!

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
• Sonic Frontiers
• Explorer's Treasure Box
• Digital Art Book and Mini Soundtrack

games.title: Sonic Frontiers: Holiday Cheer Suit
games.description:
Bring some holiday spirit to the Starfall Islands with the Holiday Cheer Suit!

The Holiday Cheer Suit can be equipped by accessing the Title Menu and then selecting the EXTRA CONTENT submenu.

games.title: Sonic Frontiers: Sonic Adventure 2 Shoes
games.description:
Take it back to the early 2000s and railgrind in style with your own pair of iconic shoes from Sonic Adventure 2!

This offer is available to our newsletter subscribers in select countries who signed up prior to January 31, 2023.

games.title: Sonic Frontiers: Sonic’s Birthday Bash
games.description: Celebrate Sonic’s birthday on the festively decorated Starfall Islands! Spin dash your way to the party with new challenges, moves, collectible Koco, and New Game+!

games.title: Sonic Frontiers: The Final Horizon
games.description: Rewrite your destiny in The Final Horizon Update! Experience a new story, new playable characters, new challenges, and more in Sonic Frontier’s 3rd climactic final Content Update… for Free!

games.title: Sonic Generations
games.description: Celebrate 20 years of Sonic in an all new adventure that delivers a definitive experience to Sonic fans new and old!

games.title: Sonic Generations
games.description: A time-traveling adventure featuring a greatest-hits collection of 3D and 2D Sonic stages, now with upgraded visuals and new bonus content.

games.title: Sonic Mania
games.description: Sonic Mania is a side-scrolling platformer that pays homage to the original Sega Genesis Sonic the Hedgehog games. Players choose from Sonic, Tails, or Knuckles, each with unique abilities, and speed through 13 zones that include redesigned stages from past games alongside original levels. The game features special stages for collecting Chaos Emeralds, time attack with online leaderboards, and split-screen competitive multiplayer.

games.title: Sonic Mania Plus
games.description:
Sonic Mania Plus is an updated version of Sonic Mania that includes the Encore DLC. Digital versions of Sonic Mania on all platforms can be upgraded to Sonic Mania Plus by purchasing the Encore DLC separately.

Plus is also available as a physical release and marks the first time any version of Sonic Mania was available on physical media. Released for Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and Switch, in addition to including the complete version of Sonic Mania Plus on a disc/cartridge it also comes packaged with a reversible cover with alternate box art, an art book and a holographic outer sleeve.

games.title: Sonic Mania: Collector's Edition
games.description:
A collector's edition to promote Sonic Mania. It contains:

- Deluxe "SEGA Genesis" style Collector's Box
- 12" Classic Sonic Statue featuring SEGA Genesis Base
- Metallic Collector's Card with Sonic Mania Download Code (digital game code)
- SEGA Cartridge Cast with Golden Ring

games.title: Sonic Mania: Encore
games.description: Experience an all-new Encore Mode, two new playable characters Mighty and Ray, and four player Competition Mode.

games.title: Sonic Origins
games.description:
Celebrate the games that started it all. Sonic Origins is a brand new collection including Sonic the Hedgehog, Sonic CD, Sonic the Hedgehog 2, and Sonic 3 & Knuckles. Play as Sonic, Tails, & Knuckles and immerse yourself in the fully remastered gameplay, tie the games together with all new animations, explore added features, modes, and more.

The versions of Sonic the Hedgehog, Sonic the Hedgehog 2 and Sonic CD in this compilation are ports of the remasters previously released for mobile, platforms, with the added Drop Dash ability from Sonic Mania.
The Sonic the Hedgehog 3 & Knuckles version is brand new for this compilation, and is also a remaster in the same way that the other titles, also adding the Drop Dash ability. This version had part of its soundtrack changed, swapping the songs for those present in the PC port of the Sonic & Knuckles Collection.

games.title: Sonic Origins Plus
games.category: Platform, Puzzle, Racing, Pinball, Adventure, Arcade
games.description:
Sonic Origins Plus is an updated version of Sonic Origins that includes the Plus Expansion Pack. Unlike Sonic Mania Plus, Sonic Origins Plus can be bought digitally on PC as a single purchase like the console versions, while the base game continues to be available on it's own. Digital versions of Sonic Origins on all platforms can be upgraded to Plus by purchasing the Plus Expansion Pack separately.

Experience the collected adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog in the newly remastered Sonic Origins Plus! With 16 legendary Sonic titles including 12 game gear games, new playable characters, modes, challenges, behind the scenes content, and more, this is the definitive way to play these classic games!

Sonic Origins Plus will be available as an all-in-one bundle in both digital and premium physical editions that include the Sonic Origins base game and the Plus Expansion Pack, featuring 12 Sonic Game Gear titles, playable Knuckles in Sonic CD, and for the first time ever, Amy Rose as a playable character in Sonic the Hedgehog 1, 2, Sonic 3 & Knuckles, and Sonic CD! This pack also includes previously released add-on content: Extreme Missions, Mirror Mode, new character animations, and additional backgrounds and music.

The premium physical release marks the first time any version of Sonic Origins was available on physical media. Released for Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and Switch, in addition to including the complete version of Sonic Origins Plus on a disc/cartridge it also comes packaged with a reversible cover with alternate box art, an art book and an outer sleeve.

games.title: Sonic Origins Plus: Day One Edition
games.description:
Experience the collected adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog in the newly remastered Sonic Origins Plus! With 16 legendary Sonic titles including 12 Game Gear games, new playable characters, modes, challenges, behind the scenes content, and more, this is the definitive way to play these classic games!

Those who purchase the Physical Edition will also receive a retro-inspired reversible coversheet, and a 20-page artbook.

games.title: Sonic Origins Plus: Expansion Pack
games.description:
For current owners of Sonic Origins, complete your experience with the Plus Expansion Pack, which features 12 Sonic Game Gear titles, playable Knuckles in Sonic CD, and for the first time ever, Amy Rose as a playable character in Sonic the Hedgehog 1, 2, Sonic 3 & Knuckles, and Sonic CD!

This pack also includes the Classic Music Pack and Premium Fun Pack which contain Extreme Missions, Mirror Mode, additional screen borders, new character animations in menus, added music from other Sonic titles, and more!

games.title: Sonic Origins: Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description: Relive the classic collected adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog, Sonic the Hedgehog 2, Sonic 3 & Knuckles, and Sonic CD in this remastered Deluxe Edition, featuring bonus digital content.

games.title: Sonic Origins: Premium Fun Pack
games.description: The Sonic Origins Premium Fun Pack features Hard Missions, Letterbox Background, Bonus Character Animations in-menu & music player, and additional re-mastered music tracks.

games.title: Sonic Racing CrossWorlds: Season Pass
games.description:
The Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Season Pass includes:

• Minecraft Pack – Steve, Alex, & the Creeper playable characters, the minecart vehicle, Minecraft World track, remixed Minecraft music, 6 Emotes per character, and additional sounds (Releasing Q4 2025)
• SpongeBob SquarePants Pack - SpongeBob SquarePants and Patrick Star playable characters, the Patty Wagon vehicle, Bikini Bottom track, new original music, 6 Emotes per character, and additional sounds (Releasing Q4 2025)
• PAC-MAN Pack - PAC-MAN and Team Ghost playable characters, the PAC-MAN Mobile vehicle, PAC-Village & Maze track, 6 Emotes per character, and additional sounds (Releasing Q1 2026)
• Mega Man Pack - Mega Man and Proto Man playable characters, the Rush Roadstar vehicle, Wily Castle track, 6 Emotes per character, and additional sounds (Releasing Q1 2026)
• Content Pack 5 - 4 Playable Characters, 1 Vehicle, 1 Track, 6 Emotes per character, and 8 Sounds (Releasing Q3 2026)
• Content Pack 6 - 2 Playable Characters, 1 Vehicle, 1 Track, 6 Emotes per character, and 8 Sounds (Releasing Q3 2026)
• Sonic Prime Character Pack - Playable Characters Rusty Rose, Tails Nine, Knuckles the Dread (Available on Launch)

*Content contained in this Bundle will also be sold separately and released throughout the following 12 months after Launch.

games.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds
games.description: Race across land, sea, air, space, and time in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.

games.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - "Blue Star" Extreme Gear
games.description: Take control of the skies with the "Blue Star" Extreme Gear, inspired by Sonic's Extreme Gear in Sonic Riders.

games.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Avatar Legends Pack
Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description:
This bundle includes:
• Base game
• Season Pass:
- Sonic Prime Character Pack - Rusty Rose, Tails Nine, Knuckles the Dread (Available at launch)
- 6 Content Packs, which include guest characters, vehicles, tracks, emotes, and more from some of your favorite pop culture franchises.
* Additional content will be released sequentially after the game is released.
* Please check the official website for product details and release schedule.

games.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Mega Man Pack
games.description:
The Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Mega Man Pack includes:
• Mega Man and Proto Man Playable Characters
• Rush Roadstar Vehicle
• Wily Castle track
• 6 Emotes per Character
• 8 Additional Sounds

games.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Minecraft Pack
games.description:
The Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Minecraft Pack includes:

• Steve, Alex, & the Creeper playable characters
• Minecart vehicle
• Minecraft World track
• Remixed Minecraft music
• 6 Emotes per character
• Additional sounds

games.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Pac-Man Pack
games.description:
The Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Pac-Man Pack includes:

• Pac-Man and Team Ghost playable characters
• Pac-Man Mobile vehicle
• Pac-Village & Maze track
• 6 Emotes per character
• Additional sounds

games.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - SpongeBob SquarePants Pack
games.description:
The Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - SpongeBob SquarePants Pack includes:

• SpongeBob SquarePants and Patrick Star playable characters
• Patty Wagon vehicle
• Bikini Bottom track
• New original music
• 6 Emotes per character
• Additional sounds

games.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Mutant Mayhem Pack
Sonic Superstars
games.description: Adventure through the mystical Northstar Islands in this all-new take on classic 2D Sonic high-speed action platforming. Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, and Amy Rose and harness all-new Emerald powers to move and attack in dynamic new ways. Navigate gorgeous, never-before-seen environments solo or with up to 3 other players and stop Dr. Eggman, Fang, and a mysterious new adversary from converting the islands' giant animals into Badniks before it's too late!

games.title: Sonic Superstars: Digital Deluxe Edition featuring LEGO
games.description:
The SONIC SUPERSTARS Digital Deluxe Edition featuring LEGO contains SONIC SUPERSTARS and the Digital Deluxe Upgrade featuring LEGO, which includes:
-LEGO Fun Pack
-Sonic Rabbit Skin
-Mecha Sonic Skin for Battle Mode
-Bonus Main Menu Wallpapers​
-Digital Artbook & Mini Original Soundtrack

games.title: Sonic Superstars: Holiday Pack
games.description: Bring cheer and joy to the holidays with this complimentary Sonic Holiday Costume!

games.title: Sonic Superstars: Lego Fun Pack
games.description:
The LEGO Fun Pack includes:
- LEGO Tails Skin
- LEGO Amy Skin
- LEGO Knuckles Skin
- Additional LEGO Stages for Battle Mode

games.title: Sonic Superstars: Lego Sonic Skin
games.description: Speed through the world of SONIC SUPERSTARS as the Blue Blur, now in LEGO form!

games.title: Sonic Superstars: Retro Diner Amy Costume
games.description: A Retro Diner Costume for a classic gal.

games.title: Sonic Superstars: Shadow Costume for Sonic
games.description: Step into the intensity, mystery and ultimate footie-pajamas of this costume inspired by one of Sonic's greatest rivals! Embrace the darkness with the Shadow Costume for Sonic!

games.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
games.description: A remastered port of Sonic the Hedgehog for mobile platforms, adding many improvements over the original version, such as the spindash, widescreen support and new playable characters. Run and spin through loop-de-loops as you collect rings and defeat enemies on your mission to save the world from the evil Dr. Eggman.

games.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 2
games.description:
One of the best selling SEGA games of all time - Sonic The Hedgehog 2 is now available for free on mobile! Rediscover SEGA’s super Sonic masterpiece!

Dr. Eggman is back to his old tricks, trying to find the seven Chaos Emeralds that will enable him to complete his ultimate weapon, the Death Egg. Only the triple threat of Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles can defeat him in this remaster from the team behind Sonic Mania!

Sonic The Hedgehog 2 joins the ever-increasing line-up of ‘SEGA Forever’, a treasure trove of free SEGA console classics brought to life on mobile for the first time.

games.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3 & Knuckles
games.description: Sonic the Hedgehog 3 & Knuckles was remastered and released as part of the Sonic Origins compilation, alongside the remasters of Sonic 1, 2, and CD. It has improvements over the original version, such as widescreen support and higher resolution, due to running in a different engine from the original game. Like the other ports in the compilation, this remaster also adds the Drop Dash ability, which was featured in Sonic Mania. Part of the soundtrack had to be changed to the songs from the PC port of Sonic the Hedgehog 3, which are based on the game's beta soundtrack.

games.title: Sonic Wings Reunion
games.description:
Sonic Wings Reunion is a sequel to the arcade-style shooter SONIC WINGS. The previous version was sold in 1998.

Choose from 8 characters and destroy the mysterious organization “Fatamornagana” that has progressed into the modern world. The scenario changes depending on the combination of characters.

The first new Sonic Wings (Aero Fighters) game in 26 years, with original staff members from the series involved in its planning, production, and oversight. This all-new installment in the classic vertical-scrolling shoot ’em up series is designed for all fans of the genre to enjoy.

games.title: Sonic X Shadow Generations
games.description: Shadow the Hedgehog is back with Classic and Modern Sonic in Sonic X Shadow Generations, an all-new collection featuring two unique experiences! Play as Shadow in a brand-new story campaign featuring never-before-seen abilities that prove why he's known as the Ultimate Life Form! Speed through iconic stages from Shadow's history, discover hidden secrets in an expansive hub world, and unlock new powers to take on Black Doom and save the world. Sonic X Shadow Generations also includes a complete remaster of the highly acclaimed Sonic Generations, a time-traveling adventure featuring a greatest-hits collection of 3D and 2D Sonic stages, now with upgraded visuals and new bonus content.

games.title: Sonic X Shadow Generations: Day One Edition
games.description:
The day one edition includes:
- Base game
- Physical printed copy of Gerald Robotnik's journal
- Code for Sonic Adventure skin

games.title: Sonic x Shadow Generations: Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description:
The digital deluxe edition allows access to the game 3 days earlier, it also Includes:
-The Base Game + Digital Deluxe Season Pass:
-- An additional character skin and level for Shadow (releasing Holiday 2024)
-- Terios Skin
-- Extra BGM Pack
-- Digital Art Book + Soundtrack
-- Skill Points (Sonic Generations)

games.title: Sonic X Shadow Generations: Digital Deluxe Upgrade
games.description:
Upgrade to the SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS Digital Deluxe Edition and receive:
• Digital Deluxe Season Pass:
o Sonic the Hedgehog 3 Movie Pack
o Terios Skin
o Extra BGM Pack
o Digital Art Book + Soundtrack
o Skill Points (Sonic Generations)
*If you own the Extra Content Pack, which is included in the Digital Deluxe Edition and Digital Deluxe Upgrade, please install the Extra Content Pack before starting a new game.

games.title: Sonic X Shadow Generations: Sonic Jam Skin
games.description: A legacy skin for Classic Sonic inspired by his look in Sonic Jam.

games.title: Sonic X Shadow Generations: Sonic the Hedgehog 3 Movie Pack
games.description:
When transported to an unknown dimension, Shadow must race through the streets of modern-day Shibuya to defeat the forces of G.U.N.

Take on a new look as Shadow and play through a unique level inspired by the new movie, Sonic the Hedgehog 3, featuring the voice of Keanu Reeves!

games.title: Sono Hi no Kemono ni ha
games.description:
Ritsuki, his younger sister Runa and childhood friend Mayu attend a school that is popular for its drama activities, with many of its graduates going on to become famous actors and scenario writers. Shortly after the entrance ceremony, they were invited by their classmate Inori to join the drama club. Ritsuki was eager to aim for the school’s primaries for the national competition, but first year students were forbidden from participating in the contest. They wouldn’t accept the fact that they were excluded just because they didn’t have much experience. If only they were given the opportunity to demonstrate their acting abilities…

Rumour has it that there is a ghost that haunts the theater. It is said that it will grant any wish so long as it is related to drama.

games.title: Sonzai
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure, Indie
games.description: Sonzai is a 2d, action-brawler platforming RPG. The town of Kumotoshi holds secrets. A new life, new people, new spirits. What are the threads that bind people together? What is the nature of magic? All presented in a beautiful, inky art style - with every single frame of animation hand drawn.

games.title: Soot
games.description: Soot is a Simulation and Strategy game where you control the terraforming crew of the Ziggurat, a roaming space station that orbits small planets and exploits their resources. Follow Captain Christopher Mason and Lieutenant Ferdinand McCann as they (and you) master the craft of terraforming.

games.title: Sophia’s Animal Clinic: Mission Wildlife Park
games.description: Your veterinary adventure begins at the wildlife park! Help injured and sick animals such as horses, deer, ducks, donkeys, goats, rabbits, and many more.

games.title: Sophie: Starlight Whispers
games.description: Sophie: Starlight Whispers is an adventure game with metroidvania elements, featuring pixelated graphics, a deep narrative, and fully dubbed in Portuguese. Explore a vast map and put an end to the dark creatures that terrorize the kingdom of Sharan.

games.title: Sophstar
games.description: A vertical arcade shoot'em up with an inventive teleport system, lots of fast-blazing action and explosions, tons of boss fights, a risk/reward based score system and a proper challenge for both veteran and new players of the genre.

games.title: Soraja Invaders
games.description: Invaders from different systems have united against you! Fight them off! Do not run out of life before invaders run out of reinforcements!

games.title: Sorcer Striker
games.description: Sorcer Striker, released in Japan as Mahou Daisakusen is a 1993 medieval-themed scrolling shooter arcade game developed and published by Raizing (now known as Eighting) , and later ported to the X68000 and FM-Towns computers and the EZweb mobile phones. It is the first game in the Mahou Daisakusen trilogy, which includes Kingdom Grandprix and Dimahoo.

games.title: Sorry We're Closed
games.description: Sorry We're Closed is a nostalgic single player survival horror game with rich lore and character interactions that allow multiple endings. Following the end days of Michelle, explore unsettling locations using the environment to hide and survive. Use your demon gun to defend in first person.

games.title: SortCraft
games.description: Design clever conveyor belt networks to sort colorful items into their correct destinations. What starts simple quickly becomes a brain-teasing challenge as you manage multiple colors, crossing paths, and tricky layouts.

games.title: Soul Axiom
games.description: Explore Soul Axiom’s rich environments and immersive story to unravel the mystery of your life, and your digital afterlife. You will be taken on an intriguing voyage of discovery, through beautiful, haunting locations, facing challenges that will lead you into danger on your mission to unlock your identity, your story, your mystery. But beware: some mysteries are better left unsolved.

games.title: Soul Dimension
games.description: Soul Dimension is a first-person PlayStation VR adventure game that combines suspenseful puzzles, exploration, and dramatic action. Players take the role of Frank, a man capable of entering dreams, as he journeys through surreal environments to rescue his deceased daughter while confronting memories, nightmares, and supernatural threats.

games.title: Soul Hackers 2
games.description: Soul Hackers 2 takes place in the 21st Century and is set during a war between the Yagaratsu and the Phantom Society, two opposing factions of Devil Summoners. The story follows two supernatural "Aion" beings named Ringo and Figue, who descend into the human world from their birthplace in the data stream of information, in order to avert a cataclysmic event that they predict will doom humanity

games.title: Soul Hackers 2: 25th Anniversary Edition
games.description:
This edition includes the following:

- Soul Hackers 2
- Three-disc 25th Anniversary Music Album
- 100-page 25th Anniversary Book
- Aiho-kun Figure
- Special Costume & Demon Fusion DLC

games.title: Soul Hackers 2: Bonus Story Arc - The Lost Numbers
games.description:
Grants access to "The Lost Numbers" bonus story arc and new dungeon.

Centered around a new Devil Summoner, Nana, you'll experience this side-story over the course of multiple requests (recommended levels ranging 19-99), which will appear gradually at Club Cretaceous as you progress through the main story.

games.title: Soul Hackers 2: Launch Edition
games.description: The Launch Edition of Soul Hackers 2 which includes exclusive Art Cards that you can't get anywhere else!

games.title: Soul Link
games.description: Soul Link is a challenging puzzle game where you use your intelligence to build bridges with falling pieces of various shapes. Reconnect this broken land with Soul Bridges, and make the world whole again!

games.title: Soul Saga: Episode 1
games.description:
Soul Saga is a traditional role-playing video game in the vein of the Final Fantasy, Suikoden, Breath of Fire, and Persona video game series. Battles are initiated similarly to Chrono Trigger, where combat begins upon the player directing the character into an enemy in the world map. Once initiated, combat consists of a turn based battle system similar to Final Fantasy X. The game will also have airship battles, similar to Skies of Arcadia.

Exploration of the overworld map will also be a major aspect of gameplay, with the player being able to explore on foot similarly to Final Fantasy VII, and by airship similarly to Skies of Arcadia.

games.title: Soul Searching
games.description:
Soul Searching is a narrative survival game about sailing away from your homeland.

Soul Searching is a non-violent humble journey on primitive boats in a world of islands, dragons, and magic.

games.title: Soul Stalker
games.category: Strategy, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Indie
games.description: The survivor roguelike where you slay your psyche. Take down waves of enemies in the natural evolution of the genre established by Vampire Survivors, with visuals inspired by Paper Mario.

games.title: Soulbind: Tales of the Underworld
games.description: It's up to you to become the Endless, a mysterious skeleton, and embark on a perilous journey. Collect monster body parts to enhance your character and use a variety of abilities. Explore sinister locations, fight mythical creatures and uncover the secrets of the Underworld.

games.title: SoulCalibur III
games.description:
A port of SoulCalibur III, originally released on the PlayStation 2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Soulcalibur III is a fighting game, the sequel to Soulcalibur II, and the fourth installment in the Soul series. Compared to its predecessor, it introduces three new modes and a larger character roster, with 24 characters playable in Tales of Souls mode and an additional 18 playable in all other modes.

games.title: SoulCalibur VI
games.description: SoulCalibur VI represents the latest entry in the premier weapons-based, head-to-head fighting series and continues the epic struggle of warriors searching for the legendary Soul Swords. Taking place in the 16th century, revisit the events of the original SoulCalibur to uncover hidden truths.

games.title: SoulCalibur VI: 2B
games.description: Joining the cast of SOULCALIBUR VI is the combat android 2B (YoRHa No. 2 Type B) from Square Enix's NieR: Automata! Jump and dash around your opponent to pull off swift attacks and deadly air combos!

games.title: SoulCalibur VI: Amy
games.description: Celebrate 20 years of SOULCALIBUR with an all new playable character: Amy!

games.title: SoulCalibur VI: Cassandra
games.description: Celebrate 20 years of Soulcalibur with an all new playable character: Cassandra!

games.title: SoulCalibur VI: Collector's Edition
games.description:
This version contains:

- SoulCalibur VI full game.
- 120 page art book.
- Metal case with built-in soundbox.
- Soundtrack on disk.
- 12'' Collectable Sophitia figure.
- Collector's Edition box.

games.title: SoulCalibur VI: Deluxe Edition
games.description:
This version contains:

- SoulCalibur VI.
- Season Pass.

games.title: SoulCalibur VI: Deluxe Edition 2019
games.description: The SoulCalibur VI: Deluxe Edition includes SoulCalibur VI and all DLC characters.

games.title: SoulCalibur VI: Haohmaru
games.description: Celebrate 20 years of SOULCALIBUR with an all new playable character: Haohmaru!

games.title: SoulCalibur VI: Hilde
games.description: Celebrate 20 years of SOULCALIBUR with an all new playable character: Hilde!

games.title: SoulCalibur VI: Hwang
games.description: Celebrate 20 years of SOULCALIBUR with an all new playable character: Hwang!

games.title: SoulCalibur VI: Setsuka
games.description: Celebrate 20 years of SOULCALIBUR with an all new playable character: Setsuka!

games.title: SoulCalibur VI: Tira
games.description: Access to the playable character Tira in the full retail version of SOULCALIBUR VI. The pack also includes a unique story for Tira in the Soul Chronicle mode.

games.title: Soulcalibur: Broken Destiny
games.description:
A port of Soulcalibur: Broken Destiny, originally released on the PSP (PlayStationPortable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

The Soulcalibur series is a weapon-based fighting franchise in which characters engage in combat using a range of weapons. Soulcalibur: Broken Destiny includes the Gauntlet mode, a single-player mode in which players progress through a series of missions using different characters. These missions are intended to introduce gameplay mechanics and techniques and to support skill development.

games.title: Souldiers
games.description: Fight for your freedom in a sprawling fantasy world caught between the living and the fallen. Hone your skills in a retro epic featuring puzzle platforming, metroidvania exploration and crunchy soulslike combat.

games.title: SoulFrost
games.description: This is a short but hard minimalistic scroll shooter where you race against doing too many actions to keep more energy, without which you won't make it to the end. Lightweight narrative art-game.

games.title: Soulshard
games.description: In a realm between life and death, a confused soul, haunted by a life filled with misguided choices, seeks redemption and freedom.

games.title: Soulstice
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description: Explore a dark world brimming with hidden mysteries, master a diverse combat system, and inhabit the dual forces of two sisters in a coming-of-age fantasy story with fast-paced action, vicious enemies and breathtaking boss fights.

games.title: Soulvars
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Adventure, Indie, Card & Board Game
games.description: Get ready to ignite your Soul! Soulvars is a pixel art, turn-based deckbuilding RPG inspired by classic JRPGs with a modern twist. Unravel a dark conspiracy as your party of Soulbearers faces off against invading Dominators in dynamic, action-packed battles.

games.title: Sound Shapes
games.description:
Play, Compose and Share in a unique take on the classic side-scrolling platformer where your actions make the music.

Equal parts instrument and game, Sound Shapes gives everyone the ability to make music. Play through a unique campaign that fuses music and artwork into a classic 2D platformer, featuring artwork by Pixeljam, Capy, Superbrothers and more, with music by I Am Robot and Proud, Jim Guthrie and Deadmau5. Create your own unique musical levels with all of the campaign content and share with the world. Sound Shapes creates an ever-changing musical community for everyone to enjoy at home or on the go.

games.title: Soundfall
games.description: Soundfall is a dungeon crawler that combines looter-shooter action with rhythm-based gameplay. Venture out solo or with up to 4 friends locally or online.
