You control the circle. Your goal is to move forward while avoiding mines and staying within the horizontal boundaries of the screen. Press the button to jump, hold the button to increase range. Collect coins to earn points.

If you hit a mine or go beyond the top or bottom of the screen, the game is over.

games.title: Taqoban
games.description: Play as Tao and Xiang, two pandas, and help them to organize their boxes as efficiently as possible to earn a maximum of bamboos!

games.title: Tardy
games.description: Tardy is a quest about fiddling with computers, terminals gadgets and other hi-tech scrap of all sorts. Deal with crazy machines, solve the mystery of the crew disappearance and help Ramto to come back home!

games.title: Tarot Readings Premium
games.description: Use our tarot reading cards adviser to learn about your future and fate!

games.title: Tarutobi
games.description: Slide, trip and jump! In TARUTOBI, a fast paced arcade game, you'll be doing all of this with just the push of a button

games.title: Task Force Delta: Afghanistan
games.description: As a member of Task Force Delta, Army's Elite special forces unit, you'll strive for vengeance for Terrorist Attacks against the United States. Formed to battle terrorism, you will engage in rough terrain against countless enemies with the sole target to eliminate leading terrorists in Afghanistan. Utilise a modern arsenal of machine guns, assault rifles, sniper rifles and pistols to weaken the terrorists and protect the free world!

games.title: Task Force Kampas
games.description:
Task Force Kampas is inspired by the Golden Age of japanese shmups, and adds new mechanics, randomly generated levels and handcrafted bosses. It is an endless loop: you can finish it, but also find the way to continue past the ending and get the highest score!

Space shooters were never that punchy before. Task Force Kampas emphasizes music and game feel to create the perfect game you'd want to spend all your coins into (if that were still a thing, you know.)

games.title: Tasomachi: Behind the Twilight
games.description:
Yukumo is a young girl who travels around in her airship, her pride and joy. When visiting a particular Far Eastern town to run some errands her airship suddenly breaks down. She decides to explore the town to search for parts for repair; however, the town has fallen silent with no trace of the people who live there, the only inhabitants being a strange cat-like species...
Tasomachi is an adventure game in which you can freely explore an Far Eastern Fantasy town. You will control Yukumo as you explore the mysterious town, clear dungeons and collect items in order to fix your broken down airship.

games.title: Tasty Slot Machine
games.description:
You start with 1,000 coins - the aim of the game is to wager your coins to try and increase your coins as high as you can. Pick the number of pay lines and then how much the bet per line will be. Then cross your fingers and press spin.
If you win on a spin, you can either Take Win or choose to Double of Nothing in a simple game of Red or Black. Keep playing until you run out of coins or want to Cash Out and register your rank in the Leaderboards!

games.title: Tavern Owner Simulator
games.description: Design. Serve. Expand. Become the ultimate tavern owner.

games.title: Taxi Chaos
games.description:
Taxi Chaos is a casual arcade racing game where you select one of a wide range of unlockable cabs, each of whom has different attributes: the strong muscle car, the superfast exotic supercar, the corner-drifting Japanese tuner, an American classic from the '60s and more: Taxi Mayhem has them all.
Your goal is to try and earn big cab fares, by picking up any customers and dropping them off at their destination spots as fast as possible before you run out of time! However, beware: most customers are a little crazy.

games.title: Taxi Driver Simulator 2024
games.description: Taxi Driver Simulator 2024 is a type of taxi simulator. The player will play the role of a taxi driver who worked for so long that he became a millionaire. Now he works as a taxi driver for fun. The game has realistic graphics that give you the feeling of being in the scene where the action takes place. The game features a garage with luxury cars that the player can purchase after accumulating enough currency. The game has an open world and is intended for people loving simulator games.

games.title: Taxi Driver: The Simulation
games.description: Start your day behind the wheel of a yellow taxicab and begin your career as a taxi driver in the US City Hamside. Carry your customers safely and on time to their final destination. Good reliability and consistency will be rewarded. Deliver satisfied customers from pickup to setdown. Tnlock additional vehicles and become the best driver in the City!

games.title: Taxi Simulator Driver: NY City Rides
TCG Card Market Simulator
games.description: Create a shop that every TCG fan dreams of visiting!

games.title: Tcheco in the Castle of Lucio
games.description:
Tcheco in the Castle of Lucio is an exciting, fast-paced action game.
Help Tcheco the Adventure Boy to leave a mysterious castle full of deadly creatures!
Be ready for a big challenge, full of nonsense humor and retro goodness.

games.title: Tchia
games.description: A tropical open-world adventure. Climb, glide, swim, and sail your boat around a beautiful archipelago in this physics-driven sandbox. Use Tchia's special ability to take control of any animal or object you can find, and Jam on your fully playable Ukulele. A game inspired by New Caledonia.

games.title: Tchia: Kepler Customization Pack
games.description: The Kepler Customization Pack includes four costume sets for Tchia and four boat customization packs, inspired by fellow titles from the Kepler game catalogue.

games.title: Tchia: Oléti Edition
games.description: The Tchia: Oléti Edition comes with the Tchia base game and the Kepler Customization Pack, which includes four costume sets for Tchia and four boat customization packs, inspired by fellow titles from the Kepler game catalogue.

games.title: Teach Me Japanese Chess Pretty Please
Teacup
games.description: Teacup is a narrative adventure game with a focus on exploration and non-linear progression. You play as the titular Teacup, a shy and introverted young frog who loves drinking tea and reading. The day before she is to host a tea party at her house, she realizes she is completely out of tea, and thus must venture into the woods around her to find the herbs she needs to restock her pantry.

games.title: Team Sonic Racing
games.description: Team Sonic Racing combines the best elements of arcade and fast-paced competitive style racing as you face-off with friends in intense multiplayer racing.

games.title: Team Sonic Racing: 30th Anniversary Edition
games.description: Team Sonic Racing combines the best elements of arcade and fast-paced competitive style racing as you face-off with friends in intense multiplayer racing. Race together and work together as a team by sharing power-ups and speed boosts. Take control of your racing style. Choose from 3 distinct character types and unlock game-changing vehicle customization options to suit your racing style. Speed up. Gear Up – Team Racing at Sonic Speed!

games.title: Team17 Indie Heroes
games.description: Team17 swings into action and delivers a beefed up, muscle-bound slice of awesome Indie action in the Team17 Indie Heroes Pack for PS4!

games.title: Tear: Owari to Hajimari no Shizuku
games.description: Visual novel adventure for PS4 and PS VR.

games.title: Tearaway: Unfolded
games.description: Journey through a vibrant, living papery world, with a plucky messenger who has a unique message to deliver - to you! Choose to guide either atoi or iota on this adventure, each a bold courier with an expressive personality and a unique message for you locked away inside their envelope head. In order to read it though, they're going to need your help to deliver it!

games.title: Tearaway: Unfolded - Crafted Edition
games.description: Join forces with Atoi the messenger in a daring quest to deliver a top-secret message. Unfold her magical papery world, save her pals in peril and battle the monsters trying to stop her delivery!

games.title: Teared
games.description: Embark on a thrilling 3D arcade action-platformer adventure in Teared. Travel through 9 challenging levels filled with epic bosses and a variety of deadly creatures. Are you ready for this epic journey?

games.title: Tears of Avia
games.description: Tears of Avia is a turn-based tactical RPG. Play with up to 5 classes and hundreds of skills, finding the best synergy with your party and their skill loadout will mean the difference between success and failure. Run a balanced party or roll nothing but warriors, the choice is yours. With some skills being weapon bound rather than class bound, there are endless possibilities for you to experiment from.

games.title: Tears Revolude
games.description:
A classic command-based RPG with 3D map interface and smooth battle animation!
A century ago, there was a unique artist named Orwiel. Sion and Michelle set off on a journey to discover his final works. The two meet a girl with no memories named Liara. What the girl carries will shake both the path they travel and their fate!

games.title: Techno Tanks
games.description: Be ready for the Techno Tank experience! Deafest the enemy tanks while dodging their deadly bullets. Improve your aim and maneuver skills while surviving a crazy retro bullet hell. Level by level the enemy's tanks get faster, smarter, and deadlier. Can you defeat them all? Play alone, together with friends, or against your friends as the game features the following game modes: - Singleplayer Stage Mode - Singleplayer and Co-op Retro Mode with more than 50 levels - VS Mode for FFA Battles for up to 4 players

games.title: Technotopia
games.description: Technotopia is a city-builder roguelike card game. Take on the role of an AI designed to build a perfect city. Build districts, meet the needs of diverse communities and maintain the delicate balance between factions vying for control over you!

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Arcade: Wrath of the Mutants
games.category: Fighting, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Arcade
games.description: A port of the arcade game Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles released in 2017 which was based on the the 2012 Nickelodeon TV series. This port adds three new stages and six new boss battles to the gameplay of the original arcade game.

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants in Manhattan
games.description: Battle alongside your brothers through the sewers, subways, and streets of NYC to take down Shredder and Krang's evil organization, Foot by Foot. Unleash custom combat skills and powerful team combos to save Manhattan from the overwhelming dark forces growing in the shadows.

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed
games.category: Fighting, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure, Arcade
games.description: Embark on an pizza-fueled journey with Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello and Michelangelo to battle an all-new wave of havoc-wreaking mutants as you join forces with familiar faces in thrilling missions across the streets of NYC!

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed - 1984 Comic Book Pack
games.description: Get the Turtles in style with the 1984 Comic Book Pack.

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed - 1987 Animated Series Pack
games.description: Get the Turtles in style with the 1987 Animated Series Pack.

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed - Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Full Base Game
• Season Pass Content:
- 1987 Animated Series Pack
- 1984 Comic Book Pack
- Metalheads Pack
- Fresh Meat Mission Pack

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed - Fresh Meat Mission Pack
games.description:
This pack includes Leatherhead missions, a Horde Mode (Including a final Scumbug boss fight), 3 new enemies and story scenes with story cutscenes.

The content contained in this pack is also included in the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed Season Pass (sold separately).

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed - Metalheads Pack
games.description: This pack includes "Metalhead" skin variants, extra masks, and extra stickers.

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed - Season Pass
games.description: The season pass includes "1987 Animated Series Pack", "1984 Comic Book Pack", "Metalheads Pack" and the "Fresh Meat Mission Pack". Content contained in this pack is also sold separately.

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge
games.category: Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Indie, Arcade
games.description: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge is a side-scrolling beat 'em up developed by Tribute Games and published by DotEmu. Inspired by the 1987 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles animated series, the game pays homage to classic TMNT titles like Turtles in Time, featuring retro-inspired pixel art and dynamic combat. Players control Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello, Raphael, or other allies, each with unique abilities, as they battle through various levels to thwart Shredder and Krang's plans to conquer New York City. The game supports solo play or co-op for up to six players, blending nostalgic design with modern gameplay mechanics.

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge - Anniversary Edition
games.category: Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Indie, Arcade
games.description:
This edition includes:
- Sprite Sticker Sheet
- Art Booklet
- Pizza Hut Personal Pan Pizza Coupon
- Dimension Shellshock DLC

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge - Dimension Shellshock
games.description: Chaos! The Neutrinos crash the Turtles’ latest pizza party! The teenagers from Dimension X are in dire need of help: Shredder is seeking to conquer the multiverse itself!

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge - Limited Edition
games.category: Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Indie, Arcade
games.description:
This edition includes the following:

- Game: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge
- Reversible Cover
- Sticker Sheet
- Art Booklet
- Limited Edition Outbox
- Keyring
- OST USB

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge - Radical Reptiles
games.description:
A powerhouse duo teams up with the Turtles for another bodacious ride! In this final content update for Shredder’s Revenge, your favorite ninja squad are joined by two fan-favorite characters from the classic 1987 TV show, Mondo Gecko and Mona Lisa! The radical reptiles are finally ready for their playable debut in a beat-em-up video game and a long-awaited reunion with the gang.

The coolest reptile on wheels, Mondo Gecko, joins the fight: use his skateboard tricks to shred through Foot soldiers and rack up extreme scores! Mondo can perform mid-air dodges with his board, making him the only character with this unique skill.

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge - Ultimate Edition
games.description:
This version contains the base game Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge and the DLCs :

- Dimension Shellshock
- Radical Reptiles

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate
games.category: Fighting, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure, Indie
games.description: TMNT Splintered Fate - Unleash the Turtles in a rogue-like quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales.

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Alopex Character DLC
games.description:
She's ready for action...and to get back at Shredder.

Meet Alopex, a mutant arctic fox and ninja assassin who went from being unwaveringly loyal to Shredder to a true friend of the Turtles. Expertly swinging her sickle-like kama, she slices at her foes with ease. Hurling her kunai at close range, she deals a powerful blast of damage. And the best part-- she can briefly become invulnerable while targeting multiple enemies in rapid succession. Ninja powers that modify shuriken also affect her kunai, so try her out with the Ninja, Flame, and Water Powers for maximum impact.

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Deluxe Edition
games.category: Fighting, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Indie
games.description:
TMNT Splintered Fate - Unleash the Turtles in a rogue-like quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales.

The Deluxe Edition includes:
The Game
Casey Jones DLC
10 exclusive foil cards

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Gold Edition
games.category: Fighting, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure, Indie
games.description: TMNT: Splintered Fate with three DLCs. Brawl through NYC in TMNT: Splintered Fate with all 7 playable heroes and the Junkyard level.

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Metalhead Character DLC
games.description:
WEAPONS FULLY CALIBRATED
Play as the loveable, locked and loaded Metalhead! As Splintered Fate's first fully ranged character, he comes with a unique gameplay style to complement the Turtles. Fire his blasters, transform into a spinning missile frenzy, and lob landmines to stop enemies in their tracks. Metalhead has an affinity with our new (free!) Robotics Powers. Fully playable in both the Main Campaign and the all-new Arcade Mode, Metalhead is ready to join you

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Platinum Edition
games.category: Fighting, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure, Indie
games.description: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate with 5 DLCs. Brawl through NYC in TMNT: Splintered Fate with 4 playable hero DLCs, the Junkyard level, and Samurai Armor Pack.

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Slash
games.category: Fighting, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure, Indie
games.description: Add Slash to the lineup- he's big, he's powerful, and he…loves candy? Use his claw and sheer strength to take down anyone in the way. Play with 5 new Artifacts while stomping through enemies with this latest playable character in TMNT: Splintered Fate.

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection
games.category: Fighting, Platform, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure, Arcade
games.description:
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection is a 2022 compilation developed by Digital Eclipse and published by Konami. It brings together 13 titles from the original TMNT video game series, including their Japanese versions, spanning arcade systems, home consoles, and handheld platforms.

The compilation includes optional gameplay adjustments such as difficulty modifiers, additional lives, and other configurable settings. A “Watch Mode” feature allows players to view automated gameplay and start playing from any chosen point in the recording.

The package also contains an archival section called the Turtles’ Lair. This archive includes design documents from Konami’s development materials, as well as box art, manuals, promotional artifacts, soundtrack samples, comic book covers, and images related to the associated animated series.

A built-in strategy guide provides game information, maps, move lists, and instructional videos for each title in the collection.

games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection - Limited Edition
games.description:
This edition includes the following:
- Game: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection
- Cloth poster featuring Kevin Eastman's adaptation of TMNT: Turtles in Time
- Multi-layer acrylic diorama of Leonardo, Donatello, Raphael and Michelangelo
- Enamel pin set of five classic designs
- Set of 12 translucent comic style character trading cards based on TMNT
- Full color artbook with 180 pages

games.title: Teki Paki
games.description: A falling block puzzle game, Teki-Paki is based around creating strings of 5 or more blocks vertically, horizontally or diagonally. The player drops L-Shaped 3-block pieces onto the game field. If the screen is filled, the game is over.

games.title: Tekken 2
games.description:
A port of Tekken 2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

The game was originally released on PlayStation and added more content to the original arcade game, such as new characters and additional game modes.

games.title: Tekken 3
games.description:
A port of Tekken 3, originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Nineteen years following the previous King of Iron Fist tournament, fighters from all over the world have mysteriously begun to disappear at the hands of the enigmatic being known only as Toshin. Heihachi, hoping the promise of strong opponents will lure out this so-called "God of Fighting," begins his preparations for The King of Iron Fist Tournament 3.

games.title: Tekken 6
games.description: A port of the version of Tekken 6 originally released on PlayStation Portable, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.title: Tekken 7
games.description: Experience the epic conclusion of the Mishima clan and unravel the reasons behind each step of their ceaseless fight. Powered by Unreal Engine 4, Tekken 7 features stunning story-driven cinematic battles and intense duels that can be enjoyed with friends and rivals alike through innovative fight mechanics.

games.title: Tekken 7 + SoulCalibur VI Double Pack
games.description:
This bundle contains:

- Tekken 7
- SoulCalibur VI

games.title: Tekken 7: Anna Williams
games.description: Anna Williams, also known as "Lightning Scarlet," has joined the fray! Master her assassin techniques and take up her bazooka to exact revenge on Anna's sister, Nina Williams!

games.title: Tekken 7: Armor King
games.description: Armor King, the evil flower of the pro-wrestling world, has joined the fray! Face off against his sworn enemy, Craig Marduk, and get revenge for the death of his brother!

games.title: Tekken 7: Artist Collaboration Character Panel Set
Tekken 7: Cave of Enlightenment
games.description: A mysterious buddhist temple set deep within a cave. This stage is chocked full of unique gimicks consisting of balcony breaks, floor breaks, and more!

games.title: Tekken 7: Collector's Edition
games.description:
This edition includes the following:

- Tekken 7
- 12" x 18" Kazuya & Heihachi Figure
- TEKKEN 7 Original Game Soundtrack
- Steel Book

games.title: Tekken 7: Craig Marduk
games.description: Craig Marduk, ferocious beast and Vale Tudo fighter, has joined the fray! Tower over your opponent before pummeling them with powerful techniques!

games.title: Tekken 7: Definitive Edition
games.description: Purchase Tekken 7: Definitive Edition and get the most complete experience for Tekken 7! This edition includes the full game, Eliza DLC, and all additional content in all 4 Season Passes.

games.title: Tekken 7: Deluxe Edition
games.description: This edition includes the full TEKKEN 7 game and all additional content eligible to the Season Pass.

games.title: Tekken 7: Eliza
games.description: Get the mysterious Eliza vampire playable character, coming from TEKKEN Revolution, and master her unique fighting style to win the fight against your friends and rivals.

games.title: Tekken 7: Fahkumram
games.description: An add-on for Tekken 7 that grants use of the character "Fahkumram". The nation-wide hero from Thailand, Fahkumram joins the fray with his powerful Muay Thai style fighting! Break through your opponent's guard with his overpowering reach combined with a violent array of attacks!

games.title: Tekken 7: Frame Data Display
games.description: View frame data using one of two different modes: "Simple Display" and "Detailed Display." The feature is available in Practice Mode, Warm-Up Mode (while waiting to join an online match), within online player matches, and while spectating tournaments.

games.title: Tekken 7: Ganryu
games.description: The long-awaited Ganryu joins the fray! Turn heads fighting in his showy outfit and show the world just how strong a sumo can be!

games.title: Tekken 7: Geese Howard
games.description: Geese Howard, the charismatic face of evil from SNK, has joined the fray! Experience for yourself the overwhelming presence of the newest antagonist to emerge in TEKKEN 7! This pack also includes an exclusive stage with its own TEKKEN 7 spin, as well as the BGM "Soy Sauce for Geese" and two Geese costumes! *Included in this add-on are Geese Howard as a playable character and a new stage. Geese Howard will also become playable in DLC1's new mode, "Ultimate TEKKEN BOWL."

games.title: Tekken 7: Island Paradise
games.description: A spacious beachside stage that features both a poolside right out of a high-class resort and a beach with beautiful clear water! Play while enjoying the unique atmosphere of the beach, including bright, warm sunlight during the daytime and a beautiful sunset in the evening.

games.title: Tekken 7: Julia Chang
games.description: Julia Chang, top spokeswoman for her great reforestation program, has joined the fray! Dazzle and overwhelm your opponents with her powerful fighting style based on Xin Yi Liu He Quan and Baji Quan!

games.title: Tekken 7: Kunimitsu
games.description: The young thief who inherited her mother's name, Kunimitsu II joins the fray! Knock your opponent off their guard with her lightning-fast moves, then finish them off with her blades wreathed in red and blue flames!

games.title: Tekken 7: Legendary Edition
games.description: This version contains the base game plus 7 DLC fighters.

games.title: Tekken 7: Lei Wulong
games.description: The super cop Lei Wulong has joined the fray! Keep your opponents guessing by switching seamlessly between his five stances as you dominate the battle!

games.title: Tekken 7: Leroy Smith
games.description: The Wing Chun master Leroy Smith joins the fray! Toy with your opponent using a mix of offensive and defensive moves, then overwhelm them with a quick flurry of attacks!

games.title: Tekken 7: Lidia Sobieska
games.description: The Polish prime minister Lidia Sobieska joins the fray! Fight to protect her people using her karate techniques! Osu!

games.title: Tekken 7: Negan
games.description: Negan, The Walking Dead's charismatic villain and leader of the Saviors, joins the battle! With Lucille in hand, he metes out punishment to those who would disturb his new world order.

games.title: Tekken 7: Noctis Lucis Caelum
games.description: Noctis, the 114th heir apparent to the Lucian throne, joins the fray from FINAL FANTASY XV! Experience a new level of combat as you warp around the enemy while invoking Armiger, the power of kings! This pack also includes the exclusive stage "HAMMERHEAD," as well as the BGM "Stand Your Ground / FINAL FANTASY XV," the BGM "APOCALYPSIS NOCTIS Remix / TEKKEN 7," and five Noctis costumes!

games.title: Tekken 7: Season Pass
games.description: The first season pass for Tekken 7 contains two playable guest characters (Geese Howard and Noctis Lucis Caelum), two new stages and OSTs, 5 additional costumes and the Tekken Bowl mode.

games.title: Tekken 7: Taiko No Tatsujin Pack
games.description:
Get the TAIKO NO TATSUJIN Pack which contains the following:
・T-Shirt (Standing-Don)
・Bouncy Don-Chan
・Bouncy Katsu-Chan
・Bouncy Tetsu-Chan
・TAIKO NO TATSUJIN Effect (Don-Chan)
・TAIKO NO TATSUJIN Effect (Katsu-Chan)
・TAIKO NO TATSUJIN Effect (Neko & Shaxy)
・TAIKO NO TATSUJIN Plate
・TAIKO NO TATSUJIN Health Gauge
・TAIKO NO TATSUJIN Panel

games.title: Tekken 7: Ultimate Edition
games.description: This edition includes the full game, all additional content eligible to Season Passes 1 & 2, the playable character Eliza, the Taiko no Tatsujin Pack, and the Artist Collaboration Character Panel Set.

games.title: Tekken 7: Ultimate Tekken Bowl & Additional Costumes
games.description: The classic mini bowling game from Tekken Tag Tournament is returning back as "Ultimate TEKKEN BOWL" DLC! On top of that, more customizable costumes such as Blood Vengeance outfits, swimsuits, and Idolmaster costumes have been added!

games.title: Tekken 7: Zafina
games.description: Zafina, a deadly assassin from ancient times, joins the fray! Track down and defeat those whose veins course with devil's blood in order to stop the revival of Azazel!

games.title: Tekken X Street Fighter
games.description:
A crossover game that is planned to have Street Fighter characters in the 3D fighting style of a normal Tekken game.
The reverse of Street Fighter x Tekken which put Tekken characters into the 2D fighting style of a Street Fighter game in 2012.

The game has been stuck in development since its 2010 announcement and the game was put on hold officially in 2016, though early character models and some gameplay systems were said to be finished at the time.

games.title: Tekken: Dark Resurrection
games.description: A port of Tekken: Dark Resurrection, originally released on the PSP (PlayStation Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.title: Tekoha: A Tale Among the Stars
games.description: Tekoha: A Tale Among the Stars is a narrative-driven light RPG following two Indigenous Brazilian sisters on an emotional journey to reunite after a tragic event reshapes their homeland. Featuring turn-based combat and a visually striking world inspired by the rich cultural heritage of the Guarani-Kaiowá people, the game offers an immersive and heartfelt experience. It explores themes of resilience and the unwavering fight to preserve Indigenous culture alongside the breathtaking environment of the Brazilian Pantanal.

games.title: Tell Me Your Story
games.description: Uncover Grandma Rose’s extraordinary stories along with Amelia, all hidden in multiple cozy puzzles spread around the world. Dive into globetrotter adventures, discover granny’s treasures, and relax along the way.

games.title: Telling Lies
games.description: Four private lives. One big lie. Search through secretly recorded video conversations to discover the truth. The successor to the acclaimed Her Story.

games.title: Telltale Batman Shadows Edition
games.description:
Step into the shadows and experience the twisted world of Telltale's Batman in a way that brings the fractured persona of the Dark Knight and the City of Gotham to life in a sinister, new way. Enhanced with hand recolored game play and remastered textures, the Telltale Batman Shadows Edition brings all ten Telltale Batman episodes across two seasons into one, complete game while staying true to the spirit of the Dark Knight's rich, visually compelling history.

Includes:
• Batman: The Telltale Series (Episodes 1-5)
• Batman: The Enemy Within (Episodes 1-5)
• Batman Shadows Mode

games.title: Temari Trials
games.description: Puzzles with Samurai Paws

games.title: Temari Trials: Dojo's Test
games.description: Temari Trials: Dojo’s Test is a logic-focused puzzle game with charming pixel art where you guide a clever fox pushing temaris toward locked chests. Every hit removes a lock, and when a chest is fully unlocked, the level is cleared. Temaris can also push each other, allowing creative setups and surprising solutions for players who enjoy Japanese aesthetics and clever problem-solving.

games.title: Tembo the Badass Elephant
games.description: TEMBO THE BADASS ELEPHANT is a larger than life, 2D side-scrolling action adventure from Game Freak.

games.title: Tempest 4000
games.description: In Tempest 4000, players are once again in control of the Claw, a powerful spacecraft equipped to destroy deadly creatures and other obstructions with rapid-fire shots on vibrant geometric prisms. With three game modes to choose from and 100 levels to conquer, players must eliminate all enemies as quickly as possible to survive and achieve that coveted spot at the top of the leaderboards.

games.title: Tempest: Jade Sea
games.description:
Captain!

It's time to go on board the real Chinese junk boat, immerse yourself in the legend, and explore mysterious islands. On your way, you will meet unexpected allies, pick a fight with a sea dragon, and visit familiar places that will play out in new colors. Do not forget to get a new gun from your cabin.

Expand your fleet
You have 2 reliable junks at your disposal!

Redecorate your ship
Put on the new sails, decorate the bowsprit with the golden dragon figurehead - let the other captains envy!

Embark on an exotic adventure
You will find the details about the forgotten island in the sail book.

Explore the world
Now you can stroll through the cities! At your service are two new pirate settlements with a tavern, drinks, and shops.

games.title: Temple of Horror
games.description: Escape the dangerous beings lurking in the dark, dodge countless deadly traps and slowly unruffle the secret of the Temple of Horror while not just trying to survive but to find your way out of this hell. Are you ready?

games.title: Tempus
games.description: TEMPUS is a puzzle adventure game with time travel. Each time you advance, you will see the island where you live change over thousands of years. You can only travel forward so it is a one way trip, how far will you go?

games.title: Temtem
games.description: Temtem is a massively multiplayer creature collection adventure inspired by Pokémon. Seek adventure at the lovely Airborne Archipelago along your Temtem squad. Catch every Temtem, battle other trainers, customize your house, join a friend's adventure or explore the online living-world.

games.title: Ten
games.description: Ten is a challenging platformer in which you face a relentless gauntlet of ten-second deathtrap rooms in a desperate struggle to escape your fate and uncover the truth!

games.title: Ten Dates
games.description:
Ten Dates is the sequel to the interactive rom-com, Five Dates. Misha, a millennial from London in search of that elusive in-person connection, tricks her best friend Ryan into going to a speed dating event with her. Each with their own five potential matches, Misha and Ryan must pluck up the courage and turn on the charm to date wildly different personalities.

Throughout the game, your choices and interactions will either strengthen or weaken your relationship with your date. Amidst a branching, multi-directional chain of conversation topics and deep-dive questions, Misha and Ryan are faced with ice-breaker games, awkward scenarios and unexpected truths. Will either find love?

games.title: Tenebris Pictura
games.category: Puzzle, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description: Exploration, ghost hunting and puzzles in the Victorian era.

games.title: Tengai
games.description: A great commander ruled an eastern plain for a long time, but his mind completely changed one day. He formed a mysterious army under his command and took several women as hostages to his palace. His evil power extended to his neighbouring countries and the princess of western country, fell into his hand.

games.title: Tennis Club Story
games.description:
Attract customers, train stars, and win the Grand Slam in this tennis club sim!
Aim for the ace position of tennis club prestige in this simulation! Your leadership decides if players make it to the big time or bust! Customize your training menu to focus on power or technique, molding players as you please for competitions, fame, and snazzy sponsors!

games.title: Tennis Elbow 4
games.description:
Tennis Elbow 4 is the successor of Tennis Elbow 2013, acclaimed by many Steam reviewers as the most realistic tennis simulation ever.

TE4 pushes even deeper the realism of the tennis rallies by providing completely rehauled ball, strike & player physics.

Created by and for tennis fans, Tennis Elbow 4 is a tennis simulation with an easy and intuitive learning curve, but with exceptional gameplay depth.

games.title: Tennis in the Face
games.description: Shoot tennis balls at your adversaries and save the city from the evil Explodz Inc. This is no Wimbledon, this is Tennis in the Face! Get ready for some hilarious ragdoll-smashing ball-bouncing action!

games.title: Tennis World Tour
games.description: The new standard developed by veterans of tennis simulations: play as one of 30 professional tennis players, learn all the shots, master each type of surface and experience a realistic career mode. Define your style of play and tactics to become number 1 in the world!

games.title: Tennis World Tour 2
games.description: Play as the world's top players, master each surface, perfect your game and strive to dominate the world circuit. Choose from multiple game modes, with singles and doubles, local and online games.

games.title: Tennis World Tour: Legends Edition
games.description: Tennis World Tour is a complete and faithful simulation of the sport, and also includes a unique system for customizing your strategy during a match, reflecting the tactical, physical, and mental dimensions of tennis. Over 30 tennis stars are represented in the game, including Roger Federer, Gaël Monfils, Angélique Kerber, Garbiñe Muguruza, Caroline Wozniacki, Nick Kyrgios, Alexander Zverev, and John Isner.

games.title: Tennis World Tour: Roland-Garros Edition
games.description: Players can step into the shoes of Rafael Nadal, 11-time winner of Roland-Garros, and Kristina Mladenovic, a French player ranked amongst the top 50 in the world, for matches on the clay courts of Roland-Garros.

games.title: Tents and Trees
games.description:
Place a tent next to each tree in this original nature puzzle game!

The numbers around the grid tell you how many tents must be placed in each row and column. Be careful, tents can’t touch each other.

Don't guess! Use your logic and carefully plan your every move. Each level has only one unique solution. Come up with your own strategies for solving larger grids and more-challenging levels.

games.title: Teocida
games.description: A surrealistic and spiritually provocative experience. Explore the ruins of a temple filled with puzzles, riddles, and secrets. Follow the Story of the Matriarch: a prophetess whose doctrine fell into obscurity.

games.title: Teocida + Estigma
games.description: Enter the surrealistic horror world of Teocida+Estigma!

games.title: Teppo and The Secret Ancient City
games.description: "Teppo and The Secret Ancient City" is an exciting adventure where players take on the role of explorer Teppo, searching for the legendary stone fortress hidden in the Amazon jungle. Meeting the mysterious Tanaca Wanax, the last chief of the unknown tribe of elected allies, Ugha Lulala, players will discover the incredible and fantastic history of a highly evolved ancient civilization, superior to that of the Mayas and the Incas. With the help of unknown technologies from space visitors, including magical diamond-shaped stones that can open a portal to access parallel worlds, players will have to overcome obstacles and challenges to reach the fortress and open the first portal. A mystery and discovery filled adventure for fans of exploration and archaeology.

games.title: Tera
games.description: Tera is an epic fantasy mmorpg experience. Master the action-packed combat system and prove yourself in solo and multiplayer adventures - all in the stunningly beautiful world of Arborea!

games.title: Teraslide
games.description: Play as Tulock, a snow fox, and help him progress through the different levels of this puzzle game based on movement on a hexagonal grid.

games.title: Teratopia
games.category: Fighting, Platform, Strategy, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure, Indie
games.description:
Join Tucho in his quest to rescue his friends and liberate the colorfully grotesque lands of Teratopia! Traverse 13 unique zones packed with enemies bent on overtaking your homeland. But fear not! The power of friendship arms you with fellow Teratopians and a diverse set of skills to face a family of red invaders.

Immerse yourself in an adventure full of action, and strategize on-the-go to better overcome your foes! Play as either Tucho the brawler, Benito the shooter, or Horacio the trickster, each with their own strengths and skills.

games.title: Teravit
games.description: Teravit is an open-world sandbox RPG where you can run, fly, dig, build, and explore the voxel world in your own unique way. Adventurers explore a vast, randomly generated world with a variety of biomes and cities with different characteristics, crafting equipment and items to take on strongholds of vicious monsters to save the world from the clutches of evil. Set forth on an adventure and create your own lasting story. Explore the map in earnest, collecting items, excavating terrain with explosives, and even creating block art. The ultimate goal in this open-world is yours to decide.

games.title: Terminal 81
games.description: Thanks to the financial crisis of 2008, Lorena migrated to Terminal 81 to work, but what seemed like a simple Latin American neighborhood, it was a dangerous region dominated by a mysterious criminal organization that carries out murders, kidnappings and human trafficking.

games.title: Terminal Velocity: Boosted Edition
games.description: In the far future, armadas from surrounding systems have suddenly waged war on Earth. You are a pilot from the Ares Squadron, flying the fastest, most dangerous crafts ever made. You're outgunned, outmanned, and strapped into a flying coffin.

games.title: Terminator 2D: No Fate
games.description: Experience the thrill of Terminator 2: Judgment Day with arcade action & pixel-perfect graphics! In this unique story blending iconic scenes from the movie with original scenarios and multiple endings, humanity’s fate is yours to decide.

games.title: Terminator 2D: No Fate - Day One Edition
games.description:
The Day One Edition features a collector's box with a full-colour manual book, reversible cover sleeve, 25mm collectible metal arcade token, and a cloth poster.

Experience the thrill of Terminator 2: Judgment Day with arcade action & pixel-perfect graphics! In this unique story blending iconic scenes from the movie with original scenarios and multiple endings, humanity’s fate is yours to decide.

games.title: Terminator: Resistance
games.description: Terminator: Resistance, is a first-person shooter set during the 'Future War' scenario that was only glimpsed at in the iconic films, 'THE TERMINATOR' and 'T2: JUDGMENT DAY'. The machines are destined to lose, but at what cost?

games.title: Terra Bomber
games.description: Terra Bomber is presented as a two dimensional sideways scroller based upon the classic arcade shooters of the 1980s.

games.title: Terra Lander
games.description:
Terra Lander pays homage to the classic early days of arcade retro gaming. Navigate the player to the landing pad through twenty increasingly difficult levels within the time limit and whilst managing limited fuel resources.

Movement or firing uses up fuel, though levels can be replenished by shooting the fuel dumps. Running out of fuel means you loose control and can't fire. If all fuel dumps are destroyed on any given level the player's fuel tank capacity is doubled for the next. Avoid the moving doors and increasingly fiendish enemies. Find the switches for the doors that block your way.

games.title: Terra Lander II: Rockslide Rescue
games.description: Terra Lander II - Rockslide Resuce is a sequel to Terra Lander, a homage to the classic early days of arcade retro, but this time you will need to rescue the humanoids of the landing pads from the planet through ten levels of increasing difficulty.

games.title: Terra Swoop Force
games.description: GDL has assembled an elite elytra task force for a top-secret, high-risk mission. Step into your Thermal Flight Armor; it’s time to begin the flight of your life!

games.title: Terra Trilogy
games.description:
Terra Trilogy features three full games in one package that pay homage to the classic and retro arcade genre of the 1980s. While capturing the twitch gameplay of their predecessors, they're brought to you in glorious HD using vector graphics to provide clean, never pixelated graphics and advanced Newtonian physics.
Terra Lander, Terra Lander II – Rockslide Rescue, and Terra Bomber each offer the familiar boops and beeps that will inspire fond memories in veteran players while newcomers will appreciate the improved graphics, visual effects, and controls they come to expect from current-gen games.

games.title: Terracotta
games.description: Puzzle adventure inspired by the army of 8,000 terracotta figures that the founder of China built as protection for eternity. Using Taoist principles and non-aggressive tactics, the hero will switch between two opposite dimensions to restore the universal balance and break an ancient spell.

games.title: Terraformers
games.description: Terraformers is a 3X game with roguelite elements in which you terraform Mars. Explore the planet's wonders, exploit its resources and expand by settling new cities. Start the terraforming process: warming the planet, creating oceans and spreading life!

games.title: Terranigma
games.description: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

games.title: TerranLands
games.description: TerranLands is a survival adventure game. Explore and gather resources in many different caves, build and craft new items in your home, and discover old Terran stories.

games.title: Terraria
games.category: Platform, Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Adventure, Indie
games.description: Terraria is a 2D sandbox action-adventure game with platforming and role-playing elements. Players create a character and are placed in a procedurally generated world where they mine resources, craft equipment, build structures, and fight enemies. Progression is driven by defeating bosses that unlock new tiers of items, biomes, and challenges. The game features a class system based on equipped gear, NPC recruitment tied to achievements, and supports both single-player and multiplayer modes. Terraria also includes official modding support through the tModLoader framework.

games.title: Terraria: Bigger and Boulder
games.description: Terraria 1.4.5 is launching on January 27th, Bigger and Boulder than ever before!

games.title: Terraria: Journey's End
games.category: Platform, Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Adventure, Indie
games.description: Terraria: Journey's End is a major update to Terraria released on the game's 9th anniversary. From new ways to play the game, to over 1000 new items to find and craft, to new bosses to challenge, and even a full-pass review of all content of the game for balance, graphic quality, and mechanics - truly, Journey's End has something for everyone.

games.title: TerraTech
games.description: As a prospector starting out on a procedurally generated exo-planet, TerraTech is a galactic exploration game where you need to build an empire from the ground up. Design your own fleet of unique vehicles and take them into battle, and you shape your journey the way you want to, researching the technologies you want and allying yourself with various corporations to create a burgeoning fleet in the lawless frontier of space.

games.title: Terror of Hemasaurus
games.description: A retro city smash 'em up with satisfying destruction physics. Play as a Giant Monster unleashing terror upon mankind in this modern arcade experience with the action turned up to eleven.

games.title: Tesla Force
games.description:
With science as your super power, charge up your coils and zap into action! Tesla Force is a rogue-lite top-down shooter featuring endless procedural gameplay with tentacle splitting action. Play as Tesla, Curie, Lovecraft and Shelley and blast the cosmic horror back into the galactic abyss!

The cosmic horrors are awakening. It's time to call upon the heroes of science and eldritch knowledge to defend mankind from an assault from the outer reaches of reality!

games.title: Tesla vs Lovecraft
games.description: Tesla vs Lovecraft is an intense top-down twin stick arena shooter. Play as the enigmatic inventor Nikola Tesla harnessing the static energy to power up Tesla-Mech and give the lovecraftian nightmares a lesson in horror!

games.title: Teslagrad
games.description: Teslagrad is a 2D puzzle platformer developed by Rain Games. Released in 2013, it is set in a steampunk-inspired world and revolves around the use of magnetism and electricity to solve puzzles. Players control a young boy who must navigate through a mysterious tower, using magnetic powers to manipulate the environment and overcome obstacles. The game is characterised by its lack of dialogue, relying on visual storytelling and atmospheric design to convey its narrative.

games.title: Teslagrad 2
games.description: Teslagrad 2 is the sequel to the original Teslagrad, developed by Rain Games and released in 2023. This 2D puzzle platformer builds upon the magnetic and electrical mechanics of its predecessor, with players once again using these abilities to solve puzzles and traverse complex environments. Set in a new region, the game introduces new powers, enemies, and challenges, while maintaining the visual storytelling and atmospheric design characteristic of the series.

games.title: Teslagrad Power Pack Edition
games.description: Return to the indie classic Teslagrad and discover another tower in the magnetic North in Teslagrad 2.

games.title: Teslagrad Remastered
games.description: Teslagrad Remastered is an updated version of the original Teslagrad, developed by Rain Games and released in 2023. This remastered edition features enhanced graphics, improved animations, and updated sound design while retaining the core puzzle-platforming mechanics of the original game. Players continue to use magnetism and electricity to navigate puzzles and obstacles within a mysterious tower, with the remastered version providing a refined visual and auditory experience.

games.title: Tethered
games.description: In a magical sky borne world, assume the role of a powerful Spirit Guardian charged with restoring life and balance. Command the Peeps, your loyal servants, to feed, fight, build, and sacrifice themselves for the greater good in a quest to release your entombed brethren.

games.title: Tetra's Escape
games.description: Tetra's Escape is a platforming puzzle-game all about blocks. Blocks named Tetras and it is down to the players to all that they can, to save them and make the most out of their special ability.

games.title: Tetra's Escape 2
games.description: Help the tetras find the exit.

games.title: Tetrack
games.description: One simple but hard rule here - you must react very quickly to constantly changing conditions, tasks and speed. A challenge for real players with exceptional skills!

games.title: Tetragon
games.description: Tetragon is a vast mysterious universe of unique puzzles, magical mazes, and challenges! Your goal is to move the plane realities using the spinning world gravity wisely. Test your mind and guide the brave lumberjack through the scattered worlds in search of his lost son!

games.title: Tetraminos
games.description: The classic arcade game is back in a supercharged version! Discover timeless gameplay revamped, practise in Puzzle mode and challenge your friends in local Versus mode with up to 4 players!

games.title: Tetris Effect
games.description: Named after a real-world phenomenon where players' brains are so engrossed that images of the iconic falling Tetrimino blocks linger in their vision, thoughts, and even dreams, Tetris Effect amplifies this magical feeling of total immersion by surrounding you with fantastic, fully three-dimensional worlds that react and evolve based on how you play. Music, backgrounds, sounds, special effects - everything, down to the Tetris pieces themselves, pulse, dance, shimmer, and explode in perfect sync with how you're playing.

games.title: Tetris Effect: Connected
games.description: Tetris Effect: Connected adds an all-new robust multiplayer expansion to the huge variety of addictive and innovative single-player modes that Tetris Effect is known for. Connect and play with or against each other in all-new modes like "Zone Battle," which shakes up traditional 1-on-1 Tetris gameplay via the time-stopping Zone mechanic, or try the innovative co-op of "Connected" mode, where up to three players can literally connect their Tetris playfields together and play as one, as they work together to take down a series of increasingly-challenging CPU-controlled bosses.

games.title: Tetris Forever
games.description:
Tetris Forever celebrates the original, genre-inspiring puzzle game that escaped from behind the Iron Curtain, onto the world stage, and into our cultural consciousness.

More than 15 playable classic games from the series' history are featured, including many being released for the first time outside Japan. Battle your friends in the multiplayer cult favorite Tetris Battle Gaiden, create massive explosions to clear lines in Super Bombliss, and see where it all began in 1984 with an accurate recreation of the first version of Tetris on the Electronika 60 computer.

games.title: Tetris Time Warp
games.description: An original Tetris game created for the Tetris Forever collection. Time Warp features a modern Tetris ruleset, along with special item pieces that send players "back in time" to earlier eras of the Tetris series.

games.title: Tetris Ultimate
games.description: Tetris Ultimate has six exciting modes, fun new features, and unique visuals, the evolution of this iconic game is the ultimate must-have on next-gen consoles.

games.title: Tetrobot and Co.
games.description:
Tetrobot is the world's most popular and reliable robot, but he's not perfect. That's why I, Maya, have built him a microscopic little brother, Psychobot.

Help me guide Psy through Tetrobot's cogs and circuits: by swallowing blocks of matter and spitting them out, we can repair anything. Learn how pipes, lasers, fans and other electronic devices work, learn how to alter the chemical properties of slime, and collect all the memory blocks that you find on the way.

The owners of damaged Tetrobots all around the world rely on us because we are the only people who can repair their precious robots.

games.title: Tetropunk
games.description: The classic arcade is back in a new style! It's time to prove that you are one of the best!

games.title: Tetsumo Party
games.description: It's Tetsumo Party time! Help sumo warriors win in a hilarious competition. Control their arms and legs to fit the incoming bamboo wall or drop out in the most ridiculous way!

games.title: Tevi
games.description: A new game from the creators of Rabi-Ribi, embark on an epic action-adventure as you slash, dash, and combo your way through a sprawling land scarred by conflict. Explore and discover hidden secrets. Customize your build to triumph in spectacular boss fights and unravel the mysteries of the world in TEVI, a bullet hell metroidvania!

games.title: Thank Goodness You're Here!
games.description: Thank Goodness You're Here! is an absurd comedy slapformer set in the bizarre Northern English town of Barnsworth. As a traveling salesman, take the time to see the sights and meet the locals, who are very eager to give you a series of increasingly odd jobs…

games.title: Thapster TV
games.description:
Thapster TV is an updated version of the original rhythm game Thapster, which was first released in Thailand in 2013 on iOS and later on Android in 2014.

Currently, the game can be purchased on both the PlayStation Store and the Microsoft Store.

The original mobile game uses touch controls to hit keys coming towards the screen across 3 tracks on the basic level and up to 5 tracks on the expert level. As for the console version, it use button controls over six tracks each.

There are now music videos playing in the background and it also has a 360 video mode. A story mode is included with the console version, as well as over ten original songs.

games.title: Thapster TV: 2nd Wave
games.description: The sequel to the PS4/XB1 edition of the rhythm video game Thapster TV.

games.title: Tharsis
games.category: Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Adventure, Indie, Card & Board Game
games.description:
Tharsis is a turn-based space strategy game. With dice and cannibalism. It puts you in control of humanity's first manned mission to Mars, just as it's struck by a micrometeoroid storm. You must guide your crew through disasters, food shortages, and the unforgiving nature of space - all while maintaining your sanity amidst cryptic signals and warnings from Mars.
Defy the odds, make the difficult decisions, and embark on the most important mission in human history.

games.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Isekai Chronicles
games.description: Experience a slice of the Jura Tempest Federation life with friends

games.title: That Trivia Game
games.description: Trivia quiz game with support for up to 4 players.

games.title: That's My Family: Family Fun Night
games.description: Family Fun Night is the first game from That's My Family to offer both original board games and classic games that were part of your childhood! Play 14 different games, from Snakes and Ladders to Parcheesi, Chess and 4 in a Row, and many more!

games.title: That's You!
games.description: The party game all about… you! Set off on a journey of discovery with up to five of your friends and family, and find out what you really think about each other. Joining the fun is easy: all you need is your phone or tablet. Snap a selfie and enjoy tons of funny questions, texting games, and drawing challenges.

games.title: The 25th Ward: The Silver Case
games.description:
The remake of The Silver Case sequel, originally released on mobile devices, that was known as "Silver Jiken: 25-Ku" in Japan or "The Silver Case: Ward 25" in English.
This is the first time the game has been released outside of Japan.

games.title: The 7th Guest
games.description:
Henry Stauf's mansion has been abandoned for as long as anyone dare remember. Stauf was a master toy maker, a maker of amazing puzzles and this strange, eerie, mansion was his greatest creation.
It stands empty, rotting ever since children started dying with his toys near them, ever since six guests came and were never seen again.

Now, you are in the house, moving from one room to another, trying to remember and trying to forget. Because Stauf's game isn't over. There were six guests the world knew about - and there was one other.
The mansion of horror comes to life again and only you can end this mad nightmare and learn the secret of the 7th guest.

games.title: The Abandoned Planet
games.description: When a wormhole tears open in space, an astronaut is hurled down and crashes on a distant planet. But where is she? Where are all the inhabitants of the planet? And how is she going to get back home? Solve the puzzle and piece together the mystery in this 2D, pixel art, first person, point and click adventure.

games.title: The Addams Family: Mansion Mayhem
games.description: Only you and your friends can help Wednesday, Pugsley, Gomez, and Morticia save the Addams Family Mansion in this horrifyingly hilarious 3D adventure for up to four players. The mansion is full of spooky scares – but can you discover its hair-raising secrets and save it from an unexpected threat? Use each iconic character's abilities to explore the house, solve puzzles, and find lost relics. Play competitive minigames that will have you bumping and jumping over each other to win.

games.title: The Adventure Pals
games.description:
An epic adventure fueled by imagination. Enter a gorgeous world in a game about friendship, exploration & riding giraffes.
The Adventure Pals is an epic adventure platformer fueled by imagination. Enter a gorgeous & hilarious world in a game about friendship, exploration & riding giraffes.

games.title: The Adventures of 00 Dilly
games.description: After Crash-Test-Dummy 00 Dilly withstood several tests in the 1950s and was thrown into the dump, some confused aliens mistakenly breathed life into 00 Dilly. WOW! OK, 00 Dilly is definitely not too bright, but he wants to prove to the world that he's the right test dummy for any kind of test.

games.title: The Adventures of Elena Temple: Definitive Edition
games.description: Experience The Adventures of Elena Temple in a Definitive Edition, including more content, more features, more fun and more... black and white pixel art!

games.title: The Adventures of Hori
games.description: Join Hori and his lovable crew of baby astronauts and their loyal Bernese Mountain Dog, Charlie, as they blast off on a thrilling journey across the galaxy! In The Adventures of Hori, you'll unravel cosmic mysteries, outsmart villainous cats known as the “Ronronneurs Maléfiques,” and discover magical objects like the Destructive Lollipop, all while forging bonds of friendship and teamwork. This heartwarming and humorous space tale is brought to life with adorable cartoon visuals, interactive choices, and immersive storytelling perfect for young players and families alike.

games.title: The Adventures of Panzer: Legacy Collection
games.description: Enter the epic and ridiculous world of General Panzer

games.title: The Alchemist of Ars Magna
games.description: The main character enters a school and gains experience in research, study, and love. This is the adventure story of an alchemist who grows through encounters and experiences and paves the way.

games.title: The Alliance Alive HD Remastered
games.description: Rise up and ignite the resistance in The Alliance Alive HD Remastered! Explore diverse realms, awaken new skills mid-battle, and forge alliances to challenge the Daemons that have taken over the world!

games.title: The Alliance Alive HD Remastered: Awakening Edition
games.description: Physical version with Nine "Night Ravens" Cutout paper dolls

games.title: The Alpha Wolf
games.description: The Alpha Wolf is an RPG animal simulator game. Play as a wolf in this open world environment. Hunt and kill animals, gather your own wolf pack, upgrade their skills and become stronger. Unlock magic skills to hunt stronger animals, to fight bosses or other players in PVP Arena Battles.

games.title: The Alto Collection
games.description:
Across the endless desert and atop an alpine expanse two journeys full of wonder await. Choose your path and set off on a thrilling snowboarding or sandboarding adventure with Alto & friends.

Full access to both Alto's Adventure and Alto's Odyssey, including over 120 levels, 360 goals, 7 unique characters, and a workshop full of upgrades

games.title: The Amazing American Circus
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Tactical, Adventure, Indie, Card & Board Game
games.description: The Amazing American Circus tells a story of the most iconic entertainment in American history. The USA, during the Gilded Age, is a turbulent place. On the East Coast springs up a modern metropolis, while in the west, cowboys and robber barons fight for their business. The new era is coming, and this is the last right moment for the circus to flourish!

games.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
games.category: Fighting, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description: The Amazing Spider-Man 2 is an open-world third-person action-adventure game set in a version of Manhattan. Players control Spider-Man, web-swinging and wall-crawling across the city while completing story missions and optional street-level activities such as stopping crimes and rescuing civilians. Combat uses a free-flowing style with counterattacks and gadgets, and a Web-Rush mechanic lets players plan movement and strikes. A Hero and Menace reputation system rewards responding to crimes and penalizes ignoring them, which affects how the city and its enforcers treat Spider-Man. It is based on the continuity of the 2012 game rather than the films.

games.title: The Aquatic Adventure of the Last Human
games.description:
From kickstarter: "The Aquatic Adventure of the Last Human is a metroid-vania styled action/adventure game where you play as the navigator of Argo 9, a spaceship/submarine hybrid, thrust back to Earth in a time after humans have gone extinct. Whereupon one will have to explore to uncover the reasons for humanity's downfall meanwhile encountering monstrous sea creatures.

The focus of this game lies in exploration, story and boss battles. It is up to the player to determine if the ruins of our species is a travesty or an inevitable conclusion."

games.title: The Arkane Collection
games.description: The Arkane Collection includes Dishonored: Definitive Edition, Dishonored 2, Dishonored: Death of the Outsider, Prey, Prey: Mooncrash, Typhon Hunter, Redfall and DEATHLOOP Deluxe Edition!

games.title: The Artful Escape
games.category: Music, Platform, Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Adventure, Indie
games.description: On the eve of his first performance, Francis Vendetti battles with the legacy of a dead folk legend and the cosmic wanderings of his own imagination. In this 2D adventure platformer, Francis, a teenage guitar prodigy, sets out on a psychedelic, multidimensional journey to inspire his stage persona.

games.title: The Ascent
games.description: The Ascent is a solo and co-op action RPG set in a cyberpunk world. The mega corporation that owns you and everyone, The Ascent Group, has just collapsed. Confusion and chaos ensue, security and order are in disarray, and without protection, everyone is left to fend for themselves. Stop gangs and hostile corporations from taking over and discover what really happened.

games.title: The Ascent: Cyber Edition
games.description:
The Cyber Edition includes:
- Base Game
- CyberSec Pack
- Cyber Warrior Pack
- Cyber Heist DLC

Physical Cyber Edition also includes:
- Steelbook
- 88 Pages Artbook
- Tuck-in Box

games.title: The Ascent: Cyber Heist
games.description: Completed The Ascent but are itching for more? Cyber Heist is for you! Solo or in co-op with your friends, take on new challenging missions, explore brand new environments, fight your way against new enemies, and experience new ways of fighting using melee weapons!

games.title: The Ascent: CyberSec Pack
games.description: The CyberSec Pack is the new explosive collection from CyberSec Mega. With 2 new weapons, 1 new tactical, 4 new pieces of armor and 4 new animated weapon skins, you will have all you need to make a bang!

games.title: The Ashen Oz
games.description: A fast-paced dark fantasy action roguelite where you chain attacks and parries into fluid, combo-driven combat through a twisted fairytale world.

games.title: The Assembly
games.description: A first-person interactive story inspired by real-world anxieties, The Assembly is a long-form game designed for VR. Explore a morally ambiguous organization as two individuals and face tough decisions from contrasting perspectives, that culminate in one of multiple thrilling conclusions.

games.title: The Awakener: Risen
games.description: Set in a medieval fantasy world, Arise of Awakener is a third-person action-adventure game with a class system that gives players direct control in how they choose to fight. With three class choices - mages, archers, and warriors, the way players decide to fight the fantastical creatures which fill this world is entirely up to them. Battles are great spectacles in which players must use their abilities and weapons to overcome the trials and challenges they will face. Fight dragons, control flying airships, collect resources and explore the expansive world that Arise of Awakener offers

games.title: The Awakening of Mummies
games.category: Puzzle, Adventure, Indie, Card & Board Game
games.description: Using your puzzle-solving skills, guide all mummies through various chambers full of traps to finally set them free from the evil Pharaoh Cléo.

games.title: The Awesome Adventures of Captain Spirit
games.description: Have you ever dreamt of being a superhero? Meet Chris, a creative and imaginative 9 year old boy who escapes reality with fantastical adventures as his alter ego, the Awesome Captain Spirit! Captain Spirit is a free demo set in the Life is Strange universe.

games.title: The Backrooms
games.description: The Backrooms is a horror adventure game where you explore the liminal space of the Backrooms while you interact with strange and creepy characters. Explore the Backrooms, find the unexpected as you go into impossible spaces and see things you shouldn't have seen.

games.title: The Backrooms 1998
games.description: The Backrooms 1998 is a first-person found footage psychological horror survival game where it tells the story of a young teen after accidentally falling into the depths of The Backrooms in 1998. Roam freely, mark, explore and try unravel the story - however you are not alone. Don't scream.

games.title: The Backrooms: Maze Escape
games.description: Trapped in an endless maze of yellow-tinted halls and eerie silence, your only hope is to find the exit before you lose your mind. The Backrooms: Maze Escape is a first-person exploration game inspired by the viral Backrooms mythos, where every hallway looks the same and reality feels distant. Collect as many coins as possible and try to complete each level as quickly as you can. Navigate two increasingly unsettling levels with no map and no guidance - only your memory and instincts.

games.title: The Bagman
games.description: The bagman is an authentic retro 16-bit horror point and click/survival horror that layers in stealth, commandable NPCS, and gratuitous slasher gore! Time and events continually tick forward, and any of your friends can die. Many paths to follow, multiple endings. Will you survive?

games.title: The Banner Saga
games.description: The Banner Saga is a Viking-themed tactical role-playing video game.

games.title: The Banner Saga 2
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Tactical, Adventure, Indie
games.description: The award winning and BAFTA nominated saga continues in The Banner Saga 2. Continue your journey soon after the climactic events of The Banner Saga. The choices you made in the first game will affect who is alive and who is dead in this exciting sequel.

games.title: The Banner Saga 3
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Tactical, Indie
games.description: Banner Saga 3 is the final dramatic chapter in the mature, story-driven Viking RPG series which has won over 20 awards and has been nominated for 4 BAFTA awards. As the world continues to crumble around you, who can you trust, how will you protect your allies and what choices will you make as the Darkness draws near?

games.title: The Banner Saga Complete Pack
games.description: A bundle containing The Banner Saga and The Banner Saga 2 along with the survival mode update/add-on for it.

games.title: The Banner Saga Trilogy: Bonus Edition
games.description:
Weave your own thread through this epic Viking RPG adventure!
Guide your caravan across the landscape of a breaking world, where the sun has stopped in the sky and the gods are dead. Bold leadership decisions, wise use of resources, and skillful battle tactics are vital to ensure that you and your clans make it through alive.
Bonus Edition Includes:

- Banner Saga 1/2/3
- Best of Soundtrack
- Mini Art Book
- Collectible Poster
- Horn of Lichbaen In-Game Item

games.title: The Bard's Tale IV
games.description: The Bard's Tale IV: Barrows Deep takes players to an astonishing adventure packed with puzzle-filled dungeon-crawling and turn-based strategy combat. Blending classic RPG gameplay and fantasy storytelling with modern design and visuals, The Bard's Tale IV: Barrows Deep is perfect for longtime fans and intrepid newcomers alike.

games.title: The Bard's Tale IV: Director's Cut
games.description: The Bard's Tale IV: Director's Cut is the triumphant return of one of the most iconic RPG series of all-time. Delve into a tactically rich combat system that rewards creativity, solve puzzles to gain treasure and advantages, and discover a beautifully crafted world.

games.title: The Bard's Tale: Remastered and Resnarkled
games.description: You are the Bard: a selfish rogue weary of pointless sub-quests and rat-infested cellars. Through magical song you summon characters to join your quest for coin and cleavage!

games.title: The Baseball T
games.description: Throw the ball to become the best baseball player in the world.

games.title: The Basketball B
games.description: Dribble the ball to become the best baller in the world.

games.title: The Basketball Quiz
games.description: Do you want to learn some amazing facts about basketball? We have the right game for you The Basketball Quiz.

games.title: The Bat D
games.description: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Collect flies with the main hero of the game The Bat D. Collect all flies in the world!

games.title: The Bat Quiz
games.description: Do you want to learn some amazing facts about bats? We have the right game for you The Bat Quiz.

games.title: The Bear B
games.description: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Catch fish with the main hero of the game The Bear B and chatch all the fish in the world!

games.title: The Beast Inside
games.description: The Beast Inside is a gripping new twist on thriller and survival horror genres, telling a multi-layered story about cryptanalyst discovering a hundred-year-old murder-mystery that not only remains unresolved, but also puts his very life at risk.

games.title: The Beastmaster Princess
games.description: In this fantasy visual novel, Take the role of Kunya and find out what happened to prince Merril with the help of Luna, Takara, Manila and Lyara. You'll face numerous dangers and in doing so, perhaps you will discover love along with the hidden power of Lyara, the beastmaster princess.

games.title: The Big Con
games.description: Flex your inner teenager in The Big Con, an adventure game where you hustle across the country as a teen trying to save your family video store. In classic 90s con movie style, you'll get to persuade and pilfer your way to greatness using a whack of potential grifts.

games.title: The Big Con: Grift of the Year Edition
games.description: Grift through the totally rad '90s in all its plaid and payphone glory!

games.title: The Bike: Moto Ride Simulator
games.description: Rev up your adventure.Experience the thrill of the open road in the ultimate motorcycle escapade.

games.title: The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth
games.description: The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth is the massively updated expansion to 2014's roguelike of the year, The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth. Following Isaac one more time on his journey players will find bizarre treasures that change Isaac's form giving him super human abilities and enabling him to fight off droves of mysterious creatures, discover secrets and fight his way to safety.

games.title: The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth+
games.description: The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth+ is a dungeon-crawling shoot-'em-up that's literally a different game each and every time you play it! The randomly generated maps are built with over 11,000 unique room configurations, each populated with a nearly endless variety of enemies, items, challenges and secrets!

games.title: The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth+
games.description: The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth+ is a dungeon-crawling shoot-'em-up that's literally a different game each and every time you play it! The randomly generated maps are built with over 11,000 unique room configurations, each populated with a nearly endless variety of enemies, items, challenges and secrets!

games.title: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
games.category: Shooter, Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Adventure, Indie, Arcade
games.description: A top-down roguelike action-adventure game and remake of the 2011 original, rebuilt from its Flash engine to enable expanded content and features. Players control Isaac through procedurally generated dungeon floors, using tears as projectiles to defeat monsters while collecting items that modify abilities and appearance in potentially powerful combinations. Runs end in permadeath, and each playthrough offers different layouts, items, and bosses. The game has received four expansions adding characters, floors, items, co-op multiplayer, modding support, and online play. Inspired by the biblical story of the same name and its designer's religious upbringing.

games.title: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance
games.description: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance is the ultimate edition of the genre-defining roguelike, with so many additions and improvements that it feels like a brand new game. Experience Isaac's adventures with new twists, terrifying turns and over 500 hours of new gameplay!

games.title: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance
games.description: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance is the ultimate edition of the award-winning roguelike twin-stick shooter. It includes all the content from previous editions of The Binding of Isaac (Rebirth, Afterbirth and Afterbirth+) plus Repentance, the game's final and biggest-ever expansion, adding hundreds of additional new features, modes, and improvements. Experience the modern classic like it's never been seen before!

games.title: The BioWare Bundle
games.description: Experience two great games from the award-winning developer BioWare.

games.title: The Bit's Escape
games.description: Bit's is a small machine built in a underground factory, his dream is to escape and discover life beyond what is below the earth.

games.title: The Bit.Trip
games.description: A collection of the six original Bit.Trip games for the PS3, PS4, and Vita.

games.title: The Blackout Club
games.description: The Blackout Club is a first-person co-op horror game centered around a group of teenage friends investigating a monstrous secret beneath the skin of their small town. 1-4 players explore procedurally-generated missions against a fearsome enemy you can only see with your eyes closed.

games.title: The Blind Prophet
games.category: Point-and-click, Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Adventure, Indie, Visual Novel
games.description:
Lead the apostle Bartholomeus through a comic book-style experience.

The Blind Prophet offers a mature look at the Point 'n' Click genre. The gameplay and experience builds its foundation on a strong storyline, a sense of fluidity and a darkly pleasing ambience.

games.title: The Blizzard 30-Year Celebration Collection
games.description:
Relax and rewind with the Blizzard Arcade Collection, featuring faithful reproductions of Blackthorne, The Lost Vikings, Rock N Roll Racing, Lost Vikings 2 and RPM Racing for modern platforms.
This collection contains two different Original Editions as well as a new Definitive Edition for the first 3 games and the Original Editions of the latter 2 games - bringing you the gameplay you remember plus a variety of new features, quality of life improvements, and behind-the-scenes content.
