This bundle also provides content for Overwatch and Diablo III on the platform it was purchased for.

games.title: The Bloody First
games.category: Shooter, Real Time Strategy (RTS), Strategy, Tactical
games.description: The Bloody First is an action real time strategy first person shooter game. The game will include battle selection, weather options, pre-battle planning, and player customization as well as user created military divisions. Plans for post-launch will include workshop created battles as well as workshop created modifications to the game.

games.title: The Bluecoats: North & South
games.category: Shooter, Real Time Strategy (RTS), Strategy, Arcade
games.description: Reunite with Sergeant Cornelius M. Chesterfield and Corporal Blutch in this remastered game that combines turn-based strategy and real-time action. This new version will delight fans of the original game, initially released on the Amiga at the end of the 1980s!

games.title: The Bluecoats: North vs South - Limited Edition
The Book of Regrets
games.description: Experience an interactive story like never before! Escape dangerous dungeons, befriend or kill enigmatic creatures, and solve puzzles as you explore a mysterious world. Your decisions directly impact the story in various ways.

games.title: The Book of Unwritten Tales 2
games.description: Every world needs its heroes. However unlikely they may seem. Join Wilbur, Ivo, Nate and Critter in another classic point-and-click adventure in the wicked world of Aventásia. Help them fulfill their destiny. A destiny as yet unwritten.

games.title: The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales
games.category: Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Turn-based strategy (TBS), Adventure, Indie
games.description: The Bookwalker is a narrative adventure where you play as Etienne Quist, a writer-turned-thief with the ability to dive into books. Use your powers to traverse reality and book worlds, and track and retrieve famous items like Thor's Hammer and the Excalibur in exchange for your creative freedom.

games.title: The Bounty Huntress
games.description: In this a Metroidvania style game made in crispy pixel art, Join Rhea , a bounty huntress with a task to save some people who have been kidnapped and taken to an old abandoned castle where there are many dangers, she needs your help to rescue these people and to bring peace to the city of Vaunard

games.title: The BoX
games.description: The Box takes the speed of a beloved platformer of old and mixes it up with color based powers and adaptations. Here you will find a mystery only you can solve with complex challenges along the way to guide you in finding the answer. Use the 6 colors at your disposal to take on the treacherous Box and find your way to freedom. Not all data is perfect. Lead our spherical little hero through The Box as he aims to find a world where its curves aren't so out of place.

games.title: The Boys Escape
games.description: Gather and lead your army to the finish line! Face your enemies and win the battle!

games.title: The Bradwell Conspiracy
games.description: The Bradwell Conspiracy is a highly-stylized, narrative-driven first person experience. Featuring innovative photography gameplay and lore-enriching secrets, are you ready to delve into a world of corporate duplicity?

games.title: The Bread Pub Brawlers
games.description: Get The Bread Pub Brawlers, Fighting game for PS4 console from the official PlayStation website. Explore The Bread Pub Brawlers game detail, demo, images, videos, reviews.

games.title: The Bridge
games.category: Platform, Puzzle, Strategy, Adventure, Indie, Arcade
games.description: A black-and-white puzzle game inspired by the art of M. C. Escher. Players guide a character through hand-drawn levels by rotating the world, which shifts the direction of gravity so that ceilings can become floors. Each level is a self-contained puzzle whose goal is to reach the exit door.

games.title: The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication
games.description: The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication is part two of The Bridge Curse series. It's a first-person survival horror game where the player controls four characters during Wen Hua University's "Carnival of Horror." What lurks around the corner is foreboding dread, a few laughs, and of course... pure fear.

games.title: The Bridge Curse: Road to Salvation
games.description: Fear, anxiety, and laughter are the symbol of youth. Experience the true paranormal haunting with your friends from the first-person perspective and stay alive. An adaptation of a horror film, includes Taiwanese urban legend and an intriguing backstory.

games.title: The Bronze Age
games.description:
This year you have been assigned to be the CEO of the Bronze mine.
To start mining the bronze and become the biggest bronze mine in the world.
Good Luck and Have Fun.

games.title: The Brookhaven Experiment
games.description: Brookhaven is a VR survival shooter for the HTC Vive. Players will have to use the weapons and tools provided to survive ever more terrifying waves of horrific monsters in an attempt to figure out what caused the beginning of the end of the world, and, if they're strong enough, stop it from happening.

games.title: The Bug Butcher
games.description: The Bug Butcher is an action-packed 2D side scrolling shoot em up game where peril comes from above. The core mechanics hold old ties from the classic arcade shooter "Super Pang" where you shoot vertically, but with modern day twists. You are Harry, a brash and tenacious exterminator who has a knack for decimating bugs. Harry's current assignment takes him to an infested futuristic research facility on a distant planet. The surviving and dwindling number of scientists employed him for his slaughtering skills.

games.title: The Bunker
games.description: The Bunker is a completely live action experience with point-and-click interactivity. Filmed on location in a decommissioned government nuclear bunker, it features a plot crafted by writers and designers behind titles like The Witcher, SOMA and Broken Sword, and incredible cast including Adam Brown (The Hobbit) and Sarah Greene (Penny Dreadful, Assassin’s Creed 3).

games.title: The Burger Quiz
games.description: Do you want to learn some amazing facts about the burger? We have the right game for you The Burger Quiz.

games.title: The Button Be: Fields
games.description: Through loss and acquest alike, make these Fields a little more beautiful.

games.title: The Button Be: Mizzle
games.description: Meet a grand mysterious construction. Bring out some awesome things in this bite-sized experimental quest.

games.title: The Button Be: Unexpected
games.description: Bring out even more wonderful things now! Just figure out how they come and at what cost...

games.title: The Cabin Factory
games.description: Your job at the Cabin Factory is simple: inspect the cabins and decide on whether they’re haunted or not. If you do find any anomalies, get out…immediately.

games.title: The Caligula Effect 2
games.description: In The Caligula Effect 2 a virtuadoll named Regret has created the world of Redo in order to save people from their past regrets by unknowingly imprisoning them in a simulation. However, this "paradise" is shaken to the core when a virtual idol named X breaks into Regret's virtual reality and restores a high school student's memories of the real world. In order to escape Redo, they re-establish the Go-Home Club, a resistance group that seeks to fight against Regret and her enforcers, the Obbligato Musicians.

games.title: The Caligula Effect 2: First Press Limited Edition
games.description:
In The Caligula Effect 2 a virtuadoll named Regret has created the world of Redo in order to save people from their past regrets by unknowingly imprisoning them in a simulation. However, this "paradise" is shaken to the core when a virtual idol named X breaks into Regret's virtual reality and restores a high school student's memories of the real world. In order to escape Redo, they re-establish the Go-Home Club, a resistance group that seeks to fight against Regret and her enforcers, the Obbligato Musicians.

The First Press Limited Edition contains:
- Game: The Caligula Effect 2
- Special album CD Side
- Special art book (100 page)
- Oguchi-illustrated image reproduction
- The Caligula Effect 2 documentary movie DVD
- Additional music DLC
- In-game item DLC
- Special illustrated box

games.title: The Caligula Effect: Overdose
games.description: Mobius. An idyllic world that exists for the sake of letting people forget about the pain and problems of reality. In this world created by a sentient vocaloid program, μ, reality and fantasy has become blurred, allowing people to relive their high school years in bliss. Yet in this seemingly beautiful and perfect world, something is amiss. Escape from this false paradise with your fellow students and return to reality in The Caligula Effect: Overdose!

games.title: The Callisto Protocol
games.description: In this narrative-driven, third-person survival horror game set 300 years in the future, the player will take on the role of Jacob Lee – a victim of fate thrown into Black Iron Prison, a maximum-security penitentiary located on Jupiter's moon, Callisto. When inmates begin to transform into monstrous creatures, the prison is thrown into chaos.

games.title: The Callisto Protocol: Contagion Bundle
games.description: Death is only the beginning in Contagion Mode, The Callisto Protocol's ultimate survival horror experience. Fight tactically and use your ammunition wisely - Contagion Mode's difficulty is custom balanced with stronger enemies and limited resources.

games.title: The Callisto Protocol: Day One Edition
games.description:
Pre-purchase now to get the following digital content:
- Retro Prisoner Character & Weapons Skin

Survive to escape the horrors of Callisto and uncover the dark secrets of Jupiter's dead moon.

games.title: The Callisto Protocol: Final Transmission
games.description: Dig deeper into the horrifying secrets of The Callisto Protocol.

games.title: The Callisto Protocol: Riot Bundle
games.description: Experience the Riot Bundle, featuring the all-new Riot Mode, new animations showcasing lethal kills, and an exciting new cosmetic collection.

games.title: The Capybara P
games.description: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Eat grass with the main hero of the game The Capybara P and eat all the grass in the world!

games.title: The Card Perfect Collection Plus: Texas Hold 'em, Solitaire and Others
games.description: An all-in-one collection for all your card game needs! Whether it's solitaire or competitive online games like Daifugo or Blackjack you're after, this is the game for you!

games.title: The Case of the Golden Idol
games.description: A new kind of detective game that allows you to think and investigate freely. Discover clues surrounding 12 strange and gruesome deaths and build your own theory. Pick your suspect, deduce the motive, unmask the awful truth.

games.title: The Casebook of Arkady Smith
games.description: An open world investigation game set in a futuristic city. Take on the role of Arkady Smith, the famous investigator in this third person adventure game.

games.title: The Cases of the Thousands Shogi Records
games.description: This is a mystery adventure in which you set out to find out where one of the strongest shogi masters disappeared off to.

games.title: The Casino Collection: Ruleta, Vídeo Póker, Tragaperras, Craps, Baccarat, Five-Card Draw Poker, Texas hold 'em, Blackjack and Page One
games.description: Enjoy ten standard casino games!

games.title: The Castle Game
games.description: The Castle Game is a strategy castle building game from Neptune Interactive.

games.title: The Cat and the Coup
games.description: The Cat and the Coup is a documentary game in which you play the cat of Dr. Mohammed Mossadegh, the first democratically elected Prime Minister of Iran. During the summer of 1953, the CIA engineered a coup to bring about his downfall. As a player, you coax Mossadegh back through significant events of his life by knocking objects off of shelves, scattering his papers, jumping on his lap and scratching him.

games.title: The Cat With Amazing Hat
games.description: A small 2D platformer about a cat in an amazing hat. Go through all the obstacles, flying platforms, strange pistons, evil insects and mice. But all these obstacles should not prevent you from guiding the cat to the portal! But be careful, one wrong move and you will have to start all over again.

games.title: The Catch: Carp & Coarse - Collector's Edition
games.description: The Catch: Carp & Coarse Collector's Edition contains not only the core experience but also Jezioro Bestii and the Lake Beasts Equipment Pack for one great price!

games.title: The Catch: Carp & Coarse Fishing
games.description: The Catch: Carp & Coarse Fishing is a species hunting fishing game from Dovetail Games about the passion and pursuit of what lurks beneath the waters. Take on the hunt of a lifetime as you target and pursue monster-sized fish around the world. With 35 species to hunt, you'll have to work up your strategy, skill and tactics to catch every boss fish in each venue. It'll take both patience and adrenaline to succeed as you choose your angling spot carefully, based on time of day, weather conditions and perfect equipment setup, before casting out into the water to battle and catch these elusive creatures.

games.title: The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story
games.description: The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story centers around the ill-fated Shijima family, who have experienced a chain of inexplicable deaths in their family over the past century. Players will take on the role of mystery novelist, Haruka Kagami and use their powers of deductions to uncover the truth behind four murder cases that have taken place in the Shijima household over the last one hundred years.

games.title: The Chainsaw Incident
games.description: The Chainsaw Incident is a high-definition 2D horror/comedy fighting game.

games.title: The Chase: Cop Pursuit
games.description:
The Chase is finally here. A thrilling and action-packed game that will have your heart racing! Prepare to unleash your inner speed monster as you take on the role of a driver who is being chased by the cops.

It's a challenging game in which you'll be immersed in a world of powered car races and exciting driving. Take control of a variety of customized cars and abilities, each with its own unique characteristics, and overcome your pursuers with your expert driving abilities. Explore smoothly created maps inspired by Eastern culture to give your escape ways a unique touch.

As you race through the maps you will come across power-ups that can give you a significant advantage in your daring escape. Keep an eye out for NOS to boost your car's speed and leave your pursuers in the dust. Additionally, strategically deploying mines can slow down police cars in order to earn victory.

Prepare to be on the edge of your seat with a captivating storyline that immerses you in danger, Can you escape the police? Prove your strength as an escape artist. Unlock additional characters to enrich your gameplay.

games.title: The Chase: Police Rush
games.description: The Chase is an endless driving game where you take the role of a driver on the run from the police. Set on an open, continuous maps, the objective is simple: stay ahead of the cops for as long as possible while avoiding obstacles and collecting essential items like fuel, magnets, coins and presents. With high-speed chases, explosive crashes, and unlockable vehicles and environments, The Chase delivers a heart-pounding experience.

games.title: The Chick C
games.description: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Collect eggs with the main hero of the game The Chick C. Collect all eggs in the world and become the egg warrior.

games.title: The Chicken Quiz
games.description: Do you want to learn some amazing facts about the Chickens? We have the right game for you The Chicken Quiz.

games.title: The Childs Sight
games.description: Discover lost moments through the eyes of a baby, as you explore what remains in the attic. Slowly unraveling the story of what happened to you, while lying in the crib unaware and innocent. With every minute as you explore you will remember more. Horrors will become real and clear.

games.title: The Choice of Life: Middle Ages 2
games.description: Explore your kingdom and rule wisely in the card game - The Choice of Life: Middle Ages 2

games.title: The Church in the Darkness
games.description: From Richard Rouse III and inspired by real-life events, The Church in the Darkness is an action-infiltration game that delves into the radical movements of the 1970s. As a former law enforcement officer, you have resolved to get into Freedom Town and check on your sister's son. But life in Freedom Town may not be what it seems.

games.title: The Closing Walls
games.description: Jump from one wall to the other and collect balls to move the walls back so you do not get crushed.

games.title: The Colonists
games.description: Build a new home for your team of robots as they begin a new life for themselves on a distant planet where they can fulfil their ultimate dream: to be human.

games.title: The Colorful Biplane
games.description: Soar through vibrant skies in The Colorful Biplane! Take control of your bright vintage aircraft and navigate through stunning low-poly landscapes filled with floating rings, hot air balloons, and exciting challenges. Collect points, avoid obstacles, and test your flying skills as you chase the highest score!

games.title: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters
games.description:
The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters is a Korean survival horror-adventure. As Mina Park, you must venture from your deserted school to survive. Explore the surrounding Sehwa district to uncover the shadow realm's secrets and avoid the psychotic killer hellbent on ending your life!

The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters is an atmospheric, story-driven game. Immerse yourself in the warped Sehwa district as you encounter an engaging cast of characters, solve puzzles, discover revealing clues, and fight for survival against a relentless psycho.

Heroines, forced to confront their worst fears, rarely emerge unscathed. Over the course of the story, Mina will encounter dangerous scenarios from which she could sustain permanent damage. Craft items to anticipate future dangers to avoid injury.

Dark Song is now more fearsome and powerful than ever before. Falling into her grasp could spell instant death. Running and wielding your flashlight makes you an easy target. You must precariously balance the urgency of exploration with your absolute need to survive!

games.title: The Coma 2B: Catacomb
games.description:
The Coma 2B: Catacomb is a Korean survival horror adventure. It is a back story of the previous game The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters, and a story bridge of all series. You are back in game as Youngho Choi, the main protagonist of The Coma 1, you must venture from the mirror dimension of reality to survive. What happened between The Coma 1 and The Coma 2? The answer is in here.

Immerse yourself in the warped Sehwa district as you encounter an engaging cast of characters, solve puzzles, discover revealing clues, and fight for survival against a relentless psycho.

Running and wielding your flashlight makes you an easy target. You must precariously balance the urgency of exploration with your absolute need to survive!

games.title: The Coma 3: Bloodlines
games.description: Welcome to the world of The Coma 3: Bloodlines. In this realm of shadows rumors and urban legends become reality, and danger lurks around every corner. If a living intruder dies here, their body will be severed from their spirit and never wake again ...

games.title: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Autumn Girl Skin
games.description: The crisp Korean autumn. The melancholic atmosphere, intertwined with vibrant autumn foliage, feels like a fashion week for Korea's youth. To keep pace with the dazzling fashionistas roaming the streets, Mina adorns herself to the fullest today.

games.title: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Daughter of a Millionaire Skin
games.description: The Sehwa Foundation proved far more formidable than anticipated, and its wealth was beyond imagination! Jihyun, already destined to inherit immense riches, resolved to abandon frugality and indulge herself to the fullest. No one would ever look down on or treat her with contempt.

games.title: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Gangster Shaman Girl Skin
games.description: Upon discovering the shocking dimension known as the Otherworld, Mina became profoundly stressed by the shaman's fate and began to go off the rails.

games.title: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Ghost Agent No. 3 Skin
games.description: Our Youngho is one of a kind; the more splendid the vigilante, the more shabbily he dresses, and he thought it utterly uncool to live in filth just to scrape by. So Youngho went to a tailor in the Coma, picked out a splendid suit, donned a tie, and hid his piercing gaze behind sunglasses.

games.title: The Coma: Recut
games.description: In this creepy Korean survival-horror you take the role of Youngho, a hapless student who finds himself trapped in the nightmarish halls of his high school. After drifting asleep during his final exam, he awakes in the school at night. The only problem is he's not alone. Relentlessly pursued by a psychotic killer, he must now muster the courage to solve the mystery of why he is here and how to escape.

games.title: The Company Man
games.description: A 2D action-adventure where you can hit your crazy co-workers with a keyboard and shoot your evil bosses with emails. Survive the struggles of working life and fulfill your lifelong quest to be CEO!

games.title: The Complex
games.description: The Complex is a female-driven, cinematic FMV sci-fi thriller. The interactive movie stars Michelle Mylett, Kate Dickie and Al Weaver. Actors also include Twitch streamer and Xbox UK presenter, Leah Viathan.

games.title: The Confinement
games.description: The Confinement is a first-person precision platformer. Run, dodge and dash! You are trapped in Confinement, a simulation created by AmokAI. Use your sharp reflexes to overcome obstacles, escape and prove that you are the best at parkour through various levels!

games.title: The Continents: Breakthrough Gaming Activity Center
games.description:
A game in the "Breakthrough Gaming Activity Center" series!
This game's release is part of Breakthrough Gaming's "Bible Video Game Sundays"!

games.title: The Copper Age
games.description:
This year you have been assigned to be the CEO of the Copper mine.
To start mining the copper and become the biggest copper mine in the world.

games.title: The Copper Canyon Shoot Out
games.description: The Copper Canyon Shoot-Out is a fast paced VR shooter set in a Wild West themed world overrun by robots. You find yourself outnumbered and outgunned against an invasion of corrupted enforcement machines.

games.title: The Council
games.description: The Council is an episodic game that delivers a fresh new take on the narrative adventure genre. Make hard-hitting decisions, develop an array of skills, and directly impact how the story unfolds. With permanent, long-lasting consequences, there is no going back. Plunge into a tale of intrigue and manipulation in the style of a classic murder mystery, interacting with a cast of alluring characters each hiding their own dark secrets. Trust no one while uncovering dire truths - no matter the cost to mind and body.

games.title: The Council: Episode 1 - The Mad Ones
games.description:
The Council is an episodic game that delivers a fresh new take on the narrative adventure genre. Make hard-hitting decisions, develop an array of skills, and directly impact how the story unfolds. With permanent, long-lasting consequences, there is no going back.

In episode 1: The Mad Ones, you set off on your journey with Louis de Richet on Lord Mortimer's private island, in an attempt discover the fate of your missing mother before it’s too late. Joining you are several high-profile guests. The strange nature of this private reception goes beyond just the prestigious guests - and each of the colorful cast seems to have their own hidden agendas.

games.title: The Council: Episode 2 - Hide and Seek
games.description:
The Council is an episodic game that delivers a fresh new take on the narrative adventure genre. Make hard-hitting decisions, develop an array of skills, and directly impact how the story unfolds. With permanent, long-lasting consequences, there is no going back.

Continue your adventure, find your mother and live with the consequences of your choices in The Council Episode 2: Hide and Seek.

games.title: The Council: Episode 3 - Ripples
games.description:
The Council is an episodic game that delivers a fresh new take on the narrative adventure genre. Make hard-hitting decisions, develop an array of skills, and directly impact how the story unfolds. With permanent, long-lasting consequences, there is no going back.

Continue your adventure in The Council Episode 3: Ripples, where plots are laid bare, characters reach their breaking points, and an unexpected, terrifying truth is uncovered.

games.title: The Council: Episode 4 - Burning Bridges
games.description: Episode 4: Burning Bridges sees allegiances explained, rivalries come to a head, and the ghosts of the past begin to catch up to the inhabitants of the island. Your decisions will haunt you as you decide the fate of Louis, Mortimer, and the world itself.

games.title: The Council: Episode 5 - Checkmate
games.description:
The Council is an episodic game that delivers a fresh new take on the narrative adventure genre. Make hard-hitting decisions, develop an array of skills, and directly impact how the story unfolds. With permanent, long-lasting consequences, there is no going back.

Checkmate is the fifth and final episode of The Council's inaugural season.

games.title: The Count Lucanor
games.description: Pixel adventure inspired by classics like Zelda and Silent Hill.

games.title: The Cow G
games.description: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Milk the cow to collect the milk cans with the main hero of the game The Cow G, so you can save the farm.

games.title: The Cow Quiz
games.description: Do you want to learn some amazing facts about the Cows? We have the right game for you The Cow Quiz.

games.title: The Crackpet Show: Happy Tree Friends Edition
games.description: The Crackpet Show is an action-packed rogue-lite shoot'em-up about mutated animals that fight in a bizarre TV show, crushing their opponents with a variety of weapons. Choose your beastie, gear ‘em up, and go kill your enemies in the name of fame and sweet sponsorship deals!

games.title: The Creepy Syndrome
games.category: Platform, Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Adventure, Indie
games.description: The Creepy Syndrome is an anthology that offers several psychological horror stories, with different pixel art and retro 1 bit, 8 bit, gameboy, etc. styles. Stories of a disturbed mind that intertwine with each other while being analysed by a mysterious psychiatrist.

games.title: The Crew
games.description: Get behind the wheel of this revolutionary action-driving game. The Crew delivers a massive open-world United States, full of highways, alleyways, dirt roads and more. Join up with others to take on challenges, or go solo and explore the countryside in a game populated by other real players.

games.title: The Crew 2
games.description: The newest iteration in the revolutionary franchise, The Crew 2 captures the thrill of the American motorsports spirit in one of the most exhilarating open worlds ever created. Welcome to Motornation, a huge, varied, action-packed, and beautiful playground built for motorsports throughout the entire US of A. Enjoy unrestrained exploration on ground, sea, and sky. From coast to coast, street and pro racers, off-road explorers, and freestylers gather and compete in all kinds of disciplines. Join them in high-octane contests and share every glorious moment with the world.

games.title: The Crew 2: American Summit Pack
games.description: Experience iconic American performance. Featuring the Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 Rift Edition, Dodge Challenger R/T Riff Edition, and Ford GT Ruby Edition. High-powered machines built to stand out and dominate.

games.title: The Crew 2: Audi Car Pack
games.description: Unleash the power of Quattro. Dominate the streets in the Audi RS Q8, carve up corners with the agile 2017 TT RS, and experience a true wagon legend with the iconic 1993 RS2 Avant.

games.title: The Crew 2: Bike Pack
games.description: Rule the open road with high-speed performance. Push the limits on the Ducati Panigale, unleash the raw power of the Kawasaki Z1000, and tear up the track on the fierce 2015 KTM 1190 RC8 R.

games.title: The Crew 2: BMW Car Pack
games.description: Experience precision German engineering at its finest. Drive the futuristic BMW i8 Roadster, rule the streets with the high-performance BMW M2 F87, and feel the wind in the sleek 2011 BMW Z4.

games.title: The Crew 2: European Summit Pack
games.description: Celebrate European precision and prestige. Featuring the Alfa Romeo 4C Serpente Edizione, the Porsche Cayenne Turbo GT Basalt Edition, and the BMW M8 Performance Edition. Bold design and unmistakable character.

games.title: The Crew 2: Gold Edition
games.description: Get The Crew 2 three days early with the Gold Edition. It also features: SteelBook, Season Pass. The Crew 2 Motorsports Deluxe Pack, which includes: Ford F-150 Raptor Race Truck 2017, Abarth 500 2008 Monster Truck Editon, Pilatus PC-21. Take on the American motorsports scene as you explore and dominate the land, air, and sea across the entire US. With a wide variety of exotic cars, bikes, boats, and planes to choose from, experience the unbridled thrill and adrenaline-pumping excitement of competing across the entire US as you test your skills in a wide range of driving disciplines. Record every heart-pounding moment and share them with the simple push of a button. Fame is yours to take!

games.title: The Crew 2: Japanese Summit Pack
games.description: Channel legendary JDM spirit. Featuring the Nissan 300ZX (Z32) Kaido-ou Edition, Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution X Black Knight Edition, and Mazda RX-8 Thunderwave Edition. Agile turbocharged icons built to thrill.

games.title: The Crew 2: Mega Car Pack
games.description: Rule every element with a massive garage featuring the Nissan, BMW, Mercedes, Porsche, and Audi Car Packs, alongside the multi-terrain Sky, Dirt, and Waves Pack plus the high-speed Bike Pack.

games.title: The Crew 2: Mercedes Car Pack
games.description: Unleash luxury and raw V8 power. Cruise in style with the 2009 Mercedes SL63 AMG, dominate the asphalt in the legendary Mercedes SLR722, and turn heads with the iconic gullwing 2010 Mercedes SLS.

games.title: The Crew 2: Nissan Car Pack
games.description: Drive the iconic Nissan 300ZX (Z32), unleash the track-ready Nissan 370Z Nismo, and dominate the streets in the legendary 2020 Nissan GT-R Nismo.

games.title: The Crew 2: Porsche Car Pack
games.description: Experience the iconic Porsche 911 Carrera RS 2.7, dominate with the raw power of the 2022 Cayenne Turbo GT, and blast down the highway in the sleek 2021 Panamera Turbo S Sport Turismo.

games.title: The Crew 2: Sky, Dirt, and Waves Pack
games.description: Master the waters in the high-speed DCB M31 powerboat, slice through the skies with the agile Zivko Edge 540 aerobatic plane, and tear up the trails on the gritty KTM 450 EXC dirt bike.

games.title: The Crew 2: Special Edition
games.description: Take on the American motorsports scene as you explore the USA in one of the most exhilarating open worlds ever created. With a wide variety of vehicles to choose from, experience the thrill and excitement of competing across the USA as you test your skills in a wide range of disciplines. The Special Edition features the Digital Special Pack which includes: Dodge Challenger SRT Demon Interception Unit & Porsche 911 Speedster

games.title: The Crew Motorfest: JDM Custom Car Pack
games.description: When it comes to Japanese-style street racing, performance is nothing without exceptional customization.

games.title: The Crew Motorfest: Year 1 Pass
games.description: Upgrade your garage with the Year 1 Pass and obtain 25 vehicles throughout Year 1!

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest
games.description: The Crew Motorfest is an open-world racing game set on scaled-down versions of the Hawaiian islands of Oahu and Maui. The third entry in The Crew series, it is structured around a festival theme with "Playlists" consisting of staged races, side activities, and challenges built around topics like specific car brands or motorsport disciplines. Players can control cars, boats, and planes across the open world, and multiplayer modes include the Grand Race and Demolition Royale. The game originally started development as DLC for The Crew 2 before becoming a standalone title, and draws comparisons to the Forza Horizon series for its festival-based structure.

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Alfa Romeo Double Car Pack
games.description: Add two of the most iconic cars built by Alfa Romeo in recent history to your vehicle collection! - Alfa Romeo 8C Competizione (2007) - Alfa Romeo Giulia GTAm (2021)

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Audi Double Car Pack
games.description: The looks of a daily driver, the performance of a supercar: that's the Audi RS recipe.

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - BMW Double Car Pack
games.description: Live the true German autobahn experience with 2 high-performance cars produced by the legendary BMW M division, added directly to your vehicle collection! - BMW M4 (2014) - BMW M5 (2011)

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Chase Squad Pack
games.description: Expand your adventure with the Chase Squad Pack! Complete new high-intensity missions and open world challenges. Hunt down all your rivals and unlock up to 7 exclusive Chase Squad vehicles!

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Chevrolet Pack
games.description: The Chevrolet Pack includes the 2017 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1, the 2020 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray C8, and the 2010 Chevrolet Camaro SS.

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Dodge Pack
games.description: The Dodge Pack includes the 2017 Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat and the 2012 Dodge Charger SRT8.

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Drift Pack
games.description: The Drift Pack includes the 2011 BMW M5, the 2016 Nissan 370Z NISMO, and the 1999 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VI GSR.

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Gold Edition
games.description:
Gold Edition includes the game, the Year 1 Pass, and up to three days of early access to the game!

Pre-purchase to get the Liberty Walk Pack, including the Toyota GR Supra 2021 LBWK Edition.

Welcome to Motorfest, the ultimate driving experience! Explore the vibrant open world of the island of O'ahu in Hawaii as you compete in intense races, themed events, and much more!

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 10
games.description: Season 10 of The Crew Motorfest adds “The Motorfest Late Show” (a new playlist with monthly themes and 12 main events), new TrackForge Kit additions for Kaho’Olawe (“Street and Touge” plus Drift Trial/Drift Path with new drift kits and modules), and a new one-hour “Hawaii Grand Tour” time-attack. It also introduces new open-world stories starting August 5, beginning with Kai’s Garage and Project 356 (Porsche 356 reward), plus new radiant/elite bundles and upcoming collaborations.

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 4
games.description:
Time to get ready for what's coming next, Festival-goers!

With Ubisoft Forward fast approaching, we wanted to thank you all for an amazing first year, your continued feedback, and for making The Crew Motorfest what it is today!

We have some exciting news to share with you next week, but before that, we wanted to give you a first look at what's coming for the end of Year 1:

Season 4 will be your next stop at Motorfest - and trust us, your customization skills will have to reach new heights as we kick off a brand-new playlist.

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 5
games.description:
A brand-new Hawaiian island will be added to the game at the launch of Season 5 - in November 2024 - for free!

Maui, a captivating jewel in the Hawaiian crown - the island embodies an exquisite blend of culture, adventure, and natural wonders, thus offering an enchanting setting for the Motorfest Festival.

From the vibrant energy of Kahului urban grounds to the awe-inspiring landscapes of Haleakalā National Park and its bamboo forest, going through the iconic Ohe’o Gulch sacred pools with its cascading waterfalls, Maui beckons with endless exploration.

Maui will add a whopping 345km of total road network to the game, with 229km of that being asphalt and 190km of dirt roads. So, get ready for some amazing island exploration!

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 6
games.description:
Season 6 is just around the corner, and we've partnered with one of the most prolific brands that specialize in getting your blood pumping!

Red Bull are here to shake things up across the paradisiacal islands of Hawaii! Get ready to rev your engines and experience the next evolution of The Crew Motorfest! Season 6 brings a fresh wave of thrilling content, including new Playlists, expanded locations, 17 new vehicles, exciting gameplay updates, and overall polish.

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 7
games.description:
The Crew Motorfest Season 7 is out now and brings two new Playlists, one on day one, the second on August 6, 17 new vehicles, and new quality-of-life improvements to the game, all for free.

Available immediately, the new Playlist, Ferrari Supercars, adds the Enzo Ferrari Museum to the island of Maui, seven main events, more than 25 challenges, six photo ops, six feats, and the yet-to-be-released Ferrari F80 supercar. Players will be able to explore the museum on a journey through Ferrari's most legendary models, guided by Michele Pignatti Morano, Director of the Ferrari Museums.

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 8
games.description: Season 8 of The Crew Motorfest brings two new Playlists, a lineup of 21 new vehicles, Ranked Grand Races, new partnerships, and much, much more

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 9
games.description: Season 9 of The Crew Motorfest adds two new playlists (NASCAR on March 4, 2026, and RC Frenzy on May 6, 2026), a new Hawaii playground island (Kaho’Olawe), and a new TrackForge feature on Moloka’i and Lanai for designing custom tracks. The season also includes 18 new vehicles, plus new NASCAR content with pit stop management, drafting, and a roster of events and challenges including prototype and rival rewards.

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Triple Bike Pack
games.description: Unleash pure power and precision with a selection of premium motorcycles from BMW, Kawasaki, and KTM.

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Year 2 Pass
games.description: Expand your adventure with exclusive new PvE gameplay and a total of 20 new vehicles. The Year 2 Pass includes: The Chase Squad Experience, with an exclusive playlist and new open world challenges. Hunt down all your rivals and unlock 7 exclusive Chase Squad vehicles. 13 new vehicles via monthly drops: 2 vehicles available at the launch of Year 2, and 1 new vehicle added every month.

games.title: The Crew: Motorfest - Year 3 Pass
games.description:
The Year 3 Pass includes:

- A total of 20 new vehicles via monthly drops*, including 2 exclusive vehicles on Day 1: the Ferrari 12Cilindri (2025) and Zenvo Aurora Agil (2026).

- 1 bonus vehicle exclusively for Year 1 Pass or Year 2 Pass owners: the majestic Cadillac Ciel concept.

*2 exclusives vehicles available at purchase + 6 vehicles dropped every season through Year 3 starting with 2 at the start of Season 8

games.title: The Crew: Ultimate Edition
games.description: Explore the first realistic recreation of the entire USA ever built for a driving game in The Crew Ultimate Edition, your all inclusive edition of the revolutionary action driving game released in 2014. The Crew Ultimate Edition includes: The Crew the original game, its expansion, The Crew Wild Run, the Season Pass content and the latest expansion, The Crew Calling All Units.

games.title: The Crew: Wild Run
games.description: The Crew Wild Run is the expansion of the revolutionary action-driving game The Crew released in 2014. Gather with players from around the world to celebrate anything with wheels - from asphalt speedsters to off-road beasts and all kinds of motocycles. You and your crew must earn your ticket to The Summit, a continuous and itinerant championship all over the USA. This is the place to be to try out the wildest vehicles, participate in new challenges and access tuner shops to upgrade your cars into exotic concepts.

games.title: The Crew: Wild Run Edition
games.description: Get The Crew open world driving MMO and The Crew Wild Run expansion in one! Ride recklessly across the entire US map. Customize your cars, monster trucks and motorcycles for mayhem on- and off-road. Join instant stunt and skill challenges. Never drive alone! The Crew Season Pass cars sold separately.

games.title: The Cricket C
games.description: Hit the ball to become the best cricket player in the world.

games.title: The Crown of Wu
games.description:
"The Crown of Wu" (or simply Crown of Wu) is a 3D third-person adventure-action, puzzles and platforms game.

Get ready to explore a new world inspired by Journey to the West, a traditional Chinese tale about the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. You’ll explore the future-past fantasy world as Sun Wukong, fighting alone against enemies and overcoming complex obstacles to retrieve the great Crown stolen by the antagonist Zhu. With Zhu waiting to fight and kill you, will you be able to get back the Crown and save your world from destruction?

games.title: The Cruel King and the Great Hero
games.description: This game is an RPG starring the human child Yuu, who longs to become a "hero," and the dragon "Overlord" who fosters her.

games.title: The Cruel King and the Great Hero: Storybook Edition
games.description: This edition includes the following PS4 Game: The Wicked King and the Noble Hero, Original Box, Mini artbook, Soundtrack CD x 2

games.title: The Cub
games.description: The Jungle Book meets the armageddon. A story-rich, old-school tough platformer inspired by Sega classics but built for today. Platform parkour through the remains of humanity as smooth apocalypse-wave tunes and stories reveal more.

games.title: The Culling II
games.description: The Culling returns to take Battle Royale to the next level. Real-world weapon ballistics. A strategically brutal melee combat system. Perks to customize your play style. Fifty contestants will drop in and compete for glory, but only one will be crowned the winner. Do you have what it takes?

games.title: The Curse 404
games.description: The Curse 404 is a psychological horror puzzle game set inside a mysterious house trapped in a repeating time loop. Each time you awaken, the environment resets but the clues you discover remain.

games.title: The Cursed Frog
games.description:
The Cursed Frog is a single-player puzzle-platformer with an enchanted twist: switch between a brave princess during the day and a cursed frog at night to overcome magical challenges in the heart of Witchwood forest.

Solve environmental puzzles, avoid treacherous traps, and use each form’s unique abilities to forge a path through 30 carefully crafted levels. The day-night shift mechanic changes not only the scenery but also the gameplay: jump higher as the frog to reach hidden areas, or fight enemies as the princess with ranged attacks and agile dashes.

Combine logic and reflexes to activate magic bridges, manipulate platforms, and discover secret routes in this ever-changing enchanted world. Each level brings new challenges that test your creativity and strategy.

games.title: The Cute Whale
games.description: Get ready for an ocean full of puzzles and charm. Guide a lovable whale through 30 handcrafted stages where strategy meets relaxation. Push the turtles onto the buoys and help restore harmony to the sea in this adorable adventure of logic and calm.

games.title: The Czech Run
games.description: The Czech Run is an infinite runner game, where you play as a typical Czech tourist, who is on vacation. Run through the mountains, dodge obstacles, and win the game.

games.title: The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance Tactics
games.description:
In The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance Tactics, lead the heroic Gelfling to restore light to the world of Thra! Experience everything the fantasy world has to offer by playing through–and going beyond–the events of the Netflix series. Encounter never-seen-before playable characters, stories, and environments.
Over the course of 80 unique turn-based campaign battles taking place across the lands of Thra, recruit new allies and customize their forces by assigning them jobs and outfitting them with new equipment.

games.title: The Dark Eye: Chains of Satinav
games.description:
With a history of more than 25 years, The Dark Eye is one of Europe's best-known role-playing brands. In addition to the popular pen & paper adventures, TDE has also inspired a series of successful computer games. The Dark Eye: Chains of Satinav immerses players deep in the world of Aventuria, where they experience an amazing story and explore lands never before featured in a TDE computer game.

In Andergast, whose inhabitants are considered to be notoriously superstitious, King Efferdan awaits a state visit from high-ranking dignitaries. For centuries the kingdom has been at odds with neighboring Nostria, but now first steps are being undertaken toward a lasting peace. But a plague of crows troubles the king, for the birds are acting with unusual aggressiveness, even attacking humans. Moreover, there are those among the citizens of Andergast who swear that the crows are bringing them dark nightmares. As the belligerent creatures infiltrate even the castle itself, the king seeks a skilled bird catcher - an opportunity for young Geron to prove that the reputation for ill luck that has followed him since childhood is undeserved. Following an audience with the king, the prestigious task is assigned to him. However, not only does his task prove unexpectedly difficult, but it also turns out to be the first step of the greatest adventure of his life, which will lead him to the borders of the charted lands of Aventuria and beyond.

games.title: The Dark Eye: Memoria
games.description: Memoria combines classic point & click adventure gameplay with the features of The Dark Eye, one of the most successful RPG universes known in the fantasy world. Point & click adventure game puzzles get a unique twist by adding magical features - and a wise, talking staff. Over eight chapters, players control both Sadja's and Geron's fates, involuntarily interacting with each other and bridging over 500 years of time. Each chapter in Memoria features opulent graphics, epic locations, a thrilling fantasy crime story and a unique puzzle design that differs from chapter to chapter.

games.title: The Dark Pictures Anthology Triple Pack
games.description:
This triple pack includes:
- The Dark Pictures - Little Hope
- The Dark Pictures - Man of Medan
- The Dark Pictures - House of Ashes
- 3 x Exclusive Collectible Pins
- The Dark Pictures Anthology World Cloth Map
- 4 Disc Steelbook

games.title: The Dark Pictures Anthology: House of Ashes
games.description: House of Ashes is the third installment in The Dark Pictures Anthology, a series of standalone cinematic horror games where your decisions determine the story and outcome. During the final days of the Iraq War, a Special Forces unit hunting for weapons of mass destruction discovers a buried Sumerian temple and the ancient horrors dwelling within it. Trapped underground, soldiers and their enemies must work together against creatures that threaten them all. Your choices throughout the game influence character relationships, available actions, and whether the group lives to see daylight.

games.title: The Dark Pictures Anthology: House of Ashes - Pazuzu Edition
games.description:
The Pazuzu Collector's edition, exclusive to the Bandai Namco Entertainment Store includes:

- The House of Ashes game
- The Pazuzu edition box
- An exclusive Underworld creature figurine (9x9x10cm)
- A metal Eclipse pin
- Exclusive art print
- Exclusive stickers
- Access to the Curator's Cut DLC

games.title: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Little Hope
games.description: Trapped and isolated in the abandoned town of Little Hope, 4 college students and their teacher must escape the nightmarish apparitions that relentlessly pursue them through an impenetrable fog.

games.title: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Man of Medan
games.description: Enter the world of The Dark Pictures - A series of standalone cinematic horror games. Players will be challenged to explore and uncover each story with the knowledge that all their choices have consequences and all playable characters can live, any and all can die...

games.title: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Season One
games.description: Season One (2019 - 2022) is the first season of The Dark Pictures Anthology. This season includes the first four installments of the anthology.

games.title: The Dark Pictures Anthology: The Devil in Me
games.description:
A group of documentary film makers receive a mysterious call inviting them to a modern-day replica of serial killer H.H. Holmes ‘Murder Castle’. But on arrival they soon discover they’re being watched, and even manipulated, and suddenly there is much more at stake than just their ratings.

We hope you enjoy your stay...

games.title: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Volume 1 - Limited Edition
games.description:
Box contents:
- Xbox Game: The Dark Pictures - Little Hope
- Xbox Game: The Dark Pictures - Man of Medan
- Dark Pictures Cloth Map
- Map Pins
- Steelcase

games.title: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Volume 2
games.description:
This edition includes the following:
- Game: The Dark Pictures Anthology: House of Ashes
- Game: The Dark Pictures Anthology: The Devil in Me
- 2 Collectible Pins
- House of Ashes Playing Cards
- Hotel Map

games.title: The Dark Prophecy
games.description: The Dark Prophecy is a 2D pixel-art point & click adventure inspired by the best retro games of the 90's. Welcome to a peaceful medieval village, where life is safe and calm. But one fateful night, everything changes.

games.title: The Darkest Tales
games.category: Platform, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure
games.description: The Darkest Tales is a complex and compelling adventure, full of familiar characters and fairytale landscapes. Over the course of the journey, you'll have to come face-to-face with the difficult questions of life more than once.

games.title: The Darkside Detective
games.description: Join The Darkside Detective, Francis McQueen, as he investigates the bizarre, the supernatural and those missing cat cases that keep getting dropped on his desk.

games.title: The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark
games.description: Delouse your room with sage and pack up your travel-sized ouija board, it's time to re-enter Twin Lakes - America's 34th most haunted city. Join Detective McQueen as he puzzles his way through 6 chilling cases, risking life and pixelated limb to solve the macabre mysteries that plague the poor town.

games.title: The Dead Tree of Ranchiuna
games.description: The Dead Tree of Ranchiuna makes us question how unfair society can be both in a direct and realistic manner and with the power of fantasy elements.

games.title: The Deadly Tower of Monsters
games.description: The Deadly Tower of Monsters is an action-packed adventure, full of time-honored literary themes: the daughter versus the tyrant father, the planet full of innocent ape-creatures, the dashing space-age liberator, the robot companion, the tower full of treacherous mutations... A timeless classic for all ages!

games.title: The Deer God
games.description: The Deer God is a breathtaking 3D pixel art adventure that will challenge your religion and your platforming skills. It's a game about survival, reincarnation, and karma; all set in a breathtaking and unique 3D pixelized world. Feast your eyes on the beautiful lighting, day and night system, and vast landscapes.

games.title: The Demon Rush: Legends Corrupt
games.description: The Demon Rush: Legends Corrupt is an action RPG with multiple modes (Story Mode, Endless Dungeon, Onslaught, Conquest, Heist). Fight your enemies up close or place effects like tornados, fire, water, death forests, black holes and more onto the battlefield.

games.title: The Diabolical Trilogy
games.description:
"The Diabolical Trilogy" is a collection of 3 challenging old-school games including;

- Xenon Valkyrie+: A roguelite platformer with RPG elements for hardcore gamers.
- Riddled Corpses EX: Frenetic arcade style twin-stick shooter. Fight your way through hordes of enemies alone or with a friend!
- Demon's Tier+: Dungeon-RPG roguelike with arcade and adventure elements. Enter the dungeons of King Thosgar and destroy his demonic minions!

games.title: The Dino R
games.description: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Eat melons with the main hero of the game The Dino R and eat all the meat in the world!

games.title: The DioField Chronicle
games.description: The DioField Chronicle is a tale of war and honor. Featuring a unique and beautiful world that blends fantasy, medieval and modern-day influences with a deep yet innovative real-time battle system.

games.title: The Disappearing of Gensokyo
games.category: Shooter, Role-playing (RPG), Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure, Indie
games.description: "The Disappearing of Gensokyo" is a Touhou Project doujin game from MyACG Studio, a Chinese doujin game fan circle. We have re-imagined Touhou as an ARPG, creating this "Danmaku-Shooting-ARPG". We hope this game will be a good experience for those who are both new and knowledgeable of Touhou!

games.title: The Disney Afternoon Collection
games.description: The Disney Afternoon Collection brings together six retro games from Capcom into one colourful new package. The games feature a number of beloved characters from memorable 80s and 90s Disney TV shows.

games.title: The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park
games.description: A narrative-driven DLC expansion where you explore a decayed Central Park and Upper West Side gripped by paranoia over a mysterious virus variant. Guided by a narrator recounting events as a flashback, you uncover what happened in the park while battling a new apex threat and familiar foes. You're joined by three companions with distinct fighting styles and backgrounds, each offering unique tactical support and reactions to situations. The endgame shifts you from hunted survivor to hunter, letting you dictate engagements and pursue enemies on your own terms, with your performance affecting future challenges and exclusive rewards. New skill variants and an exotic weapon round out the expansion.

games.title: The Division 2: Mutiny
games.description: Agents, The Division 2: Mutiny brings a shift in the conflict. True Sons defectors are breaking ranks, and we can recruit them as field ready Companions. With the Command Link system at the center of this season, your coordination with these recruits becomes a powerful tool in every fight. New threats, new equipment and a demanding Master Climax Mission will test how well you can adapt and work together.

games.title: The Division 2: Rise Up
games.description: “Rise Up” adds a new endgame mission replay mode with escalating difficulty (Escalation), introduces Prototype Gear and its Augment system, and expands Retaliation content with new Black Tusk activities, materials, objectives, and quality-of-life changes. It also brings a new modular Global Modifier system (“Recombinant”) with active and passive modifiers that affect combat.

games.title: The Division 2: Warlords of New York - Year 5 Season 1: Broken Wings
games.description: In the wake of the attack at the White House, The Division has discovered that 11 people are unaccounted for and considered missing. You will be tasked to go on a high-stakes rescue mission to find the missing civilians, as they have valuable intel on the White House and The Castle Settlement.

games.title: The Dog K
games.description: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Eat cookies with the main hero of the game The Dog K. Eat all the cookies in the world!

games.title: The Door
games.description: Immerse yourself in the experience with the VR headset and feel as if you're actually in the secret room. Solve the puzzles by operating, using and combining surrounding objects. Everything can be a clue to your escape. Figure out the scenario through dialogues with the characters and hidden clues. Gather the diary and secret notes hidden throughout the lab to find out the truth. Beware of the monsters roaming the enclosed laboratory.

games.title: The Dragoness: Command of the Flame
games.description: The Dragoness mixes HOMM-like exploration, city-building and turn-based strategic combat, with a roguelite twist. Choose your battles, paths and skills as you explore a world ravaged by war. Gather and manage your army of beasts, collect resources and expand your city.

games.title: The Dreamlands: Aisling's Quest
games.description: Help Aisling free The Dreamlands from The Mourner! The Dreamlands: Aisling's Quest is an adventure game that blends fantasy and mystery elements to present a gripping story.

games.title: The Drone Racing League Simulator
games.description: This is what it feels like to fly in the cockpit of the fastest drones! The DRL Simulator will push the limits of your drone racing abilities and prepare you to fly in real life. Explore legendary locations and new worlds. Battle it out with your friends to the finish line. Crash nonstop without wrecking your drone and breaking the bank. Master this game and you can compete for a chance to become a professional pilot in the Drone Racing League!

games.title: The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Tactical, Adventure, Indie
games.description: Step into the wacky heroic fantasy universe of the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk. Lead a team of unlikely and clumsy heroes in an epic and challenging tactical RPG. Live an adventure filled with humor, surprises and silly encounters.

games.title: The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos - Back to the Futon
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Adventure, Indie
games.description: Once again, your favourite party of unlikely heroes are in a bit of a pickle: arrested by the Dungeon's Fund, they have to accomplish a dangerous mission to earn back their freedom.

games.title: The Dungeon Of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet Of Chaos - Chicken Edition
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Card & Board Game
games.description:
Are you ready to dive into a tactical RPG chock-full of charm, humor and crazy characters?! They are clumsy, inexperienced and feisty but they'll have to endure each other's company to get the dungeon's treasure. However, a feeling of déjà-vu quickly arises...
Guide this team of unlikely heroes in an adventure full of humor and chaos!

games.title: The Dwarves
games.description: The Dwarves is a fantasy role-playing game with a strong story and tactically challenging real-time battles. 15 playable heroes, each with individual skills, are to be deployed cleverly. Take on superior numbers of orcs, ogres, älfs, bögnilim, zombies, dark mages and many more foes, to give them the low-down.

games.title: The Echo
games.description: The Echo is a retro-themed First-Person Horror/Mystery...

games.title: The Eerie Surroundings
games.description: Observe your surrounding and be confident there is or is not a anomaly to progress.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online
games.description: Every legend starts somewhere and in The Elder Scrolls Online, it starts with you. Write your story into a vibrant chapter of Tamriel’s distant past that takes place nearly 1,000 years before the iconic TES V: Skyrim, and discover a world steeped in adventure and possibility.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Gold Road
games.description:
Pre-purchase now to get immediate access to a new mount and additional rewards at launch.

The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Gold Road is ideal for adventurers who wish to access all major Chapter zones and quests found across Tamriel. The Collection: Gold Road includes the Gold Road Chapter (available at launch) in addition to the base game AND all previous Chapters (available immediately).

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Ascending Tide
games.description: The Legacy of the Bretons year-long story starts here! Strange things are happening in the Coral Aerie and Shipwright's Regret as old rivalries, ancient history, and the birthright of the Bretons come into focus and lead to the upcoming High Isle Chapter.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood
games.description: A deal made with the Prince of Destruction comes due in The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood, part of the Gates of Oblivion adventure. Explore Imperial cities and murky bogs, uncover Mehrunes Dagon's sinister plot, and never adventure alone with the new Companions System.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood Collection
games.description: The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Blackwood is the ultimate Elder Scrolls experience and includes the base game, new Blackwood Chapter, and all previous Chapters.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Dark Brotherhood
games.description: Though at the height of their power, the Dark Brotherhood faces a grave threat in the form of a mysterious black-armored warrior capable of bringing down their best agents. Venture forth for another exciting adventure in the Elder Scrolls Online as you carve a bloody swath across Tamriel in the name of the Dark Brotherhood!

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Deadlands
games.description: Experience the cataclysmic conclusion to the Gates of Oblivion year-long adventure in The Elder Scrolls Online: Deadlands. Explore new worlds, discover strange new allies, and bring destruction to Oblivion itself in this new zone and story DLC.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Dragonhold
games.description: The rage of Dragons has brought its fire and fury to the ruined region of Southern Elsweyr, and the people of this once-great kingdom fight to survive. The monstrous Dragon Kaalgrontiid, bolstered with all-new allies, returns more powerful than ever. In Dragonhold, you must stand with Sai Sahan, restore the Dragonguard, and together, finally put an end the Season of the Dragon year-long adventure!

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr
games.description: Dragons return to Tamriel in The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr, part of the Season of the Dragon year-long adventure! Explore sun-blessed savannahs and canyons, defend the Khajiiti homeland, and command the merciless undead with the Necromancer class in this all-new Chapter of The Elder Scrolls Online saga!

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Fallen Banners
games.description:
Gather your party for two challenging new PvE dungeon experiences: Lep Seclusa and Exiled Redoubt. Unlock new achievements and earn new rewards including item sets, collectibles, and more as you fight to preserve what little peace remains in the war-torn region of Cyrodiil.

Lep Seclusa

The Moth Priests of Lep Seclusa are besieged, and the cunning Orpheon the Tactician is set on seizing the power of the Elder Scroll they safeguard. You must help Sister Chana defend the sanctuary against an army of deserters, protect its people and secrets, and confront Orpheon before he can use the power of the scroll to forever change the face of Cyrodiil.

Exiled Redoubt

Soldiers of the Alliance War, regardless of their faction, are vanishing, and all trails lead to the Imperial fortress known as the Exiled Redoubt. Team up with the Battlemage Lucilla, infiltrate this mysterious stronghold, and put a stop to the schemes of a once noble Imperial house before its chaos can spread beyond its stone walls and throughout Tamriel.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Feast of Shadows
games.description: The second dungeon pack of 2025, Feast of Shadows, is coming to live servers soon. It brings with it two new dungeons, Naj-Caldeesh and Black Gem Foundry. For now, the forgotten ruin of Naj-Caldeesh remains a mystery—perhaps to be unveiled soon. Instead, journey into the depths of Molag Bal’s Oblivion realm of Coldharbour to witness the perils of the Black Gem Foundry dungeon. Learn how events have unfolded there, what deadly threats it holds, and the precious rewards to claim from it.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong
games.description: Set sail for Galen as the Legacy of the Bretons year-long story comes to a close! A druid civil war erupts and followers of the True Way vie for the legacy of the Druid King. Unite with new allies to make the Systres safe once and for all.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Flames of Ambition
games.description: The Gates of Oblivion year-long adventure starts here! Delve into two new dungeons, uncover ancient knowledge, confront a dangerous new cult, and begin a journey that takes you to The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road
games.description: A forgotten Daedric Prince has returned, bringing chaos to West Weald! Explore a new zone and defend the city of Skingrad, now beset by a dangerous Daedric cult and the jungles of Valenwood. Customize your skills like never before with the new Scribing system.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor
games.description: Join over 13 million players in the award-winning online multiplayer RPG. Explore the frozen tundra and snowy mountains of Western Skyrim and stop a powerful Vampire Lord from enslaving Tamriel in The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor, part of the year-long gothic adventure The Dark Heart of Skyrim.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Harrowstorm
games.description: Set upon a journey that will take you into Skyrim's darkest reaches with Harrowstorm, a new dungeon DLC game pack. Investigate a supernatural storm in Icereach and delve into the accursed depths of Unhallowed Grave as you discover the dark forces that threaten Skryim in this first installment of a year-long saga.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle
games.description: Welcome to High Isle, a part of Tamriel never-before-seen in the Elder Scrolls. Explore the Bretons' idyllic ocean enclave and seat of chivalric culture as you confront the ruinous forces of the Ascendant Lord.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Horns of the Reach
games.description:
A DLC pack for Elder Scrolls Online that is free for those with an active ESO Plus subscription or available for purchase costing 1500 Crowns, about $16(US) worth of the games premium currency.

It contains 2 new dungeons as well as new gear, unique item sets, boss collectibles, titles, and achievements.

"The Horns of the Reach DLC game pack arrives with Bloodroot Forge and Falkreath Hold, two brand new, challenging dungeons for four-player groups that pit you and your party against the menacing hordes of the Dreadhorn Clan."

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Imperial City
games.description: The Elder Scrolls Online: Imperial City is the first official DLC Game Pack for The Elder Scrolls Online. It contains several new zones including the Imperial City, many hours of quest and story content, new PvE dungeons, a huge PvP public dungeon, the Tel Var Stone system, an expanded crafting system, twenty-three new item sets, new Undaunted pledges, many combat and gameplay improvements and much more.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Lost Depths
games.description: Out at sea or in the heart of a druid grove, the Legacy of the Bretons year-long story sails on! An ancient enemy rises to threaten the peace of Earthen Root Enclave, and dark storms erupt from Graven Deep. The earth trembles before the next DLC!

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Markarth
games.description: The Dark Heart of Skyrim epic concludes in Markarth. As the Gray Host marches on the Reach, find unlikely allies among the clans that call this wild region home and unveil the true motivations of the mysterious Vampire Lord, Rada al-Saran.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Morrowind
games.description: The Elder Scrolls Online: Morrowind is the next Chapter of The Elder Scrolls Online. This new adventure will return Elder Scrolls fans to the legendary island of Vvardenfell, the same iconic open world RPG, The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Murkmire
games.description: Immerse yourself in the unknown cultures of the strange tribes of the deep swamp and explore the world of the Hist in a weird and wonderful new zone that includes new delves, monsters, world bosses, quests, and more.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom
games.description: Traverse the Telvanni Peninsula in Morrowind and preserve secrets ascribed to the unfathomable realms of Apocrypha. Unlock the runic power of a brand-new class - the Arcanist - and fight to uphold reality itself.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Orsinium
games.description: Orsinium, ESOTU's largest DLC game pack to date, features a colossal new zone with over 20 hours of story content, a new single-player monster arena, new public dungeons, and much more! The latest DLC game pack for the award-winning The Elder Scrolls Online: Tamriel Unlimited takes you to the mountains of Wrothgar, and to the Orc capital itself, to unravel plots and counter-plots, and clash with all-new enemies and allies.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Premium Edition
games.description:
This version Includes :

- The main game plus the new chapters: MORROWIND & SUMMERSET
- Additional 3 months ESO PLUS membership with access to all DLC expansions.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Scalebreaker
games.description: The Halls of Colossus is not the only place that held Dragons. Continue your Season of the Dragon adventure with Scalebreaker, a new DLC dungeon pack that expands upon the events of the Elsweyr Chapter with new stories and challenges. Enter two deadly new dungeons in Lair of Maarselok and Moongrave Fane that sees you race to stop a vampiric ritual and a Dragon's corrupting blight. The fight for Tamriel has only just begun!

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Scions of Ithelia
games.description:
Prove your strength to Malacath and defend a demiplane of Oblivion in the Scions of Ithelia dungeon DLC.

Two Challenging Dungeons

Venture into two 4-player PvE dungeons, Oathsworn Pit and Bedlam Veil, coming soon to both the Crown Store and ESO Plus memberships.

Oathsworn Pit

A training ground for Malacath's chosen now lies soaked with the blood of the faithful, and the God of Curses demands you enact revenge on behalf of the fallen.

Bedlam Veil

Cultists have invaded the Bedlam Veil, located within the demiplane of Maelstrom. It’s up to you to defend this ancient vault and the mysterious relic it protects.

Rewards for the Worthy

Survive both dungeons to unlock unique rewards, including new item sets, collectibles, achievements, and more not found anywhere else in Tamriel.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate
games.description: The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate is a DLC for The Elder Scrolls Online. It is the 29th DLC released for the game and continues the year-long Shadow Over Morrowind adventure along with Update 37. Its release date is March 13th, 2023 for PC and Mac, and March 28th, 2023 for Xbox and PlayStation.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Season One - Return of the Thieves Guild
The Elder Scrolls Online: Shadows of the Hist
games.description: The Elder Scrolls Online: Shadows of the Hist is the fifth DLC for The Elder Scrolls Online. It contains the two Argonian-themed dungeons of the Cradle of Shadows and Ruins of Mazzatun.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Stonethorn
games.description: Confront a rising threat and uncover a monstrous secret with Castle Thorn and Stone Garden, two challenging dungeons that continue the year-long saga.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset
games.description:
For the first time in history, the long-closed borders of Summerset are open to foreigners by decree of Queen Ayrenn. But darkness looms over the ancestral home of the High Elves, and whispers stir of Daedric followers organizing in the shadows. Rally your allies, brave champions. Summerset awaits.

Explore an all-new zone packed with adventure. Join the mysterious Psijic Order and gain powerful new abilities. Reunite with old friends, forge new alliances, and work together to unravel a conspiracy that threatens Tamriel's very existence.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Thieves Guild
games.description: Join the Thieves Guild in Hew's Bane, a never-before-seen area of Hammerfell! Explore Abah's Landing, a decadent port town ruled by corrupt merchant lords, who struggle with the Thieves Guild for power. New stories, delves, group bosses, and much more!

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Waking Flame
games.description: Continue the battle against Mehrunes Dagon and delve into two exciting new dungeons in the next installment of the Gates of Oblivion year-long adventure,The Elder Scrolls Online: Waking Flame.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Wolfhunter
games.description: Face the beasts of Hircine in Wolfhunter, The Elder Scrolls Online's latest DLC game pack, as you venture into two all-new, four-player dungeons. Contend with fang and claw as you fight to liberate the stronghold of Moon Hunter Keep or join the Great Hunt in March of Sacrifices. Powerful new gear and collectibles await those brave enough to enter the Daedric Prince's realm, but be warned: Hircine is always watching.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Wrathstone
games.description: The Season of the Dragon begins here! This epic, year-long adventure takes you into the heart of Elsweyr and beyond, and it all starts with two exciting new dungeons to challenge you and your group: Frostvault and the Depths of Malatar! Explore hazardous ruins, face deadly guardians, and claim both halves of the powerful and mysterious Wrathstone!

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim - Anniversary Edition
games.description: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim - Anniversary Edition contains the full game plus all three expansions and over 500 pieces of unique content from Creation Club, including pre-existing and new quests, dungeons, bosses, weapons, spells and more!

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim - Special Edition
games.description:
Skyrim special edition is a remaster of the classic from 2011. Now with upgraded visuals.
Skyrim reimagines and revolutionises the open-world fantasy epic, bringing to life a complete virtual world open for you to explore any way you choose.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Anniversary Edition + Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition Bundle
games.description: Experience Bethesda Game Studios’ post-nuclear and epic fantasy masterpieces.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls: Legends
games.category: Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Card & Board Game
games.description: The Elder Scrolls: Legends is a strategy card game that explores the series' characters, creatures, deities, and lore. Whether you have 10 minutes or five hours, Legends provides a variety of gameplay modes and challenges that are easy-to-learn but difficult to master. Built with all levels of players in mind, Legends offers accessible gameplay for beginners who want to get started quickly, and the game's depth keeps expert players engaged. With a wide variety of deck types and strategies, no two games are ever the same.

games.title: The Elephant E
games.description: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Eat grass with the main hero of the game The Elephant E and eat all the grass in the world!

games.title: The Elf on the Shelf: Christmas Heroes
games.description: Santa needs you! Become a Scout Elf, gathering Christmas Spirit and dodging obstacles. Pledge to make things merry and be a Christmas Hero!

games.title: The End Is Nigh
games.description:
The End Is Nigh is a sprawling adventure platformer where the player takes control of Ash, one of few 'things' that have 'survived' the "end of the world."
Follow Ash as he flops his way through a future of pain and suffering. Feel his stress levels rise as you throw him into an endless swarm of decaying, mutant creatures and help aid his final epic quest... to simply make a friend.

games.title: The Enigma Machine
games.description: ENIGMA TECHNOLOGIES invites you to delve into the mind of an AI. Seamlessly blending first-person exploration with point-and-click mechanics, THE ENIGMA MACHINE's completely unique presentation offers an increasingly unnerving atmosphere.

games.title: The Entropy Centre
games.description: Think in reverse. Outsmart the impossible. A mind-bending first-person adventure where you solve ingenious and complex puzzles by rewinding objects through time.

games.title: The Escapists
games.category: Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Tactical, Adventure, Indie
games.description: All that stands between you and your freedom is a perfectly executed escape plan. The Escapists provides players the opportunity of experiencing a light-hearted insight into everyday prison life with the main objective being that of breaking out.

games.title: The Escapists 2
games.category: Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Tactical, Adventure, Indie
games.description: The Escapists 2 is the forthcoming sequel to the sandbox prison-escape game which will include, in a first for the series, drop in/drop out play for up to four players in both local and online play.

games.title: The Escapists 2: Game of the Year Edition
games.description:
The Escapists 2 is the forthcoming sequel to the sandbox prison-escape game which will include, in a first for the series, drop in/drop out play for up to four players in both local and online play.

The Game of the Year Edition will include all 11 prisons from the base game and all Escapists 2 DLC and impenetrable penitentiaries such as Wicked Ward and the Glorious Regime!

games.title: The Escapists: The Walking Dead
games.category: Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Indie, Arcade
games.description: Manage your escape from an onslaught of walkers in this cross-over between the time management escape game The Escapists and the blockbuster zombie franchise The Walking Dead. Using the retro graphical style of The Escapists, the game gives you control of Rick Grimes as he tries to secure the safety of a number of familiar characters by seeking out a safe escape route from each area, fending off the zombie hordes and keeping as many of them alive as possible as they escape.
