Team up with Dedsec, a notorious group of hackers, to execute the biggest hack in history; take down ctOS 2.0, an invasive operating system being used by criminal masterminds to monitor and manipulate citizens on a massive scale.

The Watch Dogs 2 Deluxe Edition includes:
- Watch Dogs 2 (Game)
- Lithographies
- Map of San Francisco
- Digital soundtrack
- 2 personalisation packs

games.title: Watch Dogs 2: Gold Edition
games.description:
Use hacking as a weapon in the massive & dynamic open world of Watch Dogs 2.

In 2016, ctOS 2.0, an advanced operating system networking city infrastructure, was implemented in several US cities to create a safer, more efficient metropolis.

Play as Marcus Holloway, a brilliant young hacker living in the birthplace of the tech revolution, the San Francisco Bay Area. Team up with Dedsec, a notorious group of hackers, and expose the hidden dangers of ctOS 2.0, which, in the hands of corrupt corporations, is being wrongfully used to monitor and manipulate citizens on a massive scale.

With the power of hacking and Dedsec by your side, launch the Hack of the Century, take down ctOS 2.0 and give freedom back to whom it belongs: the people.

games.title: Watch Dogs 2: Human Conditions
games.description: Dive into the dark world of science, medicine, and misuse as biotech takes center stage in 3 new World Stories. Hack your way through several hours of additional mission content, and uncover San Francisco's biggest scientific scandals.

games.title: Watch Dogs 2: Mega Pack
games.description:
You've got it, so flaunt it with this massive customization bundle. Contains custom clothing and skins for vehicles, weapons, and RC devices.
Includes the following packs:
- RETRO-MODERNIST
- GLOW_PRO
- RIDE BRITANNIA
- KICK IT
- VELVET COWBOY
- BAY AREA THRASH

games.title: Watch Dogs 2: No Compromise
games.description: Brings a new Main Operation to life as a DedSec op goes wrong and the Russian mafia gets involved. And if you're looking for even more challenges, the new Online Coop Mode squares you off against 'enemy' players, who will do everything they can to prevent you from completing your goals.

games.title: Watch Dogs 2: Private Eye Pack
games.description:
"Everyone has secrets, no one can hide."

From the mean streets to the dark corners of the web, there is no truth you cannot find. No secret is safe, with this set of FREE Private Eye gear.

Contains:
- Complete set of clothing items.
- Custom paint job for vehicles.

games.title: Watch Dogs 2: Psychedelic Pack
games.description: Embrace the San Francisco psychedelic vibe! With this full set of customization, give Marcus the funkiest look: outfit, weapon, drone and car, let all them colour and brighten your day.

games.title: Watch Dogs 2: San Francisco Edition
games.description:
Watch Dogs 2 San Francisco Edition Includes:
The Game
Lithographies
24cm Marcus Figure
Map of San Francisco
SF-Themed Laptop Stickers
Exclusive Collector's Box
Use hacking as a weapon in the massive & dynamic open world of Watch Dogs 2.

games.title: Watch Dogs 2: T-Bone Content Bundle
games.description:
Get the style and the swagger of legendary hacker T-Bone Grady in the first Watch_Dogs 2 DLC bundle! Outfit Marcus with T-Bone's signature look, and plow a path of epic destruction through San Francisco in T-Bone's customized truck - specially equipped to lift and annihilate vehicles, enemies, and anything else in your way.

Bundle Includes;
- T-Bone Truck available in the car-on-demand app
- One complete T-Bone inspired outfit
- New elite enemy class, armed with laser-guided grenade launchers
- New co-op difficulty mode

games.title: Watch Dogs 2: Zodiac Killer
games.description:
Zodiac Killer is a DLC-exclusive mission in Watch Dogs 2, available by pre-ordering the game or with the Season Pass. It is unlocked after completing the story mission Looking Glass and reaching 1,185,000 followers.

It features the return of the infamous Zodiac Killer, who haunted San Francisco for years. Players also receive an exclusive outfit and bonuses after completing the mission.

games.title: Watch Dogs: Bad Blood
games.description:
Revisit Chicago in a brand new Watch_Dogs adventure!
Play as T-Bone Grady, the legendary and eccentric hacker and Aiden Pearce's trusted comrade. Now on the run from Blume, T-Bone only has two choices: flee and start a new life elsewhere, or fight Blume to save an old friend. Face your shady past on your road to redemption.

games.title: Watch Dogs: Complete Edition
games.description:
Experience Watch_Dogs - the phenomenon of 2014 - with the biggest edition ever!
As Aiden Pearce, a brilliant hacker, turn Chicago into the ultimate weapon in your quest for revenge.
In this Complete Edition, including the game + Season Pass, access a new game mode, weapons, outfits and missions and plays as T-Bone, the legendary hacker in a brand new campaign!

games.title: Watch Dogs: Conspiracy
games.description: In this digital trip, Aiden has to find invader robots that are disguised as humans. Aiden can see them through his lens. After Aiden profiles robots, a weak spot marked with red appears on the robots. To kill the robots, Aiden has to shoot them on their weak spots.

games.title: Watch Dogs: DEDSEC Edition
games.description:
The Dedsec Edition includes:

- Watch_Dogs
- 23cm Aiden Pearce Figurine
- 3 exclusive badges
- 4 collectible cards
- Artbook
- DEDSEC Collector box
- Map of Chicago
- Steelbook
- Soundtrack disc

Additional digital content:

- Watch_Dogs: Breakthrough Pack (DLC)
- Watch_Dogs: Palace Pack (DLC)
- Watch_Dogs: Signature Shot Pack (DLC)
- Watch_Dogs: White Hat Pack (DLC, for this edition exclusive to PS3/PS4)

games.title: Watch Dogs: Gold Edition
games.description:
A PlayStation 4 exclusive edition that includes the Season Pass.

Season Pass Includes:
- Unique "Untouchables" skin and weapon.
- See Watch Dogs through T-Bone's eyes in an exciting campaign with new hacks, new settings, and a new story line.
- A new mind bending Digital Trip.
- More single-player side missions, weapons, and skins.

games.title: Watch Dogs: Legion
games.description: In Watch Dogs: Legion, near future London is facing its downfall... Unless you do something about it. Build a resistance, fight back, and give the city back to the people. It's time to rise up.

games.title: Watch Dogs: Legion - Bloodline
games.description: Vigilante hacker Aiden Pearce is back, and this time he's teaming up with Wrench in a new storyline set before the events of the main game.

games.title: Watch Dogs: Legion - Collector's Edition
games.description:
The Collector's Edition is the most impressive edition of Watch Dogs Legion. It is available exclusively on the Ubisoft Store.

The Collector's Edition Includes;
- Lighting Ded Coronet Mask
- Ultimate Edition (the game)
- Exclusive Steelbook
- Double-sided Propaganda Poster
- Set of 3 Stickers
- Exclusive Box

games.title: Watch Dogs: Legion - Deluxe Edition
games.description:
Enhance your Watch Dogs: Legion experience with the Deluxe Pack.

In Watch Dogs: Legion, you get to build a resistance to take back a near-future London that is facing its downfall.

games.title: Watch Dogs: Legion - Gold Edition
games.description:
In Watch Dogs: Legion, near future London is facing its downfall...unless you do something about it. Build a resistance, fight back, and give the city back to the people. It’s time to rise up.

The Gold Edition includes;
- Watch Dogs: Legion (the game)
- The season pass: one expansion with two episodes, extra missions, four iconic heroes and more!

games.title: Watch Dogs: Legion - Limited Edition
games.description:
Pre-order to get access to the Golden King Pack and set your heroes apart in the streets of London with: 
The Uneasy Lies mask, Serpent Sisters Pistol skin & Lux Car skin 
Give the recruits of your resistance a unique look thanks to the Limited Edition 
Physical content, copy of the Watch Dogs Legion game 
Digital content, The London Dissident Pack: unlock three new masks to lead your resistance with style

games.title: Watch Dogs: Legion - Resistance Edition
games.description:
Unlock new content for your journey in London with the Resistance Edition:
- Copy of the Watch Dogs: Legion game.
- The Resistant Pack: unlock Lynx, a new hacker character with an animal-inspired mask and outfit, and receive one week of VIP status to help you earn in-game currency faster.

games.title: Watch Dogs: Legion - Season Pass
games.description: The season pass includes one major expansion with two episodes, extra missions, four iconic heroes with unique abilities, and immediate access to the original Watch_Dogs Complete Edition.

games.title: Watch Dogs: Legion - Ultimate Edition
games.description:
In Watch Dogs: Legion, near future London is facing its downfall...unless you do something about it. Build a resistance, fight back, and give the city back to the people. It’s time to rise up.

Watch Dogs: Legion - Ultimate Edition includes;
- Watch Dogs: Legion (the game)
- The Urban Jungle Pack: three unique characters with their own skills and cosmetics.
- Three additional masks
- A four-week VIP Status
- The Season Pass: one major expansion with two episodes, extra missions, four iconic heroes with unique abilities, a Dedsec car skin and access to the Original Watch Dogs Complete edition!

games.title: Watch Dogs: Season Pass
games.description: The Season Pass contains a new Single Player Campaign featuring the legendary hacker T-Bone as a new playable character, 3 additional missions for the main game, 3 new weapons and 5 additional skins. It also includes a new mind bending game mode in which cyborgs are invading Chicago.

games.title: Watch Dogs: Vigilante Edition
games.description:
The Watch_Dogs Vigilante Edition is dedicated to hard core fans who'd like to embody the hacker vigilante in real life!

The Vigilante Edition includes;
- Aiden’s Baseball Cap and Mask
- Soundtrack
- Single player mission: Palace pack

games.title: Watch Over Christmas
games.description: The story of Cisco, a 12-years old boy who embarks on an amazing journey to save Christmas as we know it.

games.title: Watcher Chronicles
games.description: Become a glutton for punishment and persevere against 20+ merciless bosses and legions of skeletal nightmares in this savage yet charming 2D souls-like.

games.title: Water Balloon Mania
games.description: "Water Balloon Mania" is an addictive puzzle game. The goal is to remove all fires from the screen. To do that you have to rotate and position the water balloons on top of or alongside the fires and other water balloons so that there are at least 4 blocks with the same color next to each other. You can move and turn the water balloons with the joypad.

games.title: Water Blast Shooter: Wet Gun
games.description: Get ready for non-stop action in epic water battles!

games.title: Water Delivery
games.description: Water Delivery is a first person, horror experience where you play as a water delivery boy. Ride along in the delivery truck from house to house. Deliver filled water jugs, find and return empty jugs, and collect all the payments. Will you be able to finish your final route of the evening?

games.title: Water Sort Challenge
games.description: Dive into a relaxing yet brain-teasing puzzle game where your goal is to sort colorful liquids into the correct bottles until each one holds only a single color. With 1,000 carefully designed levels, the challenge gradually increases—from simple and satisfying early stages to truly demanding logic puzzles that will put your brain to the test. Whether you're looking to unwind or train your mind, this game offers the perfect blend of fun, focus, and colorful satisfaction.

games.title: Watermelon Game: Fruits Puzzle
games.description:
Experience the thrill of stacking and merging fruits in this deceptively simple yet captivating gameplay. Drop various fruits into the box and watch as the physics come alive, making them roll, shift, and merge upon contact.
Create mesmerizing chain reactions by merging identical fruits, building up to the ultimate Watermelon – not only a points bonanza but also a container-consuming giant.

games.title: Waterpark Manager Simulator
games.description: Build your summer water park adventure!

games.title: Waterpark Simulator 25
games.description: Transform your park into the ultimate spot for summer fun.

games.title: Wattam
games.description: From the creator behind Noby Noby Boy and Katamari Damacy comes Wattam - Long ago, a huge explosion blasted the world of Wattam across the galaxy. Help the Mayor build stacks and chains with characters like Sushi, Flower, Cloud & Poop to create joyful, colorful explosions that will guide the diaspora of Wattam back home.

games.title: Waves Out!
games.description: "Waves Out!" is the rampant magnetic game that will make you want to ask for more! You will take control of Magnetin, the little but courageous metallic friend with magnetic powers. With its help, you will be able to attract the spheres tinted with your color to the goal holes so you can add points to the scoreboard. Challenge a second player or try your skills in the Time Trial! Use wisely your magnetic powers to achieve victory, and don't forget the special powers that will appear all over the arena!

games.title: Wavetale
games.description: Wavetale is a story driven, third-person action-adventure platformer, set in an island world built atop the remains of a once magnificent city. Player takes on the role of Sigrid, a headstrong girl who gains the ability to run on water through the help of a mysterious shadow. Wavetale offers a tight-knit story combined with a charming art style and delightful soundtrack and invites players to explore its world through its fast-flowing gameplay, where traditional platforming elements meet a unique surfing experience on a dynamic ocean. The intuitive controls make Wavetale accessible and family friendly, while at the same time encouraging mastery as the player will need to understand the full range of movement. Guide Sigrid through the archipelago as the calamity that once sunk the city once again looms on the horizon.

games.title: Way Down
games.description: Live this action-packed spy adventure based on the movie The Vault.

games.title: Way of Redemption
games.category: Real Time Strategy (RTS), Sport, Strategy, Indie
games.description: Way of Redemption is a MOSA (Multiplayer Online Sport Arena) game from Pixel Cream

games.title: Way of the Hunter: Elite Edition
games.description:
The Elite Edition includes the base game as well as the following extras items:
- Way of the Hunter: Season Pass.
The Way of the Hunter Season Pass includes two new region DLCs. + The Way of the Hunter Hunter's Pack

games.title: Way of the Passive Fist
games.category: Fighting, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Indie, Arcade
games.description: Way of the Passive Fist is a unique and colorful arcade brawler. Parry, Dodge and Dash to outwit and outlast your enemies on a desolate planet ruled by raiders, mutants and fanatical sun worshipers. It's a new kind of tactical fighting in the licensed arcade brawler for the 90s cartoon you wish existed.

games.title: Wayfinder
games.description: Become a Wayfinder, and unlock their powers as you choose your path and playstyle while pushing back a hostile force that has overtaken your world. Control the Chaos as you directly shape and customize the endless adventures you go on with friends, because Wayfinders are stronger together.

games.title: Wayward Strand
games.description: Wayward Strand is a heartfelt interactive story, told in a unique and curious way. Play as Casey Beaumaris - intrepid teenage journalist - as she visits an airborne hospital for the first time. Uncover the airship's mysteries, and explore the lives of its inhabitants.

games.title: WBSC eBaseball: Power Pros
games.description: Experience the virtual world of baseball available in WBSC eBASEBALL: POWER PROS. The most played baseball game series in Japan is now featured in the World Baseball Softball Confederation’s eSport discipline. Whether you like swinging for the fences or pitching in the strike zone, you know baseball is all about batting, pitching, and fielding. The virtual world of baseball is no different. With easy pick-up-and-play mechanics, WBSC eBASEBALL: POWER PROS is fun for both novices and skilled gamers

games.title: We Are Doomed
games.description:
"WE ARE DOOMED is a twin-stick shooter where you zap polygon baddies with an absurdly overpowered laserbeam.

Dive head-first into the action with reckless ambition, charge the SUPERBEAM, and zap everything out of existence in an instant. Chase high scores or just enjoy the beautiful explosion of geometry, colour and light."

games.title: We are Eva
games.description: Play the game in multiple dimensions at the same time, traveling between them whenever you like! Doesn't it sound fun? My name is Eva, by the way, I'm the main protagonist of the game you're looking at, and I promise we'll have fun. If you add me to your wishlist, of course. *wink wink*

games.title: We Are OFK
games.category: Point-and-click, Music, Simulator, Adventure, Indie, Visual Novel
games.description: Start a band in this dreamy, musical TV show from indie pop cuties OFK. Cry, skate, date, and run for your life in 5 interactive music videos, across a heartfelt story of what you risk to chase your dreams.

games.title: We Are the Dwarves
games.description: 'We Are the Dwarves!' Is a story-driven real-time tactical action game about the three dwarven astronauts in the Stone Universe looking for the warm and bright Stars. An accident with the drill-like Starship brought them to an unknown part of the Universe, pushing into dangerous circumstances, but that's where the adventure begins! The dwarves will meet ancient races and giant monsters on their mission and it's up to you, who commands the trio, how to deal with them. Depending on what you want from the game - stealth or slasher - you can choose how to play with your dwarf team.

games.title: We Happy Few
games.description: We Happy Few is the tale of a plucky bunch of moderately terrible people trying to escape from a lifetime of cheerful denial. Set in a drug-fuelled, retrofuturistic city in an alternative 1960s England, you'll have to blend in with its other inhabitants, who don't take kindly to people who don't abide by their not-so-normal rules.

games.title: We Happy Few: Deluxe Edition
games.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes We Happy Few and the We Happy Few Season Pass.

We Happy Few is the tale of a plucky bunch of moderately terrible people trying to escape from a lifetime of cheerful denial in the city of Wellington Wells. In this alternative 1960s England, conformity is key. You’ll have to fight or blend in with the drug-addled inhabitants, most of whom don’t take kindly to people who won’t abide by their not-so-normal rules.

Discover the retrofuturistic city’s dark history as you play through the intertwined narratives of three quietly rebellious citizens of Wellington Wells. Each has their own strengths and weaknesses as they face their pasts, prepare for the future, and engage in activities that aren’t exactly status quo in the artificially enthused society.

games.title: We Happy Few: Lightbearer
games.description: This add-on presents an independent story set in the district town of Wellington Wells. His plot revolves around a rockman and the infamous heartbreaker Nick Lightbearer. Is the artist really the one for whom he publicly claims to be?

games.title: We Happy Few: They Came From Below
games.description: Wellington Wells stands besieged by a robot uprising, but the mechanized menace isn't the only thing threatening to tear the pair apart. Play as Roger and team up with your boyfriend James to Find Dr. Faraday, explore a vast underground laboratory, and discover the source of the robot invaders before it's too late!

games.title: We Happy Few: We All Fall Down
games.description: Play as Victoria Byng, get a grip on her whip, and get the last word on the story of Wellington Wells. As Victoria reckons with her own withdrawals, the city slides deeper into Joy shortage and disorder. It's always been Victoria's duty to help keep things proper, but the closer she looks, the deeper the rot seems to run.

games.title: We Love Katamari Reroll + Royal Reverie
games.description:
We Love Katamari Reroll + Royal Reverie is a remaster of the PS2 game We Love Katamari.

The second title in the Katamari Damacy series has returned in a remastered, powered-up version! This new reroll comes with improved graphics and gameplay enhancements. In Royal Reverie, roll up katamari as the King of All Cosmos in his boyhood!

games.title: We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie: Special Edition
games.description:
The second title in the Katamari Damacy series has returned in a remastered, powered-up version!

We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie is a fully remastered version of We Love Katamari Damacy, originally released in 2005, with new and improved graphics and gameplay enhancements to make it easier to jump in and have fun.

The Special Edition contains We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie, the Little Prince Costume, and the Katamari Damacy Series Music Bundle.

games.title: We Should Talk.
games.description:
It's not what you say, it's how you say it. We should talk is a short-form narrative game that will make players think carefully about the words they choose.

Using a unique narrative choice mechanic, players craft sentences in response to the in-game characters in We should talk. Through this careful choice of words, players express themselves as they discuss ongoing problems about life and romance with their in-game partner over text messages, while also chatting with friends and strangers at their favorite local bar about what's on their mind.

The combination of words they choose impacts the conversations they have, how genuinely they can connect with their partner, and whether their relationship can survive the night.

games.title: We Sing
games.description: Karaoke game for the Wii developed by Le Cortex and published by Nordic Games.

games.title: We Sing
games.description: The karaoke franchise comes to PS4 and Xbox One.

games.title: We Sing Pop!
games.description:
We Sing Pop! a brand new addition to the We Sing range of games for Wii it will feature 40 of the greatest pop tracks around.

We Sing Pop! will be available in Europe and the US on Wii and will feature some of the most well-known pop hits covering four poptastic decades. The look and feel of the game will also replicate a real 'pop' vibe.

games.title: We Were Here
games.description: Lost and separated in an abandoned castle set in a frozen wasteland. Your only possession left is a walkie-talkie, with a familiar voice on the other end. Can the both of you find your way out in time?

games.title: We Were Here Expeditions: The FriendShip
games.description: Partner up with your friend online and test your friendship by solving puzzles together in an abandoned amusement park. Work together to overcome brain-teasing challenges in this standalone We Were Here experience.

games.title: We Were Here Forever
games.description: You and your fellow prisoner are trapped in the realm of Castle Rock - were you betrayed, or simply not that clever? To escape, you must explore the sinister castle for puzzles and plot your escape together. Secrets and riddles are hidden in the shadows. Just be aware that nothing is what it seems in this mysterious Antarctic adventure. Can you two escape together, or will you be trapped… forever?

games.title: We Were Here Series Bundle
games.description: Get all three games in the We Were Here Series in one handy bundle! These co-op puzzle adventures are centered around the sinister Castle Rock in deepest Antarctica.

games.title: We Were Here Together
games.description: As we explore these frozen wastes, misfortune strikes once again. Through the fierce blizzard, an emergency flare lights the sky, followed by a cry for help over the radio - broken, dying... No one else will be able to come to their rescue. But can we make it back - together?

games.title: We Were Here Too
games.description:
We Were Here Too is an online only, first-person cooperative adventure set in a fictional medieval castle. The survivors find themselves in a drastically different scenario. One is trapped in what seems like a royal court, while the other finds themselves in an abandoned tomb. Once again, all they have is a walkie-talkie, with a familiar voice on the other end.

Do you have what it takes to survive the castle… together with your friend?

games.title: We. The Revolution
games.category: Point-and-click, Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Simulator, Strategy, Adventure, Indie
games.description:
We. The Revolution is a unique game with a singular art style set in the blood-soaked and paranoid world of the French Revolution, where often you could not tell a friend from an enemy. As a judge of the Revolutionary Tribunal, you will have to trudge through this setting passing sentences, playing a dangerous political game, and doing everything in your power to not to be guillotined as an enemy of revolution. At the end of a day you will also confront your decisions with your family and very often they will see it differently.

We. The Revolution will put you in morally ambiguous situations in which there are no obvious solutions, and the decisions you make are never unambiguous...

games.title: WeakWood Throne
games.description:
WeakWood Throne is a 2D Action RPG with the open world.
In the story you will find out what happened in the WickWood Kingdom; why its inhabitants get poorer every day, and soldiers-beasts wander on their fields; what's wrong with the new king, and how to dethrone him.

games.title: Weapon of Choice DX
games.description: Weapon of Choice DX is a high-energy, run 'n' gun where each playable character is unique with their own special weapon and abilities! Blast insane aliens, find new player characters, and choose between branching paths! The world is being taken over by gene-combining beings from beyond the stars! Hideous new creatures are popping up everywhere, and it's up to the Solus Operatives to grab their unique weapons and split some disgusting alien skulls!

games.title: Weapons of Mythology: New Age
games.description: Enticing battles wait for you in Weapons of Mythology: New Age. Be ready to participate in exciting PVPs fights, epic boss hunts, and guild territory wars. Five character classes are available: Vajra, Ascension, Solar, Lotus and Mist. Choose yours and immerse yourself in this big open world, full of surprises and possibilities. You will be impressed by the diversity of landscapes and skills of each character.

games.title: Webbed
games.description:
Webbed is the story of a happy little spider on an adventure to save her boyfriend from a big mean bowerbird.
Swing through the trees, spin sticky webs, and make friends with bugs! Be the adorable spider you've always wanted to be.

games.title: Weben Blocks
games.description:
Connect the same numbers and get the biggest tile you can get!

Reach the highest score and share it with your friends!

games.title: Webgeon Speedrun Edition
games.description: Webgeon Speedrun Edition is a Arcade Speedrun Game, You have to be fast, yes you have to be fast, Can you finish 20 levels in the fastest time?

games.title: Wedding Designer
games.description: Agency simulator that deals with organizing weddings in unusual locations. Some look for fashionable places, others originality. This is where imagination counts. Our agency can organize a wedding party in such extraordinary places as an old farm, a junkyard, an abandoned factory, a fishing port or a funfair.

games.title: Wednesday 13th
games.description:
Midnight strikes.
The gates slam shut.
The manor begins to breathe… and hunt.

You are Vanessa Mort — the lost soul trapped inside the haunted Institute on Wednesday the 13th, the cursed night when walls whisper, shadows stalk, and your darkest fears take shape. Every creak in the dark could be a jump scare. Every corridor could be your last.

games.title: Weed & Greed
games.description:
Dive into the bustling world of Weed & Greed, where you'll build your illicit empire from the ground up!

Find clients or hire dealers to keep your business thriving and establish a loyal customer base. But be ready for intense action: battle NPCs and cops, arm yourself, and rule the streets like a true boss.

Explore a dynamic city with day-night cycles and shady corners perfect for deals. Build your empire by cultivating plants, synthesizing pills, and upgrading your equipment.

Rent labs, warehouses, and stash houses to dominate the game!

games.title: Weed Drug Empire
games.description: Step into the shadows of a world where power is taken, not given. In this underground simulator, you're building more than a business—you're creating an empire from nothing. No cash, no allies—just ambition, strategy, and the will to rise. Every move matters. Every mistake leaves a mark.

games.title: Weed Shop Simulator
games.description: Weed Shop Simulator launches in Early Access! Build your cannabis empire from seed to sale. Grow rare strains, craft legendary products, hire your team, and outsmart rivals in a chaotic world full of wild adventures and deep cannabis culture. Your empire awaits!

games.title: Weedcraft Inc
games.description: Weedcraft Inc explores the business of producing, breeding and selling weed in America, delving deep into the financial, political and cultural aspects of the country's complex relationship with this troublesome and promising plant.

games.title: Weeping Doll
games.description:
An ordinary family. A beautiful home. But, who's crying?
Search the home, scour every room and scrutinize over every detail to piece together the story that has been kept locked away all this time.

games.title: Weeping Willow
games.description: Weeping Willow is a kinetic visual novel in the genre of detective. Events take place in the small town of Weidendorf during quarantine of the plague.

games.title: Weird West
games.description: Discover a dark fantasy reimagining of the Wild West where lawmen and gunslingers share the frontier with fantastical creatures. Journey through the origin stories of a group of atypical heroes, written into legend by the decisions you make in an unforgiving land. Each journey is unique and tailored to the actions taken - a series of high stakes stories where everything counts and the world reacts to the choices you make. Form a posse or venture forth alone into an otherworldly confines of the Weird West and make each legend your own.

games.title: Welcome Kokuri-san
games.description: Welcome Kokuri-san is a visual novel starring the VTuber Kurune Kokuri. The story is fully voiced, and will include scenes with realistic ASMR voices, so you can enjoy the scenario “as if you were there.”

games.title: Welcome to Empyreum
games.description: Welcome to Empyreum is a local co-op party game up to 4 players. The main goal is to organize and clean numerous floors of the hotel with mechanics involving everyday chores (vacuuming or making the bed), and crazy tasks like taking care of alien babies and chasing ghosts away!

games.title: Welcome to Erin's Story in the World of Our Church and Halloween: Visual Novel
games.description: A game in the "Our Church and Halloween" series!

games.title: Welcome to Hanwell
games.description: Open world horror set in a city in which your worst nightmares have become an everyday part of life. Explore a dense open world of terror, every building a unique location with it's own story to tell. Strung together by the remenants of Hanwell.

games.title: Welcome to James' Story in the World of Our Church and Halloween: Visual Novel
games.description: Welcome to James' story in the World of Our Church and Halloween!

games.title: Welcome to Jane's Story in the World of Project: Summer Ice
Welcome to Mark's Story in the World of Project: Summer Ice
Welcome to Pammy's Story in the World of Project: Summer Ice
Welcome to Scott's Story in the World of Our Church and Halloween: Visual Novel
Welcome to the World of Nik and Kit
games.description:
A game in the "Nik and Kit" series!
This game's release is part of Breakthrough Gaming's "Bible Video Game Sundays"!

games.title: Welcome to the World of Zippy the Circle: Visual Novel
games.description: Welcome to the World of Zippy the Circle: Visual Novel tells the story of Zippy and his adventures as part of Breakthrough Gaming's "Bible Video Game Sundays"!

games.title: Welcome to the World of ZJ the Ball
Wer Weiß Denn Sowas?
games.description: With the official game based on the TV show, you can put your knowledge to the test. Play alongside Elton, Bernhard Hoëcker, or up to three friends. 30 complete shows with over 390 questions from more than 100 categories await you. You'll often be left wondering "Who even knows these things?"

games.title: Wer Weiß Denn Sowas?: Das 2. Spiel
games.description: It's time for round two, promising the best entertainment for you and your friends. Play in a team with Elton or compete alongside of Bernhard Hoëcker. You'll have to give your all in "Wer weiß denn sowas?" 30 new shows await you with exciting questions and answer videos.

games.title: Wer weiß denn sowas?: Das 3. Spiel
games.description: Just in time for the 11th season, Elton, Bernhard Hoëcker and Kai Pflaume are back on the PC with a brand new edition of WER WEISS DENN SOWAS?

games.title: Werewolf Hunter: Survive the Howl
games.description: Terror awaits in the shadows. Will you survive?

games.title: Werewolf Pinball
games.description: The curse of the Werewolf it's back in this Pinball, survive the night and try to hunt him down.

games.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Earthblood
games.description: Become a werewolf, known as Garou, in the atmosphere of their shamanistic and tribal world. Garou are Werewolf warriors opposed to urban civilization and supernatural corruption, all heading towards inevitable apocalypse. Werewolf: The Apocalypse is set in the World of Darkness, a gritty version of our own time where society declines and humans fall victim to supernatural horrors.

games.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Earthblood Champion of Gaia Edition
games.description:
You are Cahal, a powerful Garou who chose to go into exile after losing control of his destructive rage. On his quest for redemption and blood, Cahal plays a crucial role in the great war between the Garous and Endron, a powerful oil company that serves the Wyrm, whose destruction is ravaging the planet.
He can transform into a wolf and a Crinos, a huge ferocious beast.
Each form has its advantages: the wolf can sneak around undetected, Cahal as a human can interact with other people, and the Werewolf can unleash its rage to tear enemies apart.

The Champion of Gaia edition includes:
- Full game
- 3 outfits for Cahal
- 4 exclusive furs for the Wolf and Werewolf
- A nature spirit to help you in combat
- A unique finishing move

games.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Earthblood Champion of Gaia Pack
games.description:
The Champion of Gaia pack includes:
- 3 outfits for Cahal
- 4 exclusive furs for the Wolf and Werewolf
- A nature spirit to help you in combat
- A unique finishing move

games.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Earthblood: The Exiled One
games.description:
This DLC includes:
- The exclusive Cahal The Exiled One outfit
- Dark fur for the Werewolf and Wolf
- An Auspice of Ahroun emblem embroidered on the outfit
Exile was the only option to protect his family. Alone and far away from his loved ones, Cahal's spirit has darkened over time. Put on Cahal's black jacket, proudly display your Ahroun warrior Auspice and transform into a dark wolf to take on those who threaten your pack.

He can transform into a wolf and a Crinos, a huge ferocious beast.
Each form has its advantages: the wolf can sneak around undetected, Cahal as a human can interact with other people, and the Werewolf can unleash its rage to tear enemies apart.

games.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Heart of the Forest
games.description:
Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Heart of the Forest throws you deep into a primeval wilderness in the center of modern Europe. It's where the protectors of nature wage their ancient, never-ending war against the forces of destruction.

Visit real-world places of mystery and power. Explore local legends and traditions. Discover the fascinating world and history of the Polish-Belarusian borderlands. You will witness how nature clashes with technology and greed. Can it survive without our help?

games.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Purgatory
games.description: A choice-driven RPG thriller set in the World of Darkness universe. Step into the shoes of Samira, a young werewolf refugee in Poland, as she battles dark forces and loneliness, caught between rage and despair. How will your story unfold?

games.title: West Escape
games.description: Outrun the law, blast aliens, and fight for love in the wildest ride through the Wild West!

games.title: West of Dead
games.description: Step into the boots of the dead man William Mason and descend into the grim and gritty world of Purgatory in this fast-paced twin-stick shooter that'll put your skills to test. Dodge behind cover as you try to outgun your enemies in the unknown procedurally generated hunting grounds. The Wild West has never been this dark.

games.title: West of Dead: Path of the Crow Edition
games.description: The Path of the Crow Deluxe Edition contains, the Crow familiar, a new level (The Battlefield), new enemy (The Captain), a new weapon (The Mortar).

games.title: Western Slot Machine
games.description: Feel lucky today! Now, you can play the best wild casino slot anywhere and anytime. Experience the real thrill of Las Vegas!Enjoy all the fun of a Western slot machine in your hand. Place your bet, spin, and win big prizes!

games.title: Westild's Law
games.description: Westild's Law offers shootouts where you must use every element of your arsenal to win. Throw dynamite or your weapon at your enemies to stun them when ammo runs low and then take their weapons. When the situation gets critical, activate "ultra-sense", slow-down time and enhance your abilities. Embark on adventures through 48 levels, each offering unique challenges.

games.title: Whacking Hell!
games.description: The gates of hell have opened: whack all the monsters before they whack you! Collect their souls, ramp up your weapons and your spells, and become a slaughtering machine in this frantic roguelite top-down 2D shooter!

games.title: What Comes After
games.description:
What Comes After is a side-scrolling adventure and a short heartwarming story about learning how to love yourself. Help Vivi in her journey on the train to the afterlife and back.

From the creator of Coffee Talk, in collaboration with Rolling Glory Jam, the creator of Rage in Peace.

games.title: What Do You Meme? The Video Game
games.description: The smash-hit card game has gone digital! What Do You Meme? The Video Game brings internet humor to the living room. Use your phone as a controller to battle your friends and build hilarious memes!

games.title: What Have You Done, Father?
games.description: An atrocious scandal threatens the Catholic Church when the lifeless body of a woman is discovered in the rectory of a young priest.

games.title: What is Older?
games.description: What is Older? is a fun, brain-teasing game where you choose which historical event, invention, or milestone happened first. From fire to smartphones, test your sense of time and chase the ultimate high score!

games.title: What Lies in the Multiverse
games.description: What Lies in the Multiverse is a story-driven 2D adventure that one could call a dramatic comedy. Filled to the brim with hilarious, cartoonish hijinks, the narrative also presents the player with mature and deep themes like death, envy, and obsession.

games.title: What Remains of Edith Finch
games.description:
What Remains of Edith Finch is a collection of short stories about a cursed family in Washington State.

Each story offers a chance to experience the life of a different family member with stories ranging from the early 1900s to the present day. The gameplay and tone of the stories are as varied as the family members themselves. The only constants are that each is played from a first-person perspective and that each story ends with that family member's death. It's a game about what it feels like to be humbled and astonished by the vast and unknowable world around us.

You'll follow Edith Finch as she explores the history of her family and tries to figure out why she's the last Finch left alive.

games.title: What the Dub?!
games.description:
What The Dub?! is a multiplayer party game where each player overdubs missing dialogue from hilariously awful B-movies, outdated PSAs, and bizarre industrial films, with their own witty (or just plain stupid) dubs!

Players watch the dubs and vote on the best one. The player with the highest score at the end of the game wins! What The Dub takes "bad movie night" and expands it into an interactive, fast-paced, multiplayer game that friends and family, both local and afar, can enjoy!

games.title: What the Golf?
games.category: Puzzle, Simulator, Sport, Adventure, Indie, Arcade
games.description: The golf game for people who hate golf. A silly physics-based golf parody where every golf course is a new surprising type of golf, some brilliant or hilarious, others so absurd they will make you go: What the golf!

games.title: Whateverland
games.category: Point-and-click, Music, Puzzle, Strategy, Adventure, Indie, Visual Novel
games.description: Welcome to Whateverland, a prison for lost souls, where everyone gets what they truly deserve! This, not so classic, point-n-click will take you on an adventure through the bizarrely beautiful hand-drawn world. And you're the only one who decides what kind of story it's going to be!

games.title: Wheel of Fortune
games.description: Play as a contestant on Wheel of Fortune, America's favorite TV show, anytime, anywhere! Spin the wheel and put your brain to the test against thousands of unique puzzles. Play solo or challenge players online. Enjoy an authentic TV-show experience with Wheel of Fortune. Spin the wheel, win special wedges, and experience true-to-the-TV-show rules. Win iconic in-game prizes such as luxurious trips, cars, and up to one million dollars.

games.title: Wheel of Words: Crossword
games.description: "Wheel of Words: Crossword" is a delightful word puzzle game designed to test your vocabulary and problem-solving skills. Connect letters to form words that fit into crossword puzzles, uncover hidden bonus words, and enjoy the rewarding feeling of completing each grid.

games.title: Wheelie Life Simulator
games.description: Feel the adrenaline of Wheelie Life Simulator, the ultimate motorcycle skill game where balance is everything. Ride on one wheel, push your limits, and prove your mastery in a world built for precision and thrills. Every ride is a test of control, focus, and daring — from quiet city streets to wide open countryside, this game is all about perfecting the art of the wheelie. Stylish, immersive, and endlessly challenging, it’s not just a ride — it’s your journey to becoming a wheelie legend.

games.title: Wheels of Aurelia
games.category: Puzzle, Racing, Adventure, Indie, Visual Novel
games.description:
A narrative road trip game set in the roaring Italian 70s, it tells the story of Lella, a restless woman driving on the roads of the western coast of Italy, the famous "Via Aurelia".
This is an interactive fiction in the shape of an isometric driving game and with a focus on replayability: every playthrough lasts about fifteen minutes and there are sixteen different endings to discover.

games.title: When the Past Was Around
games.description: When the Past was Around is an adventure point-and-click puzzle game about love, moving on, letting go, and the joy and pain of everything in between.

games.title: Where Are My Friends?
games.category: Point-and-click, Platform, Puzzle, Adventure, Indie, Arcade
games.description: Your friends are stuck on the foreign planet, which is going to blow up soon. What are you going to do? Run fast and think a lot! Go through different trials, save yourself, your friends and an entire civilization.

games.title: Where the Bees Make Honey
games.description: Where the Bees Make Honey tells a story about reflecting on different moments from your childhood, which are played and experienced from an adult perspective. At its core Where The Bees Make Honey is a puzzle adventure game, but gameplay variation is filtered throughout.

games.title: Where the Heart Leads
games.description:
On the kind of stormy night that can change a person's destiny, an enormous sinkhole opens in the middle of Whit Anderson's farm. Braving the rumbling thunder and the driving rain, Casey - their curious Golden Retriever - ventures too close to the gaping maw and tumbles in. Desperate to save her, Whit descends into the darkness, and emerges in a realm beyond his imagining.

In this strange world, constantly shifting like the stops and starts of a dream, Whit bears witness to the story of his life and gains the power to change it.

games.title: Where the Water Tastes Like Wine
games.description: Where the Water Tastes Like Wine is a Narrative-Adventure game about traveling, sharing stories, and surviving manifest destiny. Featuring gorgeous hand-drawn illustrations, Where the Water Tastes Like Wine combines 2D visuals with a 3D overworld US map.

games.title: Which Country Is Larger?
games.description: Is China bigger than the US?

games.title: While the Iron’s Hot
games.description: Reforge a blacksmith's village on an isle of the land's finest artisans! Step into the boots of an expert smith for a crafty adventure filled with mystery and charm. Explore the land of Ellian, and prove that a hammer, anvil, and your wits can overcome any challenge.

games.title: while True: learn()
games.description: You're a machine learning specialist who makes neural networks but your cat seems to be better at it. Now you must solve puzzles to build a cat-to-human translation system (who knows what else this cat is capable of!). Earn a fortune, buy kickass cat outfits and learn how machine learning really works!

games.title: While We Wait Here
games.description:
Share thoughts and hot food with your last ever clients, as you wait for the world to end.

Tackling themes of time, the armageddon and the intricacies of human psychology, While We Wait Here promises to be as deep as it does captivating, as players must juggle between the mundanity of flipping burger patties and pouring soda to the frighteningly serious threat that lies outside the diner’s doors.

games.title: Whipseey and the Lost Atlas
games.description:
After discovering a magical book, a young boy named Drew is whisked away to Whipseeyland, where he transforms into Whipseey, the pink, whip-wielding hero of this bright, colorful world. With the help of Princess Alyssa, Whipseey embarks on a quest to recover magical orbs that possess the power to return him home.

Whip or jump on enemies standing in the way and collect the magic gems they leave behind. Find an impassable chasm? Hold down the jump button and use the whip as a helicopter to travel further. Use swing points to fling Whipseey from one far-flung location to another and bounce off enemies to reach impossible heights.

games.title: Whirlight: No Time To Trip
games.description: In the heart of Verice Bay, a brilliant idea takes shape in the hands of an eccentric inventor and an eclectic artist. Follow Margaret and Hector in a point-and-click graphic adventure that will take you to the edge of space and time to help them avert imminent danger.

games.title: Whiskey & Zombies
games.description: "Whiskey & Zombies" is a story-driven beat'em up. It's a top-down, local multiplayer set in the swamplands of Louisiana where it turns out only the local 'whiskey' is strong enough to kill the zombie virus. Surviving the apocalypse, just drink, fight, and stay alive.

games.title: Whiskey Mafia: Blacklist
games.description: Step into the gritty streets of Chicago in Whiskey Mafia: Blacklist, a story-driven crime adventure. Play as a determined detective navigating a city full of gangsters, corrupt cops, and hidden dangers. Investigate crimes, follow leads, interrogate witnesses, and uncover the secrets of a mysterious Russian crime syndicate. Explore diverse locations from bustling markets and shady bars to the dangerous docks. Experience immersive dialogues, thrilling chases, and tense confrontations in a detailed, atmospheric city. Can you survive the criminal underworld and bring justice to the streets of Chicago?

games.title: Whiskey Mafia: Frank's Story
games.description:
Whiskey Mafia: Frank's Story is the new chapter of an ambitious crime story set in New York City in the mid 1920s. It tells the story of Frank, a humble and unremarkable postman who dreams of living big time. He receives a letter from his old buddy Leo who was able to successfully survive the horrors of war. Leo proposes to open their own bar as the first business and the first step to a glorious future.

In all of a sudden, their plans go south as they have to deal with loan sharks, business rivals, bootleggers and other kinds of criminals. The duo has to fight off competitors, raid their warehouses and run things smoothly with their own bar. Do you have what it takes to deal with tension and become a bar owner during one of the hard times of NYC?

games.title: Whiskey Mafia: Leo's Family
games.description: 1920 year. New York. City of high hopes and broken dreams, friends and traitors. Can a humble guy Christopher, the son of a port worker, make his American dream come true?

games.title: Whispered Flight
games.description: Embark upon a whimsical voyage as a radiant sphere of luminescence, gracefully soaring over the placid waters of a lake cradled within the ancient boughs of a mystical woodland. In pursuit of ethereal lumens, gather your scores under the watchful eyes of the stars, whilst evading the malevolent dark skulls seeking to quench your luminous essence. With a trinity of cherished lives, navigate through the verdant whispers of the old trees, to the gentle cadence of tranquility that accompanies your flight. Delight in the quaint, animated tapestry of nature’s hues as you partake in a casual contest of valor with fellow wanderers upon the leaderboard, in this gentle ballet of light against the encroaching shadow.

games.title: Whispering Willows
games.description: Young Elena Elkhorn embarks on a harrowing journey to find her missing father and discover the secrets of the Willows Mansion. Aiding her journey is a unique amulet, she received from her father, which allows her to astral project her spirit into a ghostly-realm and communicate with the dead. Play as Elena to find her missing father, use your astral projection to solves the mansion's tricks and puzzles, help the lingering souls and discover so much more in Whispering Willows.

games.title: Whispers of Winter Blossom
games.description: Beyond the falling snow awaits the miracle of meeting you.

games.title: Whispike Survivors: Sword of the Necromancer
games.category: Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Adventure, Indie, Arcade
games.description: Cultivate the strongest monster in this horde survivor farming game! Fight against waves of creatures to beef up your Whispike and use its seeds to create even stronger hybrids!

games.title: White Creek
games.description: As Alicia Morelli, manage resources, investigate haunted locations, and choose whether to kill the possessed or save their souls.

games.title: White Day: A Labyrinth Named School
games.description: Steel your nerves for a Korean horror without equal! Step into the shoes of student Hee-Min Lee and brave the terrors of Yeondu High School in a terrifying survival horror game filled with puzzles, secrets and - of course - deadly ghosts.

games.title: White Night
games.description:
The dark will reveal all in this third-person narrative-driven survival horror game set in the jazz/noir-era of the 1930s. White Night is both a survival horror and an homage to the first survival horror while developing its own identity. Set in America's early thirties, the game offers to live the nightmare of a man, hurt and trapped in an old family manor where darkness is a constant threat.

Stranded and injured in the dead of night after an unfortunate automobile accident, players must investigate a nearby dilapidated mansion and interact with their surroundings in search of aid and answers. White Night challenges players to confront the nightmares of the past on an adventure in which darkness is the enemy… and darkness is everywhere.

games.title: White Noise 2
games.description: White Noise 2 is the sequel of the successful White Noise Online. Be a part of the investigator team, or take control of the creature and devour them! White Noise 2 offers a 4vs1 asymmetric horror experience that won't let anyone unmoved.

games.title: White Wings
games.description: "White Wings" uses the Japanese "e-mote" animation system. This is an agonizing wintertime love song. Broken families, Experiences of bullying, Tears concealed by smiles. Young men and women, three encounters, each carries sorrowful secrets in the cold winter. Embracing each other and absorbing the earth’s final, small bit of warmth.

games.title: Whiteboyz Wit Attitude: The Pursuit of Money
games.description: First there was the Whip/Nae Nae, now it’s time to Wear The Purp with the greatest rappers of all time*! Dance along with the Whiteboyz Wit Attitude in an epic FMV rhythm game, and celebrate the launch of their new album The Pursuit of Money.

games.title: Whitestone
games.description: On the 'Sunchaser's capstone voyage to the Arctic, it's smooth sailing until Jack's quarters are broken into and his friend goes missing. Unsure who to trust, Jack is forced to fight nightmares both mental and physical as he becomes the prime suspect for a terrible deed.

games.title: Whitetail Challenge
games.description: Experience the ultimate outdoors survival/hunting game. Predators, lack of food, and exposure can quickly end your quest. Stay alive and continue to hunt more productive areas. Explore, hunt, experience and enjoy....

games.title: Who Needs a Hero?
games.description: A weak and dumb adventurer, venturing into the world of Grimar, seeking for fame, lots of gold and power!

games.title: Who Pressed Mute on Uncle Marcus?
games.description: An eccentric FMV murder mystery with a twist: someone has poisoned Uncle Marcus. Uncover the truth in the yearly family quiz and try to save him before it is too late.

games.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire
games.description:
Gather all your knowledge and get the jackpot while avoiding all the trick questions facing you!

With 15 questions to answer, it will become harder and harder to increase the prize fund: over 3,000 themed questions waiting to be answered (geographic, science, history, but also entertainment or arts), a growing difficulty and the pressure from the audience and the host…

games.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire: Hitchcock DLC Pack
games.description: Challenge yourself and your friends with this brand-new theme: Hitchcock

games.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire: NBA/NHL/MLB/NFL DLC Pack
games.description: Challenge yourself and your friends with this brand-new theme: NBA/NHL/MLB/NFL

games.title: Who Wants to Be A Millionaire: The Smurfs DLC Pack
games.description: Challenge yourself and your friends with this brand-new theme: The Smurfs

games.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire: US Movies 70s DLC Pack
games.description: Challenge yourself and your friends with this brand-new theme: US Movies 70s

games.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire: US Movies 80s
games.description: Challenge yourself and your friends with this brand-new theme: US Movies 80s

games.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire: US Movies 90s
games.description: Challenge yourself and your friends with this brand-new theme: US Movies 90s

games.title: Who Wants to Be A Millionaire: US Presidents DLC Pack
games.description: Challenge yourself and your friends with this brand-new theme: US Presidents

games.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire: WWE DLC Pack
games.description: Challenge yourself and your friends with this brand-new theme: WWE

games.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?: Deluxe Upgrade
games.description: The Deluxe Upgrade offers you more than 3,000 additional questions, on top of the 6,000+ questions in the basic game!

games.title: Who Wants To Be A Millionaire?: Geography II
games.description: Challenge yourself and your friends with this brand-new theme/ Geography II

games.title: Who Wants To Be A Millionaire?: Space Conquest
games.description: Challenge yourself and your friends with this brand-new theme: Space conquest

games.title: Who Wants To Be A Millionaire?: Tintin Pack
games.description: Challenge yourself and your friends with this brand-new theme: Tintin

games.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?: Trivia Bundle
games.description: The Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? Trivia Bundle gives you access to brand new Content Packs, featuring over 2,000 new questions on a variety of interesting topics.!

games.title: Who's at the Door?
games.description: You are trapped in a small house with psychosis, having lost your memory. Carefully observe your surroundings, distinguish between reality and hallucinations, and take the medication provided by visitors on time to overcome your illness.

games.title: Who's Your Daddy
games.description: Who's Your Daddy is a casual 1 on 1 video game featuring a clueless father attempting to prevent his infant son from certain death.

games.title: Whoowasit?
games.description: Reveal the secrets of the speaking animals and find the thief!

games.title: Whore of the Orient
games.description: The next title from the team behind L.A. Noire.

games.title: Why Pizza?
games.description:
"Baba is you" meet "Getting over it" to deliver the best pizza and try not to get bankrupt!

Why Pizza? is a platformer, physical simulator, and delivery job simulator. You have to deliver pizza, get your payment and survive this day, if you have not enough money you'll lose your house, food, and life, so be careful and work hard!

games.title: Wick
games.description: Wick is a survival horror game where ghost stories are brought to life. Explore a local legend about the long lost children in the woods who can still be seen, but only by those who dare to enter alone by candlelight.

games.title: Wife Quest
games.description: Help Mia to Rescue Fernando, your husband kidnapped by a dark elf witch called Morganna and her fellow monster girls.

games.title: WiLD
games.description:
"Wild is an open world action adventure created by Michel Ancel."

"WiLD is set in a lush, expansive world where you will learn and adapt to the ever changing world around you, whilst uncovering the secrets of the land.

As you would expect from mother nature, the world will continually change through different time of day, weather and seasonal changes.

Once you get used to your surroundings, you will learn Shamanic abilities in order to take control of animals and exploit their unique abilities to assist with your survival. Discovering the relationship between man and nature is the essence of WiLD. As you can take control of any animal in the world, this opens up huge potential for emergent gameplay that will be unique to you."

Announced in 2014, information about the game stopped soon after Paris game's week in 2015 but little else followed the news.

Sony recently, March 2019, filed a trademark for the game's title and new activity on Facebook ahead of E3 likely means more information to come at the event.

The game uses Linguini Engine developed by Pastagames Studios in collaboration with Wild Sheep Studio.

games.title: Wild & Adventure Pinball
games.description: Enjoy 6 games in one with the perfect reproduction of real pinball machines, with all kinds of graphic details and sounds. Discover all the secrets, complete all the missions and become number 1 in the world or the best among your Friends, posting your high score on the online leaderboard.

games.title: Wild & Horror Pinball
games.description:
Enjoy 6 games in one with the perfect reproduction of real pinball machines, with all kinds of graphic details and sounds.
Discover all the secrets, in these thrilling games, a great challenge awaits you.
Complete all the missions and become number 1 in the world or the best among your Friends, posting your high score on the online leaderboard. Arcade design.
More than 8 missions to accomplish for game! Are you ready? Multiball, Extraball, Skillshot, Jackpots...

games.title: Wild Arms
games.description:
Experience Wild Arms originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

A warrior, a princess and a rogue cross the wastelands of Filgaia on a quest for ancient relics that may save this brave new world – a world where legends become reality. Join Jack van Burace, Princess Cecilia and Rudy Roughnight as they heed the call of the mythic Guardians to defend the lands from the evil Metal Demons.

With a story that spans centuries, breathtaking combat arenas and fully customizable options, Wild Arms launched on PlayStation in Japan in 1996, and now you can relive the original role-playing adventure that spawned a much-loved series.

games.title: Wild Arms 2
games.description:
Experience Wild Arms 2 originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

It’s about one world hanging in the balance. Where one hero must sacrifice his heart for peace. Where courage and fear, love and malice, heroes and villains go hand in hand. It’s power that exceeds human knowledge. It’s neither dream nor reality. It’s what legends are made of.

games.title: Wild Arms 3
games.description: Wild Arms 3 (titled Wild Arms Advanced 3rd in Japan) boasts major technological improvements and a number of new gameplay elements. Featuring "stroke-shaded" animation-style graphics, a "Wild West" setting, and a completely 3D game engine (not just for battles, as in the previous games).

games.title: Wild Arms 4
games.description:
Experience Wild Arms 4 originally released on the PlayStation 2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Their meeting was fate. Filgaia, a world left in ruins by a brutal war, stands still. Ten years have passed since peace was won — yet true healing has never come. Now, on these scarred lands, a new journey begins.

games.title: Wild Card Football
games.description: Wild Card Football is a fun pick-up-and-play arcade-style football game featuring 7v7 team-focused gameplay with the unique Wild Card system that lets you change the course of the action in an instant with special power-ups and rule-breaking abilities.

games.title: Wild Card Football: Legacy WR Pack
games.description: Play as famed legacy Wide Receivers Cris Carter, Steve Smith Sr. and Andre Reed, along with their unique Wild Card outfits.

games.title: Wild Dogs
games.description: The world is under a frantic alien attack. Amidst the chaos and with the army virtually subdued, the deadliest and most inconsequential pair of specialists are called upon to do what must be done. Join the war hunting aliens around the world and in every way possible.

games.title: Wild Gunman Remake
games.description: Fan remake of the NES game Wild Gunman for PlayStation Vita, PlayStation 4, and Windows.

games.title: Wild Guns Reloaded
games.description: Wild Guns Reloaded is an enhanced remaster of Wild Guns. It introduces two new characters, Doris and Bullet the dog, along with his sentry drone. The update also includes extra stages and modes, along with improved visuals and audio.

games.title: Wild Island Quest
games.description: In an endless air ocean of an alien world, small lonesome plots of land float above the abyss. But sometimes approach each other, and lands which have never met before, reveal their secrets.

games.title: Wild Park Manager
games.description: Create a park full of animals and flowers, with sports fields and playgrounds!

games.title: Wild Pinball Bundle
games.description: Enjoy 3 games in one with the perfect reproduction of real pinball machines, with all kinds of graphic details and sounds. Discover all the secrets, in these thrilling games, dinosaurs, lions, elephants and sharks awaits you. Complete all the missions and become number 1 in the world or the best among your Friends, posting your high score on the online leaderboard.

games.title: Wild Rumble
games.description: Wild Rumble is a 3v3 roguelike soccer game in which you'll evolve your team as you score goals through dangerous arenas. Unlock new characters, master their abilities and pick the best upgrades to lead your team to victory!

games.title: Wild Seas
games.description: Defend the jewel of evil pirates! Wild Seas is a tower defense game with rogue-like elements, where your positioning can ensure victory

games.title: Wild Turkey Hunter
games.description: Come experience interactive hunting at it's best! Enjoy matching wits with America's most elusive game bird the wild turkey.

games.title: Wild West Crops
games.description: A retro style mini metroidvania game during Old West about "El Gatito", a lovely little "Pistolero" cat who needs to defend his hometown from evelish mutant vegetables!

games.title: Wild West Shooter
games.description: With a captivating single-player campaign and optional multiplayer modes, the game offers an authentic cowboy experience. Players explore different locations, upgrade their weapons and develop strategies for fast-paced shootouts, ensuring an adrenaline-fuelled adventure.

games.title: Wild West Tycoon Empire
games.description: In "Wild West Tycoon Empire," you are tasked with transforming the rugged Wild West into a thriving economic powerhouse.

games.title: Wildcat Gun Machine
games.category: Shooter, Real Time Strategy (RTS), Indie, Arcade
games.description: Wildcat Gun Machine is a bullet hell dungeon crawler where you take on hordes of disgusting flesh beasts with a wide variety of guns, giant mech robots, and cute kittens.

games.title: Wildermyth
games.category: Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Tactical, Adventure, Indie
games.description: Wildermyth is a character-driven, procedurally-generated tactical RPG. Lead a band of unique heroes as they grow from a reluctant farmers into legendary fighters. Battle threats lurking in the Yondering Lands and discover secrets that the land has to offer.

games.title: Wildfire
games.category: Platform, Puzzle, Role-playing (RPG), Strategy, Adventure, Indie
games.description: Master the elements in this stealth game where everything burns. Start fires, freeze water, and move earth itself to outsmart superstitious enemies who fear your power. Rescue captive villagers and reclaim your home by turning the environment against the army sent to hunt you down.

games.title: Wildkeepers Rising
games.description: Tame monsters! Slay waves of enemy hordes! Explore fantasy lands! Wildkeepers Rising is a whimsical action-RPG roguelite set in a beautiful hand-drawn world that combines the power curve of bullet heaven games with the compulsive fun of a creature collector.

games.title: Wildshade: Unicorn Champions
games.description: Cross the finishing line riding a unicorn!

games.title: WildTrax Racing
games.description: In WildTrax Racing you will enjoy the wildest and most spectacular races in natural environments. You will have several game modes such as Arcade and 4-player multiplayer. You will also be able to compare your best times with friends and players around the world on the online ranking chart.

games.title: Will Die Alone
games.description: Some memories aren't meant to stay. We are our memories and our experiences. What happens if you delete some of them? If you change your past and, thus, your future?

games.title: Will You Snail?
games.description: A fast action platformer where an evil AI tries to kill you by predicting your movement. Dodge AI-spawned traps, solve optional puzzles and uncover the dark secrets of the simulation.

games.title: Will: A Wonderful World
games.description: Become a god and help change the fate of people, even the world! In Will: A Wonderful World, you will receive letters written by characters living in urban cities. By rearranging the order and combinations of sentences in these letters, you are going to alter the destiny of whomever that wrote them.

games.title: Willy Jetman: Astromonkey's Revenge
games.category: Shooter, Platform, Role-playing (RPG), Adventure, Indie, Arcade
games.description: Willy Jetman: Astromonkey's Revenge is an arcade shooter full to the brim with action and shooting, inspired by the console classics of the 90s. A mysterious accident causes an environmental disaster on a faraway planet.

games.title: Willy Jetman: Astromonkey's Revenge - Sweeper's Edition
games.description:
The most unlikely hero stars in the biggest 2D adventure of the year. Save the planet Gravos, free its people, face the toughest bosses… And don't forget to recycle!

Sweeper's Edition includes;
- Drawstring bag
- High-Quality book
- Willy Jetman Pin Badge
- USB Light Point Figurine

games.title: Willy Morgan and the Curse of Bone Town
games.description: Third-person adventure game, set in a fantasy pirate-themed world with a modern touch. Combining the traditional point-and-click genre gameplay with a unique cartoon 3D graphics, Willy Morgan has the dreamy atmosphere, the humor and the freedom to explore typical of timeless classics such as Monkey Island.

games.title: Willy's Adventure
games.description: Join Willy in Willy’s Adventure, a fast-paced retro platformer packed with action and charm! Dash through a perilous castle, brave the icy snow fields, and face off against a fearsome boss in an epic final showdown. Armed with your trusty blaster and rocket-powered double jump, you’ll shoot, slide, and soar past monsters, spiders, and deadly traps in vibrant pixel worlds. With classic arcade energy and tight controls, Willy’s Adventure delivers the perfect blend of nostalgia and challenge — are you ready to conquer them all?

games.title: Willy's Wonderland: The Game
games.category: Fighting, Hack and slash/Beat 'em up, Indie, Arcade
games.description: Willy’s Wonderland: The Game is a 2.5D beat ‘em up game based on the cult film of the same name, in which a group of Animatronics come to life and slaughter people who dare visit Willy’s Wonderland.

games.title: Wilmot's Warehouse
games.description: Wilmot's Warehouse is a puzzle game about keeping a warehouse running in tip-top shape. You play as Wilmot, a hard working warehouse employee tasked with pushing, sorting and stacking a variety of products. Over time more and more truckloads of these products will arrive, gradually filling up the warehouse. How you arrange them all is entirely up to you - organize by color, type, the Dewey Decimal System, or some wild format that only you understand - it's all good! Just remember where you put everything, because when the service hatch opens, you'll need to find the things people want quickly, in order to earn the coveted Performance Stars required for all manner of labor-saving upgrades.

games.title: Wind of Shuriken
games.description: Wind Shuriken is an exciting, stylish action platformer. Play as a legendary fighter from another galaxy, and use your legendary sword to defeat powerful enemies.

games.title: Wind Peaks
games.description: In a place called Wind Peaks, mysteries happen, help the scouts find all the missing objects in this fun and relaxing adventure of treasure hunt.

games.title: Windborn: Journey to the South
games.description: Guide your bird south, staying with your flock. Soar through speed boosts, embrace the skies, and don’t fall behind. Can you keep up?

games.title: Windbound
games.description: The Forbidden Islands are Calling, Unlock their Secrets. Shipwrecked on an island, explore, adapt and navigate the land and perilous seas to stay alive.

games.title: Windfolk: Sky Is Just the Beginning
games.description: Test your flying skills. Become the fastest person in Eurian and don't let the enemies stop you. Use barrel rolls and acrobatic movements to fly as fast as you can. Battle in a unique environment where you have to keep moving in order to dodge the enemies' attacks. Combine your weapons and skills to create unique effects that will help you defeat your enemies. From the tropical seaside with floating islands to the scorching deserts that hold the ruins of an ancient civilization, discover the wonderful world of Eurian. Go behind enemy lines and explore every corner of each stage.

games.title: Windjammers
games.description:
Windjammers (also known as Flying Power Disc in Japan) is a fast paced sports arcade game released by Data East on the Neo Geo arcade system in 1994 and later on the Wii Virtual Console in Japan on June 22, 2010. Following the bankruptcy of Data East, the intellectual rights for this game were acquired by Paon. It was delisted in Japanese Virtual Console for the Wii on December 24, 2013, making it the only delisted Neo Geo game for the Wii Virtual Console.

The game mechanics are essentially the same as Pong or air hockey, where players continuously shoot the disc at the goal zone of the opponent attempting to score. The game can be played against the computer or in a 2 player versus.

games.title: Windjammers 2
games.description: Windjammers 2 will combine everything fans love about the classic title with entirely hand-drawn 2D animations to create the ultimate windjamming experience. The coming sequel will bring new stages and players, surprising and amazing new power moves and enhanced gameplay mechanics!

games.title: Windmill Engine
games.description: "Windmill Engine" is an incremental game where you need to build a windmill structure in a cartoon style of graphics.

games.title: Winds & Leaves
games.description:
Learn to read the signs of the various climates, awaken old landmarks, and grow your own forests in this PlayStation VR flora builder.

Stranded in a barren landscape, you are the only being capable of mastering the ancient art of growing vegetation.

Journey across the Steppe to discover landmarks left behind from a previous time. Uncover their secrets in order to unlock new equipment and gather ancient dormant seed varieties. Find the perfect conditions to plant them in and you'll witness magnificent trees grow to maturity and transform the landscape.

games.title: Windstorm: An Unexpected Arrival
games.description: Rediscover the breathtaking world of Windstorm, based on the established film and book series, Ostwind! There are many new things to discover on Kaltenbach Ranch! Ride through exciting adventures on Windstorm's back in this video game sequel based on the second film!

games.title: Windstorm: An Unexpected Arrival
games.description: After surviving a fire, Windstorm is restless and not even Mika is able to help him. It is only when the brave girl Ari unexpectedly arrives at the beautiful Kaltenbach estate that Windstorm is able to calm down by befriending Ari. Even though Ari has …

games.title: Windstorm: Start of a Great Friendship
games.description: Based on the successful Windstorm movies and best-selling books, experience exciting riding tasks together with Windstorm and freely explore the breathtaking surroundings of the Kaltenbach estate. Ride alongside other horses, look for hidden objects and try to become the racing champion. Numerous secrets and hidden locations are waiting to be discovered! After a long day of adventuring across the beautiful hills of Kaltenbach, take care of your animal friend with all of your love! Grooming, scraping out hooves and much more is necessary to keep your newly made friend in good shape.

games.title: Windswept
games.description: Our feather-shelled heroes were swept away by a storm, and they need your help! In this '90s-inspired platforming adventure, take on over forty handcrafted stages to discover the secrets of their world, the moon and beyond!

games.title: Wing of Darkness
games.description: This high-speed flying shooter features young girls, who with wings on their back, must fight the "Blanka," mysterious flying entities that suddenly appeared one day.

games.title: Wings of Bluestar
games.description:
Wings Of Bluestar is a 2D horizontal shmup (shoot'em up) that offers singe and local multiplayer. It's sci-fi themed and has an anime art style.
The game offers a lot of features to unlock using ingame earned points, these features are like more credits, boss challenge, gallery etc.

games.title: Wings of Endless
games.description:
Wings of Endless" is an action RPG that captivates with its platforming elements and a rich, pixel-art visual style. The game unfolds the story of Hariku, a confident bounty hunter whose routine mission evolves into an expansive quest, revealing the layers of a long-forgotten war. Accompanied by Owly, his mysterious talking owl, and a cast of unexpected allies, Hariku's journey spans across diverse and vivid landscapes filled with secrets, from desolate deserts and lush forests to icy expanses and marshlands​​​​.

The gameplay is dynamic, emphasizing a combat system that allows players to control three distinct heroes, each with unique abilities, and switch between them in real-time to unleash powerful combos. This system, alongside a vast world ripe for exploration, numerous side missions, a variety of challenging enemies, and intricate puzzles, ensures a gameplay experience that is both engaging and rewarding. Additionally, the game features a crafting system for consumables, further enriching the gameplay with strategic elements​

games.title: Wingspan
games.category: Strategy, Turn-based strategy (TBS), Indie, Card & Board Game
games.description: In Wingspan you are bird enthusiasts - researchers, bird watchers, ornithologists, and collectors - seeking to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves.

games.title: Wingspan: Asia Expansion
games.description: Explore the wonders of Asia in Wingspan: Asia Expansion! Discover new birds and bonus cards, compete in Duet Mode, and immerse yourself in rich landscapes with stunning art and soothing music. Compete in fresh challenges, and experience a serene journey with Asia's avian marvels!

games.title: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Additional Asian Avians
games.description: Expand your bird sanctuary with 25 fan-designed Asian bird cards featuring unique powers, habitats, and birdsong. This content introduces species from diverse regions across Asia that have not previously appeared in Wingspan, along with an exclusive player portrait.

games.title: Wingspan: Bird Pack - British Birds
games.description:
Expand your bird sanctuary with Wingspan Bird Pack: British Birds, featuring species from the British Isles!

Enhance your wildlife preserve with the fan-designed 25 British bird cards with unique powers, and hear them sing in this first digital Bird Pack.
